BA00.boundary: 同期、同团队、单位和币种一致；区分看板与本体目标口径
BA00.evidenceRule: 经营总览按指标定义分别取数；销售目标、订单、发货和财务数据不能直接相加。
BA00.io: 目标和履约事实 → 同期经营缺口
BA00.name: 销售目标与实绩对账

BA01.boundary: 转换时间不自动证明已关联具体商机
BA01.evidenceRule: 按线索主键逐条核查状态时间。
BA01.io: 线索 → 待派／待领清单和转化记录
BA01.name: 分派、认领与转换

BA02.boundary: 商机节点沿用上传模板
BA02.evidenceRule: 按商机ID关联预测和订单明细；客户分支按BR-Q04和BOR31圈定客户。线索转商机缺稳定逐条键。
BA02.io: 客户需求和目标 → 商机及预测
BA02.name: 获取、推进与签单分析

BA03.boundary: 红区分类不能单独认定违规
BA03.evidenceRule: 报价申请行上的商机ID与申请单ID为下钻入口，版本及匹配率须验收。
BA03.io: 报价申请 → 报价结果和审批证据
BA03.name: 报价办理与红区复核

BA04.boundary: 区分普通订单、变更和取消，避免重复累加
BA04.evidenceRule: 商机通过订单行关联订单；报价与订单缺可信键时仅保留流程衔接。
BA04.io: 商机和客户订单 → 有效订单
BA04.name: 接单、审批与有效变更

BA05.boundary: 订单行作为未发事实核对粒度
BA05.evidenceRule: 以订单行对计划及实际发货；业务键空或冲突时单列。
BA05.io: 有效订单与交期 → 发货及履约证据
BA05.name: 排程、发货与履约

BA06.boundary: 已认领与财务到账、核销分别记录
BA06.evidenceRule: 按应收明细与账龄关联；发货和核销间须有正式财务关联。
BA06.io: 应收明细与到期日 → 对账及催收清单
BA06.name: 账龄对账与核销跟踪

BA07.boundary: 分成版本、比例单位和应合计由业务确认
BA07.evidenceRule: 按分成记录的订单ID回查；有效版本和金额归属待确认。
BA07.io: 订单和批准分配单 → 分成核对结果
BA07.name: 分成分配与绩效核对

AC-GD01.acceptance: 复算同订单超期订未发金额；交期变更须有审批，实际发货须有凭证
AC-GD01.content: 按超期天数和未发影响排序，逐单确认补发、协商改期或修复关联
AC-GD01.name: 超期订未发处置
AC-GD01.target: 复算同订单超期订未发金额；交期变更须有审批，实际发货须有凭证

AC-GD02.acceptance: 同目标版本重跑实发/目标电量，逐单确认已发、获准改期和未解决项
AC-GD02.content: 核对缺口订单的供货承诺、计划和实际过账，限期更新交付安排
AC-GD02.name: 出货量低于同期目标处置
AC-GD02.target: 同目标版本重跑实发/目标电量，逐单确认已发、获准改期和未解决项

AC-GF01.acceptance: 对原账龄行核对财务核销及未结余额；已到期行数本身不作为关闭条件
AC-GF01.content: 按客户核对回款、认领、核销和争议，明确催收或财务处理责任人
AC-GF01.name: 到期账龄记录需要对账处置
AC-GF01.target: 对原账龄行核对财务核销及未结余额；已到期行数本身不作为关闭条件

AC-GF02.acceptance: 用正式源复跑同期间周转天数和账龄；模拟值永不作为复检结果
AC-GF02.content: 落实正式财务源后定位账龄贡献，核对重点客户和争议单据
AC-GF02.name: 应收周转偏高（待正式财务源）处置
AC-GF02.target: 用正式源复跑同期间周转天数和账龄；模拟值永不作为复检结果

AC-GG01.acceptance: 同一团队范围和目标版本复核销售额及达成率，并核对待跟进订单
AC-GG01.content: 锁定缺口较大的团队，逐单分派商机补量或履约核查，约定复检窗口
AC-GG01.name: 销售额达成低于目标处置
AC-GG01.target: 同一团队范围和目标版本复核销售额及达成率，并核对待跟进订单

AC-GL01.acceptance: 同口径重跑GX01并核查原清单线索主键；有记录证明实际流转
AC-GL01.content: 按状态和等待时间逐条分派或联系认领，补录已发生的节点
AC-GL01.name: 线索积压待处理处置
AC-GL01.target: 同口径重跑GX01并核查原清单线索主键；有记录证明实际流转

AC-GO01.acceptance: 同订单回查审批及生效凭证；复检逾期未完成清单和同口径指标
AC-GO01.content: 对未完成订单核实审批、资料和变更状态，协调责任人补齐材料
AC-GO01.name: 订单接收办理超期处置
AC-GO01.target: 同订单回查审批及生效凭证；复检逾期未完成清单和同口径指标

AC-GP01.acceptance: 同一订单、版本和比例单位按批准口径复核，再对照分配单验收
AC-GP01.content: 对照批准分配单和有效版本，核实重复与漏配，由业务负责人确认更正
AC-GP01.name: 订单业绩分成待对账处置
AC-GP01.target: 同一订单、版本和比例单位按批准口径复核，再对照分配单验收

AC-GQ01.acceptance: 同一报价主键复核审批记录及处置结果；保留原期间红区记录用于审计
AC-GQ01.content: 逐单补齐定价依据与审批凭证，提交例外审批或在原系统修订报价
AC-GQ01.name: 红区报价待复核处置
AC-GQ01.target: 同一报价主键复核审批记录及处置结果；保留原期间红区记录用于审计

AC-GQ02.acceptance: 同批报价审批完成且逾期未完成清单减少，分别保留历史周期和当前状态
AC-GQ02.content: 按责任人列出超期报价，核实等待阶段并约定处理时间
AC-GQ02.name: 报价办理超期处置
AC-GQ02.target: 同批报价审批完成且逾期未完成清单减少，分别保留历史周期和当前状态

AC01.acceptance: 每条商机需求输入完成且审批通过，或有放弃结论；按周更新进展
AC01.content: 在BR-Q04储能客户范围内，对处于 P0、未签单且需求确认未完成的战略客户商机，逐条完成客户需求输入与审核（客户需求审核状态＝已审核），无法推进的给出放弃结论
AC01.name: 逐户补齐战略客户需求确认
AC01.objects: 储能名单内根因影响明细中的战略客户 P0 商机
AC01.role: 销售负责人（牵头）＋ 方案经理
AC01.target: C01 中需求输入未完成（new_demandinput = 0）的商机降为 0，C01 商机数下降

AC02.acceptance: 逐户建立商机或给出不开拓理由
AC02.content: 仅储能客户名单内。对商机数为 0 的战略客户限期建立商机，明确目标产品部、需求调研计划与责任人
AC02.name: 无商机战略客户限期建立商机
AC02.objects: 储能名单内待突破战略客户（R09 清单）
AC02.target: R09 待突破战略客户数降为 0

AC03.acceptance: 逐户计划齐全并按月更新
AC03.content: 仅储能客户名单内。针对战略客户逐户制定突破计划：目标产品部、目标电量、责任人、时间表，跟进无商机战略客户的需求调研与商机建立进度。
AC03.name: 战略客户突破计划
AC03.objects: 储能名单内全部战略客户
AC03.role: 销售 VP（牵头）＋ 对应产品部总经理
AC03.target: 战略客户覆盖率提升；R09待突破战略客户数下降

AC06.acceptance: 每条超期商机卡点关闭或给出新的完成时间
AC06.content: 对 P2 在途超期商机优先排技术资源，补齐技术协议、规格书、质保协议等输入，逐项关闭卡点
AC06.name: 方案推动超期项目优先排资源
AC06.objects: 方案推动超期商机（C07 清单）
AC06.target: C07 超期商机数下降；P2-02 超期预测量下降

AC07.acceptance: 各产品部缺口与对应待签商机逐项对账
AC07.content: 按产品部分解销售缺口，资源优先保障缺口最大的产品部，并匹配同部门待签商机
AC07.name: 产品部缺口分解与资源倾斜
AC07.objects: 销售缺口为负的产品部

AC08.acceptance: 月度经营分析会输出对账结论
AC08.content: 将产品部达成率与战略客户商机推进率纳入月度经营分析对账
AC08.name: 纳入月度经营对账
AC08.target: 月度对账覆盖全部产品部

AC09.acceptance: 逐单转化计划齐全并按周更新
AC09.content: 对待签集中的产品类型（电芯 / PACK）逐单制定转化计划：预计签约时间、责任人、所需支持
AC09.name: 电芯 / PACK 待签逐单转化
AC09.objects: 待签占比 ≥ 20% 的产品类型商机
AC09.target: R05 / R06 待签金额下降

AC10.acceptance: 重点跟踪清单覆盖全部战略、重点客户未签单商机
AC10.content: 在BR-Q04储能客户范围内，将战略、重点客户未签单商机全部纳入重点跟踪，使重点跟踪占未签单预测 ≥ 70%
AC10.name: 扩大重点跟踪纳管
AC10.objects: 储能名单内战略、重点客户未签单商机

AC11.acceptance: 每条商机完成需求确认或关闭
AC11.content: 在BR-Q04储能客户范围内，对重点跟踪以外（一般客户）的未签单商机中 P0 需求未确认的商机，逐条确认需求与预计签约时间
AC11.name: 其余商机需求确认专项
AC11.objects: 储能名单内C06 清单中的商机
AC11.target: C06 需求未确认商机数降为 0

AC12.acceptance: 超期环节逐项关闭；环节事件补录完整
AC12.content: 定位商机获取阶段超期的具体环节（保密协议、客户需求、协作团队、需求输入、销售预测、客户组织架构），逐环节指定责任人并补录环节事件
AC12.name: 商机获取环节卡点清理
AC12.objects: P0 超期商机（P0-02 清单）
AC12.role: 销售负责人 ＋ 销售运营
AC12.target: P0-02 超期商机预测量下降；P0-05 / P0-08 完成事件可计算

RC-GD01.aiFocus: 用逐单查询定位订单，核验客户要求交期、有效订单行和实际发货明细，按订单行核对缺口
RC-GD01.condition: 确证的是履约差额；缺料、产能、质量和客户延期需各自凭证
RC-GD01.name: 到期订单存在未发余额
RC-GD01.output: 证据、反证、适用范围、结论状态

RC-GD02.aiFocus: 先定位团队差距，再核对相同范围内的欠发订单及发货事实，统一电量单位
RC-GD02.condition: 欠发仅作为候选贡献，目标与欠发不在同粒度时不直接对账
RC-GD02.name: 交付缺口集中在欠发订单
RC-GD02.output: 证据、反证、适用范围、结论状态

RC-GF01.aiFocus: 按账龄主键及应收明细ID核对到期日、应收金额、已认领金额，再查财务核销和币种
RC-GF01.condition: 到期是可观察事实；已认领不能直接当已到账或已核销，金额不跨币种合计
RC-GF01.name: 应收到期且认领或核销情况待核实
RC-GF01.output: 证据、反证、适用范围、结论状态

RC-GF02.aiFocus: 补齐正式周转指标、期间应收余额与赊销口径，再下钻账龄及客户；禁止用模拟值作证据
RC-GF02.condition: 须确认同口径快照及现金、应收与核销归属
RC-GF02.name: 逾期余额或账期结构变化
RC-GF02.output: 证据、反证、适用范围、结论状态

RC-GG01.aiFocus: 优先读取同一产品团队组合查询，按团队计算同期目标与实绩差，核实发货、确认与目标版本
RC-GG01.condition: 团队缺口只解释分布；确认经营原因还需核对订单和履约证据
RC-GG01.name: 目标缺口集中在部分团队
RC-GG01.output: 证据、反证、适用范围、结论状态

RC-GL01.aiFocus: 按状态1/2分组，并查分派、认领时间；时间与状态冲突先核实
RC-GL01.condition: 确认未完成的环节，不能仅凭空时间推断人员未处理
RC-GL01.name: 线索在分派或认领环节停留
RC-GL01.output: 证据、反证、适用范围、结论状态

RC-GO01.aiFocus: 按源SQL起止确认审批开始、结束及有效版本，查当前处理记录；配置为MOCK时只试算
RC-GO01.condition: 起止时间或状态不足时，不能归因为审批停滞
RC-GO01.name: 订单审批或生效等待
RC-GO01.output: 证据、反证、适用范围、结论状态

RC-GP01.aiFocus: 按订单主键核查分成记录、原始比例及行数；同一订单与负责人多行需区分分成版本及职责
RC-GP01.condition: 无物理主键保证；发现原始口径差异只列待核对，不能认定结算错误
RC-GP01.name: 分成规则或有效记录重复待核实
RC-GP01.output: 证据、反证、适用范围、结论状态

RC-GQ01.aiFocus: 按源SQL报价主键定位红区记录，核对成本、折扣、报价版本和授权材料
RC-GQ01.condition: 只有报价和审批依据相符时，才可记录具体越权或成本偏差；红区本身不能证明违规
RC-GQ01.name: 红区报价的定价依据待确认
RC-GQ01.output: 证据、反证、适用范围、结论状态

RC-GQ02.aiFocus: 配对同一报价版本提交与审批结果，核对未完成状态和等待时长；当前配置为MOCK时只试算
RC-GQ02.condition: 无法区分审批等待、数据未回传或无需审批时，标为待核实
RC-GQ02.name: 报价申请审核等待
RC-GQ02.output: 证据、反证、适用范围、结论状态

RC01.aiFocus: AI 对 C01 商机下钻需求输入完成标志（new_demandinput）、客户需求提交 / 审批时间与项目进展文本，归纳未落实环节（需求未输入 / 未审批 / 被驳回）及客户侧原因；输出受影响商机清单与预测量
RC01.condition: 储能客户范围按BR-Q04，存在战略客户（等级 1）处于 P0（new_processstage = 11）、有效（statecode = 0）且未签单的商机，数量或预测金额 / 电量 > 0（客户口径：C01 不再以需求未确认作取值过滤，需求确认情况作原因下钻）
RC01.name: 战略客户需求确认未落实
RC01.output: 是否成立、受影响商机 / 客户清单、受影响预测金额与电量、证据（指标值、查询配置键、明细）

RC03.aiFocus: AI 归纳超期商机的卡点类别（技术协议、质保协议、规格书、中信保限额）并给出滞留天数分布；P2-05 无独立起止事件时仅作文本判断
RC03.condition: 未签单商机处于 P2 且在途用时 > P2 动态平均周期（P2-01）× 1.5（严格大于；等于不触发）；卡点环节按 P2-03 技术协议 / 规格书、P2-04 质保协议、P2-05 中信保限额各自周期 > 同组均值 × 1.5 定位
RC03.name: 方案推动超期
RC03.output: 是否成立、受影响商机 / 客户清单、受影响预测金额与电量、证据（指标值、查询配置键、明细）

RC04.aiFocus: 规则判定；AI 仅用于解释缺口归属与同部门待签商机
RC04.condition: 同一产品部累计实际销售 − 年度目标 < 0（金额、电量分别判断）
RC04.name: 产品部销售缺口
RC04.output: 是否成立、受影响商机 / 客户清单、受影响预测金额与电量、证据（指标值、查询配置键、明细）

RC05.condition: 某产品类型待签预测占该类总预测 ≥ 20%
RC05.name: 产品结构待签集中
RC05.output: 是否成立、受影响商机 / 客户清单、受影响预测金额与电量、证据（指标值、查询配置键、明细）

RC06.condition: 分母R02 > 0，且储能名单内R04 ÷ 全部R02 < 70%（严格小于；等于70%不成立）。金额、电量分别判断。
RC06.name: 重点跟踪商机承接不足
RC06.output: 是否成立、受影响商机 / 客户清单、受影响预测金额与电量、证据（指标值、查询配置键、明细）

RC07.aiFocus: AI 对其余未签单商机按需求输入标志与进展文本分组，列出需优先确认的商机
RC07.condition: C09其余占比 ≥ 30%，且储能名单内、等级明确且非重点跟踪的C06商机（P0、statecode = 0、未签单、new_demandinput = 0）商机数或预测金额 / 电量 > 0；金额、电量分别判断。
RC07.name: 其余商机需求未确认
RC07.output: 是否成立、受影响商机 / 客户清单、受影响预测金额与电量、证据（指标值、查询配置键、明细）

RC08.aiFocus: AI 依据可得事件（保密协议起止、客户需求提交 / 审批、销售预测完成）与进展文本定位卡点环节
RC08.condition: P0 阶段超期（P0-02 > 0）时，按小环节自身起止定位：P0-03 签保密协议、P0-04 输入客户需求、P0-05 选择协作团队、P0-06 申请需求输入、P0-07 创建或更新销售预测、P0-08 确认客户组织架构；单笔周期 > 同组动态均值 × 1.5
RC08.method: 规则 + AI（P0-05 / P0-08 尚无完成事件，为 AI 文本判断）
RC08.name: 商机获取环节卡点
RC08.output: 是否成立、受影响商机 / 客户清单、受影响预测金额与电量、证据（指标值、查询配置键、明细）

RC09.aiFocus: AI 汇总无商机战略客户的线索、拜访与需求记录，区分“未开拓”与“需求未识别”，给出每户的开拓切入点
RC09.condition: 储能客户范围按BR-Q04，战略客户名单内商机数 = 0 的客户数 > 0（R09 > 0），且无近期线索、拜访或需求调研记录（依据专家关联规则：R09 无商机客户需补查需求及开拓情况）
RC09.name: 战略客户开拓不足
RC09.output: 是否成立、受影响商机 / 客户清单、受影响预测金额与电量、证据（指标值、查询配置键、明细）

LE01.definition: 商机主数据：客户、产品类型、阶段、审核状态、负责人等。
LE01.name: 商机管理

LE02.definition: 商机按月的预测 / 正式订单金额与电量；商机预测金额的事实来源。
LE02.name: 项目月度销售预测

LE04.definition: 商机推进记录：阶段、卡点、下一步、完成情况。
LE04.name: 项目进展

LE05.definition: 客户主数据：客户等级、名称、建档时间。
LE05.name: 客户

LE06.definition: 年度及月度销售目标。同商机＋年度可能有多次目标版本，必须先取createdon最新版本（同时间按new_targetid降序）；空商机ID以目标ID独立保留，再按客户、产品或团队汇总。客户/产品不是版本去重键。

LE07.definition: 销售订单头：状态、变更、审批。

LE08.name: 订单产品

LE11.definition: 人员所属团队，用于负责人 → 产品团队。
LE11.name: 团队人员关系

LE13.definition: 经人工确认下发的经营任务令；来源为行动建议（本体元素 AC）的运行记录。
LE13.name: 任务令

LE14.definition: 报价申请头：OA 提交、审批时间与状态；申请报价环节周期（P1-07）。
LE14.name: 报价申请单

LE15.definition: 报价申请行：关联商机（new_opportunity_id）与报价申请单。
LE15.name: 报价申请单明细

LE16.definition: 发货单头：发货日期、状态；产品部实际销售归期（C04）。
LE16.name: 发货单

LE17.definition: 发货行：订单、产品编码、数量、本币金额（C04）。
LE17.name: 发货单明细

LE18.definition: 产品物料主数据：产品编码、系统电量（发货电量换算）。
LE18.name: 产品物料

LE21.definition: DA未声明物理主键，使用前确认粒度与重复记录
LE21.name: 线索进展

LE22.definition: DA未声明物理主键，使用前确认粒度与重复记录
LE22.name: 报价单产品

LE29.definition: DA未声明物理主键，使用前确认粒度与重复记录
LE29.name: 销售业绩分成

LE31.name: 储能系统项目进展明细表

LE32.name: 储能系统项目进展总表

LE33.definition: 仅登记CSV SQL中的外部依赖，字段结构与配置环境待验
LE33.name: 静态指标配置

B01.definition: 年度销售目标：先筛年度→按商机ID＋年度排列目标版本→仅保留rn=1→展开该版本12个月→按客户、产品或团队汇总。汇总所选年度全年12个月的销售目标金额及电量。
B01.name: 年度销售目标
B01.note: 先版本去重后汇总；空商机ID按目标ID独立保留。
B01.rule: 同商机同年度按createdon DESC NULLS LAST、new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST取一条；空商机ID用new_targetid独立保留。客户、产品和团队仅作汇总维度，不作版本去重键；不同商机即使客户或产品相同也分别保留。金额new_month1～12按元÷10^8转亿元；电量new_month1_power～12_power按kWh÷10^6转GWh。作为预测缺口及签单进度的比较基准。
B01.status: 查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细

B02.definition: 按同年度、组织和产品范围汇总 CRM 商机预测。按商机及产品预测明细去重。
B02.name: 商机总预测金额／电量
B02.note: 同编码在不同组合的预测取值不一致；本次独立查询按阶段说明的预测金额，商机＋月份取最新。
B02.rule: 作为预测总量基准，和 B01 比较。
B02.status: 查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细

C01.definition: 客户须在储能名单且等级1；最新商机new_processstage=11、statecode=0，经订单明细未关联到真实订单。数量按商机ID去重，预测金额/电量按本文件原所选期间最新预测规则汇总；缺预测不影响商机数量。
C01.name: 处于 P0 阶段的战略客户未签单商机数及预测量
C01.note: 储能名单内等级1、P0=11、statecode=0、无真实订单；需求输入情况用于下钻。预测缺失不影响商机计数。
C01.rule: 数量不依赖预测记录存在；预测金额与电量分别计算。此指标不再以需求未确认作为额外取值过滤，需求确认情况可另作原因下钻。
C01.status: 已实现；P0有效战略未签集合，数量与预测分开计算

C03.definition: 产品部年度销售目标：先筛年度→按商机ID＋年度排列目标版本→仅保留rn=1→展开该版本12个月→按客户、产品或团队汇总。按目标归属团队汇总全年12个月金额与power；同一团队一行，仅列目标事实有记录的团队。
C03.name: 产品部年度销售目标
C03.note: C0专项增加来源记录数、非空计数与团队归属路径诊断。C03仅目标有记录团队，C04仅实绩有记录团队，C05明确未查到哪一侧；不把未出现的团队误报为核心字段全空，不强行补0。
C03.rule: 同商机同年度按createdon DESC NULLS LAST、new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST取一条；空商机ID用new_targetid独立保留。客户、产品和团队仅作汇总维度，不作版本去重键；不同商机即使客户或产品相同也分别保留。与C04按同一团队比较，C05计算实际－目标。金额new_month1～12按元÷10^8转亿元；电量new_month1_power～12_power按kWh÷10^6转GWh。
C03.status: 按结果动态判定（见 SQL 中 status 的 CASE）

C04.definition: 以产品团队为维度，汇总所选年度/期间截至观察日的实际销售额和实际销售电量。团队与C03保持同一名称范围，同一团队一行。 仅列出实际有实绩事实记录的团队。
C04.name: 产品部累计实际销售额／电量
C04.note: C0专项增加来源记录数、非空计数与团队归属路径诊断。C03仅目标有记录团队，C04仅实绩有记录团队，C05明确未查到哪一侧；不把未出现的团队误报为核心字段全空，不强行补0。 团队维度查找不再额外按商机创建年份截断，实际销售事实仍按发货期间筛选；同一订单有归属不明商机时不强行分给已知团队。 引用ID未匹配到商机的明细也视为团队归属不明。
C04.rule: 累计实际销售作为产品部差距判定的实绩依据。与 C03 的年度目标使用同年度、产品部及统计范围，按 C05 判定该产品部的销售缺口是否成立。
C04.status: 按结果动态判定（见 SQL 中 status 的 CASE）

C05.definition: 按同一产品团队逐项计算C04实际销售－C03年度目标，金额和电量分别计算；小于0代表该团队不足。
C05.name: 产品部实际销售与目标差距
C05.note: C0专项增加来源记录数、非空计数与团队归属路径诊断。C03仅目标有记录团队，C04仅实绩有记录团队，C05明确未查到哪一侧；不把未出现的团队误报为核心字段全空，不强行补0。 当目标或实绩团队仅在一侧出现时，记录数会明确为0，不能仅凭此就认定源字段全空。
C05.rule: 如同一产品部的累计实际销售减年度目标小于 0，则判定“该产品部存在销售缺口”成立。金额、电量分别判断。关联风险 2 时，须匹配该产品部的电芯或 PACK 待签商机。差距用于定位缺口归属，具体推进卡点按 C07 核实。
C05.status: 按结果动态判定（见 SQL 中 status 的 CASE）

C06.definition: 客户须在储能名单且不属于重点等级1/2；最新商机new_processstage=11、statecode=0、订单明细无真实订单、new_demandinput=0。按商机ID计数，预测缺失不阻断数量。 等级未知不进入C06。
C06.name: 其余未签单商机中 P0 需求未确认的商机数及预测量
C06.note: 仅储能名单内，排除重点等级1/2及等级未知，P0、有效、未签且需求未确认；预测缺失不影响数量。
C06.rule: 如其余未签单商机预测占全部未签单预测的比例大于或等于 30%，且其中存在仍处于 P0、需求确认未完成的商机，数量及对应预测金额或电量大于 0，则判定“其余商机需求未确认”这一原因成立。金额、电量分别判断。
C06.status: 已按需求输入Boolean完成标志实现；预测缺失不挡数量

C07.definition: 筛选当前仍在方案推动（P2）、且尚未签单的商机。在途用时为测量日减 P2 进入日。动态平均周期引用 P2-01。 签单判定按本次确认：商机ID关联订单明细.new_opportunity_id，再由明细.salesorderid关联订单.salesorderid；至少1个去重订单ID为已签，0个为未签。不使用批量合同确认枚举。
C07.name: 方案推动超平均周期 50% 的未签单商机
C07.note: 未发现P2动态均值及1.5倍比较；可依据本次阶段说明另算；签单按订单明细关联。
C07.rule: 如未签单商机仍处于 P2，且实际在途用时严格大于 P2 动态平均周期的 1.5 倍，则判定“方案推动超期”原因成立。按电芯、PACK 匹配风险 2 的待签商机，统计受影响预测金额和电量。等于 1.5 倍时不触发。
C07.status: 查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细

C08.definition: 分子为储能客户名单内的R04重点跟踪未签预测，分母沿R02全部未签单商机预测；金额、电量分别按原规则计算。客户名单仅调整分子所属客户范围。 签单按商机→订单明细→真实订单关联判定。
C08.name: 重点跟踪商机占未签单预测的比例
C08.note: R04分子限储能客户，R02分母仍为全部未签预测；金额、电量分别计算，分母大于0且严格低于70%才成立。
C08.rule: 如分母大于 0，且重点跟踪商机占未签单预测的比例严格低于 70%，则判定“重点跟踪商机承接不足”这一原因成立。等于 70% 时本项不成立。分母为 0 时不计算比例。
C08.status: 查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细

C09.definition: 沿原关系：其余预测＝R02全部未签预测－R04重点跟踪未签预测。R04重点跟踪客户限定储能名单；其余金额、电量与分母、缺值规则沿本文件，不把其余一律称一般客户。 签单按商机→订单明细→真实订单关联判定。
C09.name: 其余未签单商机预测金额／电量及占比
C09.note: R02全部未签预测减R04储能重点跟踪预测；其余占比以R02为分母，可能含名单外客户。C06只核查名单内商机。
C09.resultColumn: 金额_亿元、电量_GWh、比率_原始小数
C09.rule: 分母大于0时计算比例；负差额检查重复和范围。C09是全部未签减储能重点跟踪所得，其余可能包含名单外商机；C06只下钻储能名单内的P0需求未确认商机。
C09.status: 查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细

P0-01.definition: 统计所有实际经历过P0阶段的商机，不按当前new_processstage限定样本。当前已进入后续阶段的商机也纳入。按商机.createdon至new_stage1enddate计算；已完成取结束，在途取观察截止，按电芯/PACK分别计算动态均值。统计窗口以进入本阶段时间归期。
P0-01.name: 商机获取阶段平均周期
P0-01.note: 与C01的“当前处于P0”条件区分；阶段平均周期不加当前阶段枚举过滤。缺少有效日期的记录不能仅凭后续阶段枚举补造日期。
P0-01.rule: 单笔实际周期严格大于对应动态平均周期的 1.5 倍时判为超期风险。
P0-01.status: 查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细

P0-02.definition: 按阶段筛出实际周期大于动态平均周期 1.5 倍的商机。以商机 ID 去重后汇总预测金额和电量，细分电芯与 PACK。
P0-02.name: 商机获取阶段超过平均周期 50% 的商机预测总量
P0-02.note: 阶段均值包含已完成及在途；超过均值1.5倍预测量需另算。当前看板无同名完整查询。
P0-02.rule: 只汇总本阶段满足超期条件的商机。同一商机在同一阶段只计算一次。
P0-02.status: 查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细

P0-03.definition: 商机.new_cdaenddate－商机.new_cdastartdate，换算天后取平均。已完成取真实结束，在途取观察截止；以本环节开始时间归所选期间。已进入后续阶段的记录也保留，不限定当前阶段枚举。
P0-03.name: 签保密协议平均周期
P0-03.note: 保密协议继续使用已确认的商机表独立开始/结束日期。 总体按真实事件去重；缺起止数据与缺字段映射分开列示。分组样本不可直接相加。 客户表保密日期仍作独立对照，不静默覆盖本指标的商机表日期。
P0-03.rule: 对已实际进入本环节的有效事件计算周期；不以当前阶段枚举排除已到后续阶段的历史事件。同一事件去重，按电芯/PACK计算动态均值；单笔周期严格大于同组均值1.5倍才判超期。
P0-03.status: 按结果动态判定（见 SQL 中 status 的 CASE）

P0-04.definition: 商机.new_approved_time_acneed－商机.new_submit_time_acneed，换算天后取平均。已完成取真实结束，在途取观察截止；以本环节开始时间归所选期间。已进入后续阶段的记录也保留，不限定当前阶段枚举。
P0-04.name: 输入客户需求平均周期
P0-04.note: 客户需求按自身提交至审批通过；不再从商机创建时间累计。 总体按真实事件去重；缺起止数据与缺字段映射分开列示。分组样本不可直接相加。
P0-04.rule: 对已实际进入本环节的有效事件计算周期；不以当前阶段枚举排除已到后续阶段的历史事件。同一事件去重，按电芯/PACK计算动态均值；单笔周期严格大于同组均值1.5倍才判超期。
P0-04.status: 按结果动态判定（见 SQL 中 status 的 CASE）

P0-05.definition: 待确认，暂不计算；数值返回NULL。
P0-05.name: 选择协作团队平均周期
P0-05.note:
用户红字：待确认：是否要删除
处理：用户红字：待确认：是否要删除。本次按要求置空，停用优先流程和阶段回退；保留编码、名称及单位。
P0-05.rule: 不启用相关流程或阶段替代。

BR-Q05.name: 金额电量分开判定
BR-Q05.related:
风险：RK01、RK02、RK03、RK04、RK05、RK06、RK07、RK10（涉及金额、电量的判定）
根因：RC01、RC03、RC04、RC05、RC06、RC07、RC08、RC09（涉及金额、电量的判定）
BR-Q05.trigger: 全部 R / C 规则

BR-Q06.description: 阶段：所有实际经历过该阶段的商机（不按当前 new_processstage 限定），P0 = createdon → new_stage1enddate，P1~P4 = new_stageNenddate → new_stage(N+1)enddate；已完成取结束，在途取观察截止（所选期末与观察日较早者）；以进入阶段时间归期；按电芯、PACK 分别计算
BR-Q06.name: 动态平均周期
BR-Q06.result: 单笔周期严格大于同阶段同产品均值 × 1.5 判超期（等于不触发）；日期逆序剔除并计数；同商机每阶段只计一次

BR-Q08.description: 客户 SQL 无绑定参数：只改 parameters.start_date / end_exclusive（结束日不含，默认 2025 全年）；观察截止 = LEAST(当前时间, 期末)；时间进度 = (观察截止 − 年初) ÷ 全年天数
BR-Q08.name: 统计期间参数
BR-Q08.related:
指标：全部 51项指标
维度：D001 月度销售预测期间、D029 目标时间
BR-Q08.result: 年度目标（B01 / C03）不随期间缩为单月

BR-Q09.description: 阶段内小环节按本环节自身开始、结束事件计算，不以阶段起点代替本环节开始；已完成取真实结束，在途取观察截止；以本环节开始时间归期；同一事件去重
BR-Q09.name: 环节周期自身起止
BR-Q09.result: 独立起止事件未明确的环节主值保持 NULL（P0-05、P0-08、P1-06、P2-05、P3-03、P3-05、P3-06、P4-03、P4-04、S01、S02、S04）；P0-07 暂沿用创建 → 预测完成；P3-04例外，按BR-Q10处理

BR-Q10.description:
仅new_issap=1；SAP基准日期=COALESCE(new_sapdate,new_sapsubmitdate)，须落所选期间且不晚于观察截止。
商机.createdon>SAP基准日期时记0天，其他情况留NULL。
BR-Q10.name: SAP 建档周期

实体：LE01 商机管理、LE05 客户
关联：商机.parentaccountid=客户.accountid
比较：商机.createdon>COALESCE(客户.new_sapdate,客户.new_sapsubmitdate)
BR-Q10.result: 按商机ID去重、关联客户后逐项判断；0天样本参与平均，NULL不参与。等于、早于及日期缺失均不记0。new_issapnew仅按原始1/2分组。

BR-Q11.description:
目标：先筛年度→按商机ID＋年度排列目标版本→仅保留rn=1→展开该版本12个月→按客户、产品或团队汇总。同商机同年度按createdon DESC NULLS LAST、new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST取一条；空商机ID用new_targetid独立保留。客户、产品和团队仅作汇总维度，不作版本去重键；不同商机即使客户或产品相同也分别保留。金额new_month1～12按元÷10^8转亿元；电量new_month1_power～12_power按kWh÷10^6转GWh。
实绩沿原口径：发货明细new_amount_base÷10^8；电量＝数量×产品new_system_energy（kWh）÷10^6。
BR-Q11.name: 目标与实绩换算
BR-Q11.related:
指标：B01、R01、R03、R04、R05、R06、R08、C03、C04、C05及其目标依赖
实体：LE06 销售目标管理、LE17 发货单明细、LE18 产品物料
顺序：BR-Q03版本去重→target_facts月份展开→客户/产品/团队汇总。
BR-Q11.result: 目标SQL必须包含ROW_NUMBER按商机＋年度排序及rn=1，再执行SUM。不得只WHERE new_year后全量求和，不按客户或产品去重，不使用new_total_amount。空商机ID按目标ID独立保留；多团队不重复分摊，未分配沿原口径。
BR-Q11.trigger: B01、R01～R06、R08、C03～C05及其他使用年度目标的指标；C04实绩换算沿原口径。

WITH selected_period AS (
    SELECT NULL::timestamp AS start_at, NULL::timestamp AS end_at
    /*TIME_BEGIN*/
    WHERE FALSE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT CAST(:start_date AS timestamp), CAST(:end_exclusive AS timestamp)
    /*TIME_END*/
), lines AS (
    SELECT i."new_ord_shipmentitemid" AS fact_id,
           s."new_shipping2_date"::timestamp AS fact_date,
           i."new_amount_base"::numeric AS amount_cny,
           COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY i."new_ord_shipmentitemid") AS fact_copies
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipmentitem_esb" i
    JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb" s
      ON s."new_ord_shipmentid" = i."new_ord_shipment_id"
    WHERE i."new_qty" > 0
      AND s."statecode" = 0
      AND NULLIF(btrim(s."new_shipping2_date"::text), '') IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0
                 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(amount_cny)
                 AND bool_and(fact_copies = 1)
            THEN SUM(amount_cny) / 100000000::numeric
       END AS "M0001"
FROM lines
WHERE ((SELECT start_at FROM selected_period) IS NULL OR fact_date >= (SELECT start_at FROM selected_period))
  AND ((SELECT end_at FROM selected_period) IS NULL OR fact_date < (SELECT end_at FROM selected_period))
sql.Q004:
WITH selected_period AS (
    SELECT NULL::timestamp AS start_at, NULL::timestamp AS end_at
    /*TIME_BEGIN*/
    WHERE FALSE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT CAST(:start_date AS timestamp), CAST(:end_exclusive AS timestamp)
    /*TIME_END*/
), lines AS (
    SELECT i."new_ord_shipmentitemid" AS fact_id,
           COALESCE(s."new_shipping2_date", s."new_shipping_date")::timestamp AS fact_date,
           CASE WHEN NULLIF(btrim(s."new_shipping2_date"::text), '') IS NOT NULL THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE 'UNCOMPLETED' END AS d007,
           i."new_amount_base"::numeric AS amount_cny,
           COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY i."new_ord_shipmentitemid") AS fact_copies
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipmentitem_esb" i
    JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb" s
      ON s."new_ord_shipmentid" = i."new_ord_shipment_id"
    WHERE i."new_qty" > 0
      AND s."statecode" = 0
)
SELECT d007 AS "D007",
       to_char(fact_date, 'YYYYMM') AS "D008",
       CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0
                 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(amount_cny)
                 AND bool_and(fact_copies = 1)
            THEN SUM(amount_cny) / 100000000::numeric
       END AS "M00013"
FROM lines
WHERE ((SELECT start_at FROM selected_period) IS NULL OR fact_date >= (SELECT start_at FROM selected_period))
  AND ((SELECT end_at FROM selected_period) IS NULL OR fact_date < (SELECT end_at FROM selected_period))
GROUP BY d007, to_char(fact_date, 'YYYYMM')

WITH __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(name AS TEXT)) = 1 THEN MIN(CAST(name AS TEXT)) END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_owners AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(t.team_name) END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS t
    ON t.team_id = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(t.team_name), '') IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_products AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS new_product_typeid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)) = 1
      THEN MIN(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT))
    END AS new_accproducttype
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    v.*,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), owner_team.team_name) AS __x360_target_team_name_20261114
  FROM (
    SELECT
      raw.*,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY COALESCE(
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(raw.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''),
          CAST(raw.new_targetid AS TEXT)
        ), raw.new_year
        ORDER BY raw.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, raw.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS __x360_target_version_20261114
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_target_esb AS raw
    WHERE
      raw.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
  ) AS v
  LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS owned
    ON owned.team_id = CAST(v.owningteam AS TEXT)
  LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_owners AS owner_team
    ON owner_team.owner_id = CAST(v.ownerid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    v.__x360_target_version_20261114 = 1
), __x360_selected_prediction_request AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  /*TIME_BEGIN*/
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(:start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
    CAST(:end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP) /*TIME_END*/
), __x360_selected_prediction_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM __x360_selected_prediction_request
)
SELECT
  __x360_period_result.*
FROM (
  WITH requested AS (
    SELECT
      CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
      CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
    WHERE
      FALSE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      start_at,
      end_at
    FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
  ), bounds AS (
    SELECT
      MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
      MAX(end_at) AS end_at
    FROM requested
  ), __accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(accountid AS TEXT),
      CAST(new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS customer_level,
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(name AS TEXT)), '') AS customer_name
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb"
  ), __teams AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(teamid AS TEXT),
      CAST(name AS TEXT) AS team_name
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb"
  ), __owner_team_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
      t.team_name
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" AS tm
    JOIN __teams AS t
      ON t.teamid = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(t.team_name), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), __owner_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      owner_id,
      CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(team_name) END AS team_name
    FROM __owner_team_candidates
    GROUP BY
      owner_id
  ), __remaining_opportunity_source AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      opportunityid,
      ownerid,
      new_salesbg,
      new_accproducttype,
      new_accountlevel,
      parentaccountid,
      new_cellcapacity,
      new_cell_qty
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb"
  ), __opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(opportunityid AS TEXT),
      CAST(ownerid AS TEXT),
      CAST(new_salesbg AS TEXT) AS d002,
      CASE
        WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
        THEN '其他'
        WHEN CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS d003,
      CAST(new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS d005,
      CAST(parentaccountid AS TEXT)
    FROM __remaining_opportunity_source
  ), __shipment_items AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(i.new_ord_shipmentitemid AS TEXT) AS fact_id,
      CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
      CAST(i.new_qty AS DECIMAL) AS qty,
      CAST(i.new_productcode AS TEXT) AS product_code,
      CAST(s.new_account_id AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      COALESCE(
        NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(i.new_ord_salesorder_id AS TEXT)), ''),
        NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(s.new_salesorderid AS TEXT)), '')
      ) AS order_id
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipmentitem_esb" AS i
    JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb" AS s
      ON s.new_ord_shipmentid = i.new_ord_shipment_id
    CROSS JOIN bounds AS b
    WHERE
      i.new_qty > 0
      AND s.statecode = 0
      AND s.new_ord_shipmentid IS NOT NULL
      AND s.new_shipping2_date IS NOT NULL
      AND CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      AND (
        b.start_at IS NULL
        OR (
          CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) >= b.start_at
          AND CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) < b.end_at
        )
      )
  ), __selected_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      order_id
    FROM __shipment_items
    WHERE
      order_id IS NOT NULL
  ), __direct_order_links AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(so.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id,
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(so.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') AS opportunity_id
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" AS so
    JOIN __selected_orders AS requested
      ON requested.order_id = CAST(so.salesorderid AS TEXT)
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(so.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), __order_links AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      order_id,
      opportunity_id
    FROM __direct_order_links
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT),
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '')
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb" AS l
    JOIN __selected_orders AS requested
      ON requested.order_id = CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)
    WHERE
      NOT EXISTS(
        SELECT
          1
        FROM __direct_order_links AS d
        WHERE
          d.order_id = CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)
      )
  ), __order_dimension_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      link.order_id,
      link.opportunity_id,
      o.ownerid,
      o.d002,
      o.d003,
      teams.team_name
    FROM __order_links AS link
    LEFT JOIN __opportunities AS o
      ON o.opportunityid = link.opportunity_id
    LEFT JOIN __owner_team_candidates AS teams
      ON teams.owner_id = o.ownerid
  ), __order_dimensions AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      order_id,
      CASE
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT ownerid) = 1 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(ownerid)
        THEN MIN(ownerid)
      END AS owner_id,
      CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT d002) = 1 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(d002) THEN MIN(d002) END AS d002,
      CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT d003) = 1 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(d003) THEN MIN(d003) END AS d003,
      CASE
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) = 1 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(team_name)
        THEN MIN(team_name)
      END AS team_name
    FROM __order_dimension_candidates
    GROUP BY
      order_id
  ), __product_energy AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      CAST(p.productnumber AS TEXT) AS product_code,
      CASE
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT p.new_system_energy) = 1
        THEN MIN(CAST(p.new_system_energy AS DECIMAL))
      END AS energy_kwh
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_product_esb" AS p
    WHERE
      p.new_system_energy > 0
      AND EXISTS(
        SELECT
          1
        FROM __shipment_items AS i
        WHERE
          i.product_code = CAST(p.productnumber AS TEXT)
      )
    GROUP BY
      CAST(p.productnumber AS TEXT)
  ), __actual_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST('ACTUAL' AS TEXT) AS kind,
      i.fact_id,
      i.fact_date,
      i.qty * p.energy_kwh / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS value_gwh,
      (
        i.fact_id IS NULL OR p.energy_kwh IS NULL
      ) AS invalid,
      d.d002,
      d.d003,
      c.customer_level AS d005,
      c.customer_name AS d006,
      d.team_name AS d004
    FROM __shipment_items AS i
    JOIN __product_energy AS p
      ON p.product_code = i.product_code
    LEFT JOIN __order_dimensions AS d
      ON d.order_id = i.order_id
    LEFT JOIN __accounts AS c
      ON c.accountid = i.account_id
  ), __target_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      ranked.*
    FROM (
      SELECT
        CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT) AS target_id,
        t.new_year,
        CAST(t.new_account_id AS TEXT) AS account_id,
        CAST(t.new_marketing_center AS TEXT) AS d002,
        CAST(t.new_producttype_id AS TEXT) AS producttype_id,
        CAST(t.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
        CAST(t.owningteam AS TEXT) AS owning_team,
        t.new_month1_power,
        t.new_month2_power,
        t.new_month3_power,
        t.new_month4_power,
        t.new_month5_power,
        t.new_month6_power,
        t.new_month7_power,
        t.new_month8_power,
        t.new_month9_power,
        t.new_month10_power,
        t.new_month11_power,
        t.new_month12_power,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''), CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT)), t.new_year
          ORDER BY t.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, t.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS rn
      FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS t
      CROSS JOIN bounds AS b
      WHERE
        b.start_at IS NULL
        OR t.new_year BETWEEN CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM b.start_at) AS INT) AND CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM b.end_at - INTERVAL '1 MICROSECOND') AS INT)
    ) AS ranked
    WHERE
      ranked.rn = 1
  ), __product_types AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS producttype_id,
      CASE
        WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
        THEN '其他'
        WHEN CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS d003
    FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_products AS p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
  ), __target_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST('TARGET' AS TEXT) AS kind,
      t.target_id || ':' || CAST(v.month_no AS TEXT) AS fact_id,
      CASE
        WHEN t.new_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 9999
        THEN CAST(MAKE_DATE(CAST(t.new_year AS INT), v.month_no, 1) AS TIMESTAMP)
      END AS fact_date,
      CAST(v.power_kwh AS DECIMAL) / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS value_gwh,
      FALSE AS invalid,
      t.d002,
      COALESCE(pt.d003, '其他') AS d003,
      c.customer_level AS d005,
      c.customer_name AS d006,
      (
        SELECT
          CASE
            WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT c.__x360_target_team_name_20261114) = 1
            THEN MIN(c.__x360_target_team_name_20261114)
          END
        FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS c
        WHERE
          CAST(c.new_targetid AS TEXT) = CAST(t.target_id AS TEXT)
      ) AS d004
    FROM __target_latest AS t
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      VALUES
        (1, t.new_month1_power),
        (2, t.new_month2_power),
        (3, t.new_month3_power),
        (4, t.new_month4_power),
        (5, t.new_month5_power),
        (6, t.new_month6_power),
        (7, t.new_month7_power),
        (8, t.new_month8_power),
        (9, t.new_month9_power),
        (10, t.new_month10_power),
        (11, t.new_month11_power),
        (12, t.new_month12_power)
    ) AS v(month_no, power_kwh)
    CROSS JOIN bounds AS b
    LEFT JOIN __product_types AS pt
      ON pt.producttype_id = t.producttype_id
    LEFT JOIN __accounts AS c
      ON c.accountid = t.account_id
    WHERE
      t.target_id IS NOT NULL
      AND (
        b.start_at IS NULL
        OR (
          CASE
            WHEN t.new_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 9999
            THEN CAST(MAKE_DATE(CAST(t.new_year AS INT), v.month_no, 1) AS TIMESTAMP)
          END >= b.start_at
          AND CASE
            WHEN t.new_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 9999
            THEN CAST(MAKE_DATE(CAST(t.new_year AS INT), v.month_no, 1) AS TIMESTAMP)
          END < b.end_at
        )
      )
  ), __forecast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      ranked.fact_id,
      ranked.opportunity_id,
      ranked.fact_date,
      ranked.qty,
      ranked.energy_kwh
    FROM (
      SELECT
        CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS fact_id,
        CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
        CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
        CAST(m.new_shipforecast_qty AS DECIMAL) AS qty,
        CAST(m.new_singlepower AS DECIMAL) AS energy_kwh,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT), DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
          ORDER BY CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) DESC NULLS LAST, CAST(m.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) DESC NULLS LAST, CAST(m.modifiedon AS TIMESTAMP) DESC NULLS LAST, CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS __remaining_month_latest_rn
      FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb" AS m
      CROSS JOIN bounds AS b
      WHERE
        NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
        AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
        AND (
          b.start_at IS NULL
          OR (
            CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= b.start_at
            AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < b.end_at
          )
        )
    ) AS ranked
    WHERE
      ranked.__remaining_month_latest_rn = 1 AND ranked.fact_id IS NOT NULL
  ), __remaining_opp_energy_values AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
      END AS product_type,
      CAST(o.new_cellcapacity AS DECIMAL) AS cell_energy_kwh,
      CAST(o.new_cell_qty AS DECIMAL) AS cells_per_set
    FROM __remaining_opportunity_source AS o
    WHERE
      EXISTS(
        SELECT
          1
        FROM __forecast_rows AS f
        WHERE
          f.opportunity_id = CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)
      )
  ), __remaining_opp_energy_by_type AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      opportunity_id,
      CASE
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT product_type) = 1
        AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(product_type)
        AND COUNT(DISTINCT cell_energy_kwh) = 1
        AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(cell_energy_kwh)
        AND MIN(cell_energy_kwh) > 0
        THEN CASE
          WHEN MIN(product_type) = '电芯'
          THEN MIN(cell_energy_kwh)
          WHEN MIN(product_type) = 'PACK'
          AND COUNT(DISTINCT cells_per_set) = 1
          AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(cells_per_set)
          AND MIN(cells_per_set) > 0
          THEN MIN(cell_energy_kwh) * MIN(cells_per_set)
        END
      END AS alternative_unit_kwh
    FROM __remaining_opp_energy_values
    GROUP BY
      opportunity_id
  ), __remaining_converted AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      f.fact_id,
      f.opportunity_id,
      f.fact_date,
      f.qty,
      CASE WHEN f.energy_kwh > 0 THEN f.energy_kwh ELSE e.alternative_unit_kwh END AS unit_kwh
    FROM __forecast_rows AS f
    LEFT JOIN __remaining_opp_energy_by_type AS e
      ON e.opportunity_id = f.opportunity_id
  ), __forecast_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST('FORECAST' AS TEXT) AS kind,
      f.fact_id,
      f.fact_date,
      CASE
        WHEN f.qty = 0
        THEN CAST(0 AS DECIMAL)
        WHEN f.qty > 0 AND f.unit_kwh > 0
        THEN f.qty * f.unit_kwh / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL)
      END AS value_gwh,
      (
        f.qty IS NULL OR f.qty < 0 OR (
          f.qty > 0 AND f.unit_kwh IS NULL
        )
      ) AS invalid,
      o.d002,
      o.d003,
      o.d005,
      c.customer_name AS d006,
      teams.team_name AS d004
    FROM __remaining_converted AS f
    JOIN __opportunities AS o
      ON o.opportunityid = f.opportunity_id
    LEFT JOIN __accounts AS c
      ON c.accountid = o.parentaccountid
    LEFT JOIN __owner_teams AS teams
      ON teams.owner_id = o.ownerid
  ), facts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM __actual_facts
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      *
    FROM __target_facts
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      *
    FROM __forecast_facts
  ), checked AS (
    SELECT
      f.*,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY kind, fact_id) AS copies
    FROM facts AS f
  ), scoped AS (
    SELECT
      f.*,
      TO_CHAR(f.fact_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month_key
    FROM checked AS f
    WHERE
      f.fact_date IS NOT NULL
      /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D002*/ AND f.d002 IN (:product_lines) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D002*/
      /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D003*/ AND f.d003 IN (:product_types) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D003*/
      /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D004*/ AND f.d004 IN (:team_ids) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D004*/
      /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D005*/ AND (
        f.d005 IN (:customer_levels)
        OR (
          CASE f.d005
            WHEN '0'
            THEN '核心大客户'
            WHEN '1'
            THEN '战略大客户'
            WHEN '2'
            THEN '重要大客户'
            WHEN '3'
            THEN '一般客户'
            WHEN '4'
            THEN 'BG大客户'
            ELSE f.d005
          END
        ) IN (:customer_levels)
      ) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D005*/
      /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D006*/ AND f.d006 IN (:customer_ids) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/
  ), aggregated AS (
    SELECT
      f.month_key AS "YWLN_D044",
      CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(
          BOOL_OR(f.invalid OR f.copies > 1 OR f.fact_id IS NULL) FILTER(WHERE
            kind = 'ACTUAL'),
          FALSE
        )
        THEN NULL
        ELSE SUM(value_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
          kind = 'ACTUAL')
      END AS actual_gwh,
      SUM(value_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
        kind = 'TARGET') AS target_gwh,
      SUM(value_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
        kind = 'FORECAST'
        AND f.fact_id IS NOT NULL
        AND f.copies = 1
        AND NOT COALESCE(f.invalid, TRUE)) AS remaining_gwh
    FROM scoped AS f
    GROUP BY
      f.month_key
  )
  SELECT
    a."YWLN_D044" AS "YWLN_D044",
    a.actual_gwh AS "YWLN_M0006",
    a.target_gwh AS "YWLN_M0007",
    a.actual_gwh + COALESCE(a.remaining_gwh, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL)) AS "YWLN_M0011"
  FROM aggregated AS a
) AS __x360_period_result
sql.Q016:
WITH
__requested AS (
 SELECT NULL::timestamp AS start_at,NULL::timestamp AS end_at
 /*TIME_BEGIN*/ WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT CAST(:start_date AS timestamp),CAST(:end_exclusive AS timestamp) /*TIME_END*/
),
__bounds AS (SELECT MAX(start_at) AS start_at,MAX(end_at) AS end_at FROM __requested),
__order_raw AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT so.salesorderid::text AS salesorderid,so.ordernumber::text AS order_no,
 so.customerid::text AS customerid,so.opportunityid::text AS opportunityid,
 so.ownerid::text AS ownerid,so.new_amount::numeric AS order_amount,so.createdon::timestamp AS createdon
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" so CROSS JOIN __bounds b
 WHERE so.salesorderid IS NOT NULL AND so.statecode=0 AND so.createdon::timestamp<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
 AND (b.start_at IS NULL OR (so.createdon::timestamp>=b.start_at AND so.createdon::timestamp<b.end_at))
),
__orders AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT salesorderid,MIN(order_no) AS order_no,MIN(customerid) AS customerid,
 MIN(opportunityid) AS opportunityid,MIN(ownerid) AS ownerid,MIN(order_amount) AS order_amount,
 COUNT(*)>1 AS source_issue FROM __order_raw GROUP BY salesorderid
),
__line_raw AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT l.salesorderdetailid::text AS salesorderdetailid,l.salesorderid::text AS salesorderid,
 l.new_product_id::text AS new_product_id,l.lineitemnumber,l.new_opportunity_id::text AS new_opportunity_id,
 l.quantity::numeric AS quantity,l.new_productnumber::text AS product_code,l.uomid::text AS uom_id,l.requestdeliveryby::timestamp AS requestdeliveryby,
 l.modifiedon::timestamp AS modifiedon,l.new_effectivedate::timestamp AS new_effectivedate FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb" l
),
__line_ranked AS (
 SELECT l.*,DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY salesorderdetailid ORDER BY modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST) AS latest_rank
 FROM __line_raw l WHERE l.salesorderdetailid IS NOT NULL AND l.modifiedon<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
),
__line_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT salesorderdetailid,MIN(salesorderid) AS salesorderid,MIN(new_product_id) AS new_product_id,
 MIN(lineitemnumber) AS lineitemnumber,MIN(new_opportunity_id) AS new_opportunity_id,
 MIN(quantity) AS quantity,MIN(product_code) AS product_code,MIN(uom_id) AS uom_id,MIN(requestdeliveryby) AS requestdeliveryby,
 MIN(new_effectivedate) AS new_effectivedate,COUNT(*)>1 AS source_issue
 FROM __line_ranked WHERE latest_rank=1 GROUP BY salesorderdetailid
),
__active_lines AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT l.* FROM __line_latest l WHERE (l.new_effectivedate IS NULL OR l.new_effectivedate<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
 
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __orders o WHERE o.salesorderid=l.salesorderid)
),
__order_totals AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT salesorderid,SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity,
 BOOL_OR(source_issue OR quantity IS NULL OR quantity<0) OR SUM(quantity)<=0 AS quantity_issue,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(btrim(new_opportunity_id),''))=1 THEN MIN(NULLIF(btrim(new_opportunity_id),'')) END AS unique_opportunityid
 FROM __active_lines GROUP BY salesorderid
),
__day_raw AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT d.new_shipmentdetailid::text AS new_shipmentdetailid,d.new_salesorder_id::text AS new_salesorder_id,
 d.new_no,d.new_product_id::text AS new_product_id,d.new_shipment_date,
 d.new_shipmentdetail_monthinfoid::text AS new_shipmentdetail_monthinfoid,d.new_notshipped_qty,
 d.modifiedon::timestamp AS modifiedon,d.versionnumber,d.statecode,d.new_shipment_qty,d.new_dailyshipmentplan_iscreated
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_shipmentdetail_esb" d WHERE d.new_shipmentdetailid IS NOT NULL
),
__month_raw AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT m.new_shipmentdetail_monthinfoid::text AS new_shipmentdetail_monthinfoid,
 m.new_salesorderdetailid::text AS new_salesorderdetailid,m.modifiedon::timestamp AS modifiedon,m.statecode,m.new_alignstatus
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_shipmentdetail_monthinfo_esb" m
),
__shipment_header_source AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT s.new_ord_shipmentid,s.new_shipping2_date,s.statecode,s.modifiedon,s.new_salesorderid
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb" s
),
__shipment_item_source AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT i.new_ord_shipmentitemid,i.new_ord_shipment_id,i.new_ord_salesorder_id,i.new_seq,
 i.new_product_id,i.new_productcode,i.new_uom_id,i.new_qty,i.statecode,i.modifiedon,i.new_amount
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipmentitem_esb" i
),
__actual_header_distinct AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT new_ord_shipmentid::text AS shipment_id,new_shipping2_date::timestamp AS shipped_at,
 statecode,modifiedon::timestamp AS modified_at FROM __shipment_header_source
),
__actual_header_ranked AS (
 SELECT s.*,DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY shipment_id ORDER BY modified_at DESC NULLS LAST) AS latest_rank
 FROM __actual_header_distinct s WHERE shipment_id IS NOT NULL AND modified_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
),
__actual_headers AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT shipment_id,MIN(shipped_at) AS shipped_at,MIN(statecode) AS statecode,COUNT(*)>1 AS version_issue
 FROM __actual_header_ranked WHERE latest_rank=1 GROUP BY shipment_id
),
__actual_item_distinct AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT new_ord_shipmentitemid::text AS item_id,new_ord_shipment_id::text AS shipment_id,
 new_ord_salesorder_id::text AS order_id,new_seq::text AS seq_raw,new_product_id::text AS product_id,
 new_productcode::text AS product_code,new_uom_id::text AS uom_id,new_qty::numeric AS shipped_qty,
 statecode,modifiedon::timestamp AS modified_at FROM __shipment_item_source
),
__actual_item_ranked AS (
 SELECT i.*,DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY item_id ORDER BY modified_at DESC NULLS LAST) AS latest_rank
 FROM __actual_item_distinct i WHERE item_id IS NOT NULL AND modified_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
),
__actual_items AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT item_id,MIN(shipment_id) AS shipment_id,MIN(order_id) AS order_id,MIN(seq_raw) AS seq_raw,
 MIN(product_id) AS product_id,MIN(product_code) AS product_code,MIN(uom_id) AS uom_id,
 MIN(shipped_qty) AS shipped_qty,MIN(statecode) AS statecode,COUNT(*)>1 AS version_issue
 FROM __actual_item_ranked WHERE latest_rank=1 GROUP BY item_id
),
__actual_joined AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT i.*,s.shipment_id AS matched_header_id,s.shipped_at,s.statecode AS header_state,
 s.version_issue AS header_version_issue,
 CASE WHEN btrim(i.seq_raw) ~ '^[0-9]+([.]0+)?$' THEN btrim(i.seq_raw)::numeric END AS normalized_seq
 FROM __actual_items i JOIN __orders o ON o.salesorderid=i.order_id
 LEFT JOIN __actual_headers s ON s.shipment_id=i.shipment_id
),
__actual_eligible AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT * FROM __actual_joined WHERE statecode=0 AND header_state=0 AND shipped_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
),
__actual_matches AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT i.item_id,COUNT(l.salesorderdetailid) AS line_matches,
 MIN(l.salesorderdetailid) AS line_id,MIN(l.uom_id) AS line_uom_id
 FROM __actual_eligible i LEFT JOIN __line_latest l ON l.salesorderid=i.order_id
 AND l.lineitemnumber::numeric=i.normalized_seq
 AND (l.new_product_id=i.product_id OR NULLIF(btrim(i.product_code),'')=NULLIF(btrim(l.product_code),''))
 GROUP BY i.item_id
),
__actual_linked AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT i.*,m.line_matches,m.line_id,
 CASE WHEN NULLIF(btrim(i.uom_id),'') IS NULL OR NULLIF(btrim(m.line_uom_id),'') IS NULL THEN FALSE
 WHEN btrim(i.uom_id) ~* '^([0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}|[{][0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}[}])$' AND btrim(m.line_uom_id) ~* '^([0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}|[{][0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}[}])$'
 THEN btrim(i.uom_id)::uuid=btrim(m.line_uom_id)::uuid
 ELSE btrim(i.uom_id)=btrim(m.line_uom_id) END AS same_uom
 FROM __actual_eligible i JOIN __actual_matches m ON m.item_id=i.item_id
),
__actual_problem_rows AS (
 SELECT order_id,CASE WHEN version_issue OR header_version_issue THEN '发货版本冲突'
 WHEN line_matches<>1 THEN '发货明细无法唯一关联订单行'
 WHEN NOT same_uom THEN '发货与订单计量单位不一致或缺失'
 WHEN shipped_qty IS NULL THEN '实际发货数量缺失' END AS reason
 FROM __actual_linked
 WHERE version_issue OR header_version_issue OR line_matches<>1 OR NOT same_uom OR shipped_qty IS NULL
 UNION ALL
 SELECT order_id,CASE WHEN matched_header_id IS NULL THEN '发货明细找不到可用发货主表'
 WHEN version_issue OR header_version_issue THEN '发货版本冲突'
 ELSE '有效发货单缺实际发货时间' END AS reason
 FROM __actual_joined WHERE statecode=0 AND
 (matched_header_id IS NULL OR version_issue OR header_version_issue OR (header_state=0 AND shipped_at IS NULL))
),
__actual_bad_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT order_id,string_agg(DISTINCT reason,'、' ORDER BY reason) AS reason
 FROM __actual_problem_rows GROUP BY order_id
),
__actual_by_line AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT line_id,SUM(shipped_qty) AS net_shipped_qty,
 BOOL_OR(shipped_qty IS NULL OR version_issue OR header_version_issue OR NOT same_uom) AS source_issue
 FROM __actual_linked WHERE line_matches=1 GROUP BY line_id
),
__line_balances AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT l.salesorderdetailid AS line_id,l.quantity AS ordered_qty,
 COALESCE(s.net_shipped_qty,0) AS net_shipped_qty,b.reason AS actual_problem,
 l.source_issue OR COALESCE(s.source_issue,FALSE) OR b.order_id IS NOT NULL
 OR l.quantity IS NULL OR l.quantity<0 OR COALESCE(s.net_shipped_qty,0)<0
 OR COALESCE(s.net_shipped_qty,0)>l.quantity AS quantity_issue
 FROM __active_lines l LEFT JOIN __actual_by_line s ON s.line_id=l.salesorderdetailid
 LEFT JOIN __actual_bad_orders b ON b.order_id=l.salesorderid
),
__pending_by_line AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT line_id,CASE WHEN quantity_issue THEN NULL ELSE ordered_qty-net_shipped_qty END AS pending_qty,
 CASE WHEN quantity_issue THEN NULL ELSE net_shipped_qty END AS net_shipped_qty,
 quantity_issue,actual_problem,FALSE AS energy_product_issue,
 CASE WHEN quantity_issue OR ordered_qty-net_shipped_qty>0 THEN 1::bigint END AS plan_rows
 FROM __line_balances
),
__product_raw AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT DISTINCT p.productid::text AS productid FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_product_esb" p),
__line_base AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT l.salesorderdetailid AS line_id,l.salesorderid AS order_id,l.new_product_id AS product_id,
 l.quantity AS ordered_qty,l.requestdeliveryby AS due_at,l.requestdeliveryby::date AS due_date,l.source_issue AS line_issue,
 so.order_no,so.customerid,so.order_amount,so.source_issue AS order_issue,ot.total_quantity,ot.quantity_issue AS order_quantity_issue,
 NULL::text AS d002,NULL::text AS d003,NULL::text AS d005,so.ownerid AS owner_id,NULL::text AS d006,'否'::text AS anomaly_flag,p.pending_qty,p.net_shipped_qty,p.actual_problem,p.quantity_issue AS pending_quantity_issue,p.plan_rows,NULL::numeric AS unit_energy_kwh,FALSE AS product_issue

),
__line_base AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT l.salesorderdetailid AS line_id,l.salesorderid AS order_id,l.new_product_id AS product_id,
 l.quantity AS ordered_qty,l.requestdeliveryby AS due_at,l.requestdeliveryby::date AS due_date,l.source_issue AS line_issue,
 so.order_no,so.customerid,so.order_amount,so.source_issue AS order_issue,ot.total_quantity,ot.quantity_issue AS order_quantity_issue,
 o.d002,o.d003,a.customer_level AS d005,COALESCE(o.owner_id,so.ownerid) AS owner_id,so.customer_name AS d006,CASE WHEN COALESCE(o.d005 IN ('0','1','2') OR o.risk_level IN ('1','2'),FALSE) THEN '是' ELSE '否' END AS anomaly_flag,p.pending_qty,p.net_shipped_qty,p.actual_problem,p.quantity_issue AS pending_quantity_issue,p.plan_rows,pr.unit_energy_kwh,(pr.productid IS NULL OR pr.source_issue) AS product_issue
 FROM __active_lines l JOIN __orders so ON so.salesorderid=l.salesorderid
 JOIN __order_totals ot ON ot.salesorderid=l.salesorderid
 LEFT JOIN __pending_by_line p ON p.line_id=l.salesorderdetailid
 LEFT JOIN __product_energy pr ON pr.productid=l.new_product_id
 
 LEFT JOIN __opportunities o ON o.opportunityid=COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(l.new_opportunity_id),''),ot.unique_opportunityid,NULLIF(btrim(so.opportunityid),''))
 LEFT JOIN __accounts a ON a.customer_name=so.customer_name
),
__line_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT f.*,team.team_names AS d004,
 CASE WHEN due_at<CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 'overdue_pending' WHEN due_at>=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 'normal_pending' END AS status_code,
 CURRENT_DATE-due_date AS overdue_days,
 CASE WHEN NOT order_issue AND NOT line_issue AND NOT COALESCE(order_quantity_issue,TRUE)
 AND order_amount IS NOT NULL AND ordered_qty>=0 AND total_quantity>0
 THEN order_amount*ordered_qty/NULLIF(total_quantity,0) END AS allocated_order_amount,
 CASE WHEN NOT order_issue AND NOT line_issue AND NOT COALESCE(order_quantity_issue,TRUE)
 AND NOT COALESCE(pending_quantity_issue,FALSE) AND order_amount IS NOT NULL
 AND pending_qty>0 AND ordered_qty>0 AND pending_qty<=ordered_qty AND total_quantity>0
 THEN order_amount*pending_qty/NULLIF(total_quantity,0) END AS pending_amount,
 CASE WHEN NOT line_issue AND NOT COALESCE(pending_quantity_issue,FALSE) AND NOT product_issue
 AND pending_qty>0 AND (ordered_qty IS NULL OR pending_qty<=ordered_qty)
 THEN pending_qty*unit_energy_kwh END AS pending_energy_kwh
 FROM __line_base f LEFT JOIN __owner_teams team ON team.owner_id=f.owner_id
),
__line_scope AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT f.* FROM __line_facts f WHERE TRUE
AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __flt_YWLN_D002) OR (f.d002 IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D002)))
AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __flt_YWLN_D003) OR (f.d003 IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D003)))
AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __flt_YWLN_D004) OR (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __team_members tm WHERE tm.owner_id=f.owner_id AND (tm.team_name IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D004) OR tm.team_id IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D004)))))
AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __flt_YWLN_D005) OR (f.d005 IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D005) OR CASE f.d005 WHEN '0' THEN '核心大客户' WHEN '1' THEN '战略大客户' WHEN '2' THEN '重要大客户' WHEN '3' THEN '一般客户' WHEN '4' THEN 'BG大客户' ELSE f.d005 END IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D005)))
AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __flt_YWLN_D006) OR (f.d006 IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D006) OR f.customerid IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D006)))
AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __flt_YWLN_D045) OR (f.anomaly_flag IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D045)))

),
__pending_scope AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT f.* FROM __line_scope f WHERE f.plan_rows IS NOT NULL
 AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __x360_card_pending_filter)
      OR f.status_code IS NULL OR f.status_code IN (SELECT v FROM __x360_card_pending_filter))
 AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __x360_card_pie_filter)
      OR CASE f.status_code WHEN 'overdue_pending' THEN '超期订未发' WHEN 'normal_pending' THEN '正常订未发' END
         IN (SELECT v FROM __x360_card_pie_filter))
),
__totals AS (
 SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status_code='overdue_pending') AS overdue_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status_code='normal_pending') AS normal_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status_code IS NULL) AS missing_due_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status_code='overdue_pending' AND pending_amount IS NOT NULL) AS overdue_amount_valid_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status_code='normal_pending' AND pending_amount IS NOT NULL) AS normal_amount_valid_rows,
 SUM(pending_amount) FILTER(WHERE status_code='overdue_pending') AS overdue_amount,
 SUM(pending_amount) FILTER(WHERE status_code='normal_pending') AS normal_amount,
 SUM(pending_energy_kwh) FILTER(WHERE status_code='overdue_pending') AS overdue_energy
 FROM __pending_scope
),
__denominator AS (
 SELECT SUM(allocated_order_amount) FILTER(WHERE allocated_order_amount IS NOT NULL
 AND (plan_rows IS NULL OR (pending_amount IS NOT NULL AND status_code IS NOT NULL))) AS order_amount
 FROM __line_scope
)
SELECT CASE WHEN t.overdue_rows=0 AND t.normal_rows=0 AND t.missing_due_rows>0 THEN NULL WHEN t.overdue_rows=0 THEN 0::numeric ELSE t.overdue_energy/1000000::numeric END AS "M0134"
FROM __totals t CROSS JOIN __denominator d

sql.Q020:
WITH fact AS (
 SELECT
 i."new_ord_shipmentitemid" AS fact_id,
 s."new_shipping2_date"::timestamp AS shipped_at,
 i."new_amount_base" AS amount_cny,
 o."new_salesbg" AS product_line_code,
 CASE
 WHEN o."opportunityid" IS NULL THEN NULL
 WHEN o."new_accproducttype" IS NULL
 OR trim(o."new_accproducttype") = '' THEN 'OTHER'
 ELSE o."new_accproducttype"
 END AS product_type_code,
 o."new_accountlevel" AS customer_level_code,
 o."ownerid" AS owner_id,
 s."new_account_id" AS customer_id
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipmentitem_esb" i
 JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb" s
 ON s."new_ord_shipmentid" = i."new_ord_shipment_id"
 LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" so
 ON so."salesorderid" = s."new_salesorderid"
 LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" o
 ON o."opportunityid" = so."opportunityid"
 WHERE i."new_qty" > 0
 AND s."new_shipping2_date"::timestamp IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
 SUM(f.amount_cny) / 100000000::numeric AS "YWLN_M0001"
FROM fact f
WHERE 1 = 1
/*TIME_BEGIN*/
 AND f.shipped_at >= :start_date
 AND f.shipped_at < :end_exclusive
/*TIME_END*/
/*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D002*/
 AND f.product_line_code IN (:product_lines)
/*FILTER_END:YWLN_D002*/
/*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D003*/
 AND f.product_type_code IN (:product_types)
/*FILTER_END:YWLN_D003*/
/*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D004*/
 AND EXISTS (
 SELECT 1
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" tm
 JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb" t ON t."teamid" = tm."teamid"
 WHERE tm."systemuserid" = f.owner_id
 AND t."teamid" IN (:team_ids)
 )
/*FILTER_END:YWLN_D004*/
/*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D005*/
 AND f.customer_level_code IN (:customer_levels)
/*FILTER_END:YWLN_D005*/
/*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D006*/
 AND f.customer_id IN (:customer_ids)
/*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/
sql.Q021:
WITH __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(name AS TEXT)) = 1 THEN MIN(CAST(name AS TEXT)) END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_owners AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(t.team_name) END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS t
    ON t.team_id = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(t.team_name), '') IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_products AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS new_product_typeid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)) = 1
      THEN MIN(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT))
    END AS new_accproducttype
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    v.*,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), owner_team.team_name) AS __x360_target_team_name_20261114
  FROM (
    SELECT
      raw.*,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY COALESCE(
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(raw.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''),
          CAST(raw.new_targetid AS TEXT)
        ), raw.new_year
        ORDER BY raw.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, raw.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS __x360_target_version_20261114
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_target_esb AS raw
    WHERE
      raw.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
  ) AS v
  LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS owned
    ON owned.team_id = CAST(v.owningteam AS TEXT)
  LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_owners AS owner_team
    ON owner_team.owner_id = CAST(v.ownerid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    v.__x360_target_version_20261114 = 1
), __ont_request AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  /*TIME_BEGIN*/
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(:start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
    CAST(:end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP) /*TIME_END*/
), __ont_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM __ont_request
), __ont_accounts_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    a.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_accounts AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM __ont_accounts_ranked
  WHERE
    __ont_rn = 1
), __ont_opportunity_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_opportunity AS (
  SELECT
    o.*
  FROM __ont_opportunity_ranked AS o
  WHERE
    o.__ont_rn = 1
), __ont_forecast_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    m.*,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL), 0) / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS __ont_energy_mwh,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS m
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND m.new_accountdate IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      b.start_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= b.start_at
    )
    AND (
      b.end_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < b.end_at
    )
), __ont_forecast AS (
  SELECT
    m.*
  FROM __ont_forecast_ranked AS m
  JOIN __ont_opportunity AS o
    ON o.opportunityid = m.new_opportunity_id
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    m.__ont_rn = 1
    AND (
      o.createdon IS NULL
      OR CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) <= LEAST(
        COALESCE(b.end_at, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)),
        CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)
      )
    )
), __ont_owner_teams AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS ownerid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), '')) = 1
      THEN MIN(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), ''))
    END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb AS t
    ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
  GROUP BY
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)
), __x360_risk_selected_prediction_request AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    start_at,
    end_at
  FROM __ont_bounds
), __x360_risk_selected_prediction_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM __x360_risk_selected_prediction_request
)
SELECT
  __x360_risk_period_result.*
FROM (
  WITH __customer_target_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      ranked.*
    FROM (
      SELECT
        original.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY COALESCE(
            NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(original.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''),
            CAST(original.new_targetid AS TEXT)
          ), original.new_year
          ORDER BY original.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, original.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS __customer_target_rn
      FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS original
    ) AS ranked
    WHERE
      ranked.__customer_target_rn = 1
  )
  SELECT
    customer_target_result.*
  FROM (
    WITH __x360_gov_source_7 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT
        __x360_raw."new_targetid",
        __x360_raw."ownerid",
        __x360_raw."createdon",
        __x360_raw."statecode",
        __x360_raw."new_account_id",
        __x360_raw."new_marketing_center",
        __x360_raw."new_month1",
        __x360_raw."new_month10",
        __x360_raw."new_month11",
        __x360_raw."new_month12",
        __x360_raw."new_month2",
        __x360_raw."new_month3",
        __x360_raw."new_month4",
        __x360_raw."new_month5",
        __x360_raw."new_month6",
        __x360_raw."new_month7",
        __x360_raw."new_month8",
        __x360_raw."new_month9",
        __x360_raw."new_opportunity_id",
        __x360_raw."new_year",
        __x360_raw."new_month1_power",
        __x360_raw."new_month10_power",
        __x360_raw."new_month11_power",
        __x360_raw."new_month12_power",
        __x360_raw."new_month2_power",
        __x360_raw."new_month3_power",
        __x360_raw."new_month4_power",
        __x360_raw."new_month5_power",
        __x360_raw."new_month6_power",
        __x360_raw."new_month7_power",
        __x360_raw."new_month8_power",
        __x360_raw."new_month9_power",
        __x360_raw."new_target_type",
        __x360_raw."new_product_id",
        CAST(__x360_product_type."new_accproducttype" AS TEXT) AS "new_accproducttype"
      FROM (
        SELECT
          __x360_rank.*
        FROM (
          SELECT
            __x360_base.*,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
              PARTITION BY COALESCE(
                NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__x360_base.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''),
                CAST(__x360_base.new_targetid AS TEXT)
              ), __x360_base.new_year
              ORDER BY __x360_base.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, __x360_base.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
            ) AS version_rn
          FROM __customer_target_latest AS __x360_base
        ) AS __x360_rank
        WHERE
          __x360_rank.version_rn = 1
      ) AS __x360_raw
      LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_products AS __x360_product_type
        ON __x360_product_type."new_product_typeid" = __x360_raw."new_producttype_id"
    )
    SELECT
      *
    FROM (
      /* CUSTOMER_LEVEL_CODES_V1 */
      SELECT
        CASE CAST(view_rows."YWLN_D005" AS TEXT)
          WHEN '战略大客户'
          THEN '1'
          WHEN '战略客户'
          THEN '1'
          WHEN '重要大客户'
          THEN '2'
          WHEN '重要客户'
          THEN '2'
          WHEN '一般客户'
          THEN '3'
          WHEN 'BG大客户'
          THEN '4'
          WHEN 'BG客户'
          THEN '4'
          ELSE CAST(view_rows."YWLN_D005" AS TEXT)
        END AS "YWLN_D005",
        view_rows."YWLN_M0140",
        view_rows."YWLN_M0024",
        view_rows."YWLN_M0075",
        view_rows."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_ACTUAL_ENERGY",
        view_rows."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_TARGET_ENERGY"
      FROM (
        WITH __dashboard_combo_period AS (
          SELECT
            CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
            CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
          WHERE
            FALSE
          UNION ALL
          SELECT
            start_at,
            end_at
          FROM __x360_risk_selected_prediction_bounds
        ), __dashboard_customer_level_inputs AS (
          SELECT
            CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS value
          /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D005*/
          WHERE
            FALSE
          UNION ALL
          SELECT
            UNNEST(CAST(ARRAY[:customer_levels] AS TEXT[])) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D005*/
        ), __dashboard_combo_ywln_d005 AS MATERIALIZED (
          SELECT DISTINCT
            expanded.value
          FROM __dashboard_customer_level_inputs AS input
          CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
            VALUES
              (input.value),
              (
                CASE input.value
                  WHEN '核心大客户'
                  THEN '0'
                  WHEN '战略大客户'
                  THEN '1'
                  WHEN '重要大客户'
                  THEN '2'
                  WHEN '一般客户'
                  THEN '3'
                  WHEN 'BG大客户'
                  THEN '4'
                END
              ),
              (
                CASE input.value
                  WHEN '0'
                  THEN '核心大客户'
                  WHEN '1'
                  THEN '战略大客户'
                  WHEN '2'
                  THEN '重要大客户'
                  WHEN '3'
                  THEN '一般客户'
                  WHEN '4'
                  THEN 'BG大客户'
                END
              )
          ) AS expanded(value)
          WHERE
            expanded.value IS NOT NULL
        ), __dashboard_combo_ywln_d006 AS (
          SELECT
            CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS value
        ), __base_customer_metrics AS MATERIALIZED (
          WITH __grouped_metric_1 AS (
            WITH requested AS (
              SELECT
                CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
                CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
              WHERE
                FALSE
              UNION ALL
              SELECT
                CAST((
                  SELECT
                    start_at
                  FROM __dashboard_combo_period
                ) AS TIMESTAMP),
                CAST((
                  SELECT
                    end_at
                  FROM __dashboard_combo_period
                ) AS TIMESTAMP)
            ), bounds AS (
              SELECT
                MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
                MAX(end_at) AS end_at
              FROM requested
            ), measure_rows AS (
              SELECT DISTINCT
                CAST('m0' AS TEXT) AS measure_tag,
                CAST(f.fact_id AS TEXT),
                CAST(f.fact_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
                CAST((
                  1
                ) AS DECIMAL) / CAST(1 AS DECIMAL) AS metric_value,
                (
                  COALESCE(f.source_issue, FALSE) OR COALESCE((
                    FALSE
                  ), FALSE)
                ) AS invalid,
                (
                  FALSE
                ) AS poison_time,
                f.d002,
                f.d003,
                f.owner_id,
                f.d005,
                f.d006,
                f.status_code,
                CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS helmet_status
              FROM (
                SELECT
                  CAST(c.accountid AS TEXT) AS fact_id,
                  CAST(c.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
                  CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS d002,
                  CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS d003,
                  CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
                  CAST(c.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS d005,
                  NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(c.name AS TEXT)), '') AS d006,
                  CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS status_code,
                  FALSE AS source_issue
                FROM __ont_accounts AS c
                WHERE
                  c.accountid IS NOT NULL
              ) AS f
              WHERE
                TRUE
            ), checked AS (
              SELECT
                *,
                COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY measure_tag, fact_id) AS fact_copies
              FROM measure_rows
            ), scoped AS (
              SELECT
                f.*,
                CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS d004
              FROM checked AS f
              WHERE
                (
                  (
                    SELECT
                      start_at
                    FROM bounds
                  ) IS NULL
                  OR (
                    f.fact_date >= (
                      SELECT
                        start_at
                      FROM bounds
                    )
                    AND f.fact_date < (
                      SELECT
                        end_at
                      FROM bounds
                    )
                  )
                  OR f.poison_time
                )
                AND (
                  NOT EXISTS(
                    SELECT
                      1
                    FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d005
                    WHERE
                      value IS NOT NULL
                  )
                  OR (
                    f.d005 IN (
                      SELECT
                        value
                      FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d005
                    )
                  )
                )
                AND (
                  NOT EXISTS(
                    SELECT
                      1
                    FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d006
                    WHERE
                      value IS NOT NULL
                  )
                  OR (
                    f.d006 IN (
                      SELECT
                        value
                      FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d006
                    )
                  )
                )
            )
            SELECT
              f.d005 AS "YWLN_D005",
              (
                CASE
                  WHEN COALESCE(BOOL_OR(f.invalid) FILTER(WHERE
                    f.measure_tag = 'm0'), FALSE)
                  THEN NULL
                  ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT f.fact_id) FILTER(WHERE
                    f.measure_tag = 'm0')
                END
              ) AS "YWLN_M0075"
            FROM scoped AS f
            GROUP BY
              f.d005
          ), __grouped_metric_2 AS (
            WITH requested AS (
              SELECT
                CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
                CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
              WHERE
                FALSE
              UNION ALL
              SELECT
                CAST((
                  SELECT
                    start_at
                  FROM __dashboard_combo_period
                ) AS TIMESTAMP),
