      CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        VALUES
          (1, t.new_month1),
          (2, t.new_month2),
          (3, t.new_month3),
          (4, t.new_month4),
          (5, t.new_month5),
          (6, t.new_month6),
          (7, t.new_month7),
          (8, t.new_month8),
          (9, t.new_month9),
          (10, t.new_month10),
          (11, t.new_month11),
          (12, t.new_month12)
      ) AS v(month_no, amount_yuan)
      WHERE
        TRUE
    ), fact_versions AS (
      SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY kind, fact_id) AS id_copies
      FROM fact_distinct
    ), scoped AS (
      SELECT
        f.*,
        CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS d004
      FROM fact_versions AS f
      WHERE
        f.fact_date IS NOT NULL
        /*TIME_BEGIN*/ AND CASE
          WHEN f.kind IN ('TARGET')
          THEN f.fact_date >= DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', CAST(:start_date AS TIMESTAMP))
          ELSE f.fact_date >= CAST(:start_date AS TIMESTAMP)
        END
        AND CASE
          WHEN f.kind IN ('TARGET')
          THEN f.fact_date < CASE
            WHEN CAST(:end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
            THEN DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', CAST(:start_date AS TIMESTAMP)) + INTERVAL '1 YEAR'
          END
          ELSE f.fact_date < CAST(:end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)
        END
    
/*TIME_END*/
), aggregated AS (
      SELECT
        CASE
          WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
            kind = 'ACTUAL' AND fact_date < DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) = COUNT(amount_yuan) FILTER(WHERE
            kind = 'ACTUAL' AND fact_date < DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
          AND COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
            kind = 'ACTUAL' AND fact_date < DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) = COUNT(fact_id) FILTER(WHERE
            kind = 'ACTUAL' AND fact_date < DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
          AND NOT COALESCE(
            BOOL_OR(id_copies > 1) FILTER(WHERE
              kind = 'ACTUAL' AND fact_date < DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)),
            FALSE
          )
          AND COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
            kind = 'FORECAST') = COUNT(amount_yuan) FILTER(WHERE
            kind = 'FORECAST')
          AND COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
            kind = 'FORECAST') = COUNT(fact_id) FILTER(WHERE
            kind = 'FORECAST')
          AND NOT COALESCE(BOOL_OR(id_copies > 1) FILTER(WHERE
            kind = 'FORECAST'), FALSE)
          THEN CASE
            WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
              kind = 'ACTUAL' AND fact_date < DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) = 0
            AND COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
              kind = 'FORECAST') = 0
            THEN NULL
            ELSE COALESCE(
              SUM(amount_yuan) FILTER(WHERE
                kind = 'ACTUAL' AND fact_date < DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)),
              0
            ) + COALESCE(SUM(amount_yuan) FILTER(WHERE
              kind = 'FORECAST'), 0)
          END
        END AS expected_yuan,
        SUM(amount_yuan) FILTER(WHERE
          kind = 'TARGET') AS target_yuan
      FROM scoped AS f
    )
    SELECT
      expected_yuan / NULLIF(target_yuan, 0) AS "YWLN_M0005"
    FROM aggregated
  ) AS __x360_gov_result
) AS customer_target_result

WITH __ont_request AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  /*TIME_BEGIN*/
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(:start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
    CAST(:end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP) /*TIME_END*/
), __ont_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM __ont_request
), __ont_accounts_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    a.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_accounts AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM __ont_accounts_ranked
  WHERE
    __ont_rn = 1
), __ont_opportunity_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_opportunity AS (
  SELECT
    o.*
  FROM __ont_opportunity_ranked AS o
  WHERE
    o.__ont_rn = 1
), __ont_forecast_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    m.*,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL), 0) / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS __ont_energy_mwh,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS m
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND m.new_accountdate IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      b.start_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= b.start_at
    )
    AND (
      b.end_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < b.end_at
    )
), __ont_forecast AS (
  SELECT
    m.*
  FROM __ont_forecast_ranked AS m
  JOIN __ont_opportunity AS o
    ON o.opportunityid = m.new_opportunity_id
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    m.__ont_rn = 1
    AND (
      o.createdon IS NULL
      OR CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) <= LEAST(
        COALESCE(b.end_at, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)),
        CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)
      )
    )
), __ont_owner_teams AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS ownerid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), '')) = 1
      THEN MIN(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), ''))
    END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb AS t
    ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
  GROUP BY
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)
), __x360_signed_via_order_lines_20261113 AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(__sign_line.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunityid
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS __sign_line
  JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb AS __sign_order
    ON __sign_order.salesorderid = __sign_line.salesorderid
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__sign_line.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__sign_line.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND __sign_order.salesorderid IS NOT NULL
), __signed_order_source AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    (
      sx.opportunityid || ''
    ) AS opportunityid,
    (
      sx.salesorderid || ''
    ) AS salesorderid,
    (
      sx.new_salesorderid || ''
    ) AS new_salesorderid,
    sx.statecode,
    sx.new_changetype,
    sx.new_changestatus,
    sx.new_approval_time
  FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" AS sx
), __signed_keys_0 AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    opportunityid
  FROM __x360_signed_via_order_lines_20261113
), requested AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    start_at,
    end_at
  FROM __ont_bounds
), bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM requested
), measure_rows AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST('m0' AS TEXT) AS measure_tag,
    CAST(f.fact_id AS TEXT),
    CAST(f.fact_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
    CAST((
      f.amount_yuan
    ) AS DECIMAL) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS metric_value,
    (
      COALESCE(f.source_issue, FALSE)
      OR COALESCE((
        FALSE
      ), FALSE)
      OR (
        f.amount_yuan
      ) IS NULL
    ) AS invalid,
    (
      FALSE
    ) AS poison_time,
    f.d002,
    f.d003,
    f.owner_id,
    f.d005,
    f.d006,
    f.status_code,
    TO_JSONB(f) ->> 'helmet_status' AS helmet_status
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS fact_id,
      CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
      CAST(o.new_salesbg AS TEXT) AS d002,
      CASE
        WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL
        THEN NULL
        WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
        THEN '其他'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS d003,
      CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
      CAST(o.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS d005,
      (
        SELECT
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.name AS TEXT)), '')
        FROM __ont_accounts AS a
        WHERE
          CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) = CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT)
      ) AS d006,
      CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(o.opportunityid IN (
          SELECT
            opportunityid
          FROM __signed_keys_0
        ), FALSE)
        THEN 'signed_opportunity'
        ELSE 'unsigned_opportunity'
      END AS status_code,
      (
        SELECT
          CASE
            WHEN (
              TRUE
            )
            AND CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
            AND CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            AND (
              CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
              OR (
                CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP)
                AND CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
              )
            )
            AND p.enabled
            AND p.cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL
            THEN CASE
              WHEN CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
              AND CURRENT_DATE - CAST(o.createdon AS DATE) > p.cycle_target_days
              THEN 'overdue_uncompleted'
              WHEN CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
              AND p.cycle_target_days - (
                CURRENT_DATE - CAST(o.createdon AS DATE)
              ) BETWEEN 0 AND p.imminent_days
              THEN 'imminent_uncompleted'
              WHEN CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
              AND p.cycle_target_days - (
                CURRENT_DATE - CAST(o.createdon AS DATE)
              ) > p.imminent_days
              THEN 'normal_uncompleted'
              WHEN CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
              AND CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS DATE) - CAST(o.createdon AS DATE) > p.cycle_target_days
              THEN 'overdue_completed'
              WHEN CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
              AND CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS DATE) - CAST(o.createdon AS DATE) <= p.cycle_target_days
              THEN 'normal_completed'
            END
          END
        FROM (
          SELECT
            dimension_code,
            cycle_target_days,
            imminent_days,
            (
              cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL
              AND cycle_target_days >= 0
              AND imminent_days IS NOT NULL
              AND imminent_days BETWEEN 0 AND cycle_target_days
            ) AS enabled
          FROM (
            SELECT
              dimension_code,
              MAX(config_value) FILTER(WHERE
                config_key = REPLACE(dimension_code, 'YWLN_', '') || '_CYCLE_TARGET_DAYS') AS cycle_target_days,
              MAX(config_value) FILTER(WHERE
                config_key = REPLACE(dimension_code, 'YWLN_', '') || '_IMMINENT_DAYS') AS imminent_days
            FROM ded_public."x360_static_metric_config"
            WHERE
              config_set = 'MOCK'
              AND period_key = 'GLOBAL'
              AND config_group = 'HELMET'
              AND enabled
            GROUP BY
              dimension_code
          ) AS v
        ) AS p
        WHERE
          p.dimension_code = 'YWLN_D020'
      ) AS helmet_status,
      (
        CAST(o.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) IN ('1', '2')
        OR CAST(o.new_risklevel AS TEXT) IN ('1', '2')
      ) AS is_key,
      CAST((
        m.new_forecast_amt_rmb / NULLIF(m.new_whprice, 0) / 1000000
      ) AS DECIMAL) AS energy_mwh,
      m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS amount_yuan,
      TRUE AS amount_period_valid,
      FALSE AS source_issue
    FROM __ont_forecast AS m
    JOIN __ont_opportunity AS o
      ON o.opportunityid = m.new_opportunity_id
    WHERE
      m.new_oppmonthid IS NOT NULL
      AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
      AND TRUE
      AND TRUE
      AND TRUE
      AND TRUE
  ) AS f
  WHERE
    f.status_code = 'signed_opportunity' AND TRUE AND f.amount_yuan IS NOT NULL
), checked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY measure_tag, fact_id) AS fact_copies
  FROM measure_rows
), scoped AS (
  SELECT
    f.*,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS d004
  FROM checked AS f
  WHERE
    (
      (
        SELECT
          start_at
        FROM bounds
      ) IS NULL
      OR (
        f.fact_date >= (
          SELECT
            start_at
          FROM bounds
        )
        AND f.fact_date < (
          SELECT
            end_at
          FROM bounds
        )
      )
      OR f.poison_time
    )
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D002*/ AND  f.d002 IN (:product_lines) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D002*/
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D003*/ AND  f.d003 IN (:product_types) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D003*/
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D004*/ AND  EXISTS(
      SELECT
        1
      FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" AS tm
      JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb" AS t
        ON t."teamid" = tm."teamid"
      WHERE
        CAST(tm."systemuserid" AS TEXT) = f.owner_id
        AND CAST(t."name" AS TEXT) IN (:team_ids)
    ) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D004*/
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D005*/ AND  f.d005 IN (:customer_levels) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D005*/
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D006*/ AND  f.d006 IN (:customer_ids) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D015*/ AND  f.status_code IN (:sign_codes) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D015*/
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D020*/ AND  f.helmet_status IN (:status_codes) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D020*/
)
SELECT
  f.d005 AS "YWLN_D005",
  (
    SUM(f.metric_value) FILTER(WHERE
      f.measure_tag = 'm0')
  ) AS "YWLN_M0198"
FROM scoped AS f
GROUP BY
  f.d005

), __x360_selected_prediction_request AS (

  ), __accounts AS MATERIALIZED (

  ), __teams AS MATERIALIZED (

  ), __owner_teams AS MATERIALIZED (

    FROM __owner_team_candidates

  ), __remaining_opportunity_source AS MATERIALIZED (

      parentaccountid,

    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb"
  ), __opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(opportunityid AS TEXT),

      CAST(new_salesbg AS TEXT) AS d002,
      CASE
        WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
        THEN '其他'

  ), __order_links AS MATERIALIZED (

          d.order_id = CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)
      )
  ), __order_dimension_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      link.order_id,
      link.opportunity_id,
      o.ownerid,
      o.d002,
      o.d003,
      teams.team_name
    FROM __order_links AS link
    LEFT JOIN __opportunities AS o
      ON o.opportunityid = link.opportunity_id
    LEFT JOIN __owner_team_candidates AS teams
      ON teams.owner_id = o.ownerid
  ), __order_dimensions AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      order_id,
      CASE
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT ownerid) = 1 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(ownerid)
        THEN MIN(ownerid)
      END AS owner_id,
      CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT d002) = 1 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(d002) THEN MIN(d002) END AS d002,
      CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT d003) = 1 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(d003) THEN MIN(d003) END AS d003,
      CASE
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) = 1 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(team_name)
        THEN MIN(team_name)
      END AS team_name
    FROM __order_dimension_candidates
    GROUP BY
      order_id
  ), __product_energy AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      CAST(p.productnumber AS TEXT) AS product_code,
      CASE
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT p.new_system_energy) = 1
        THEN MIN(CAST(p.new_system_energy AS DECIMAL))
      END AS energy_kwh
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_product_esb" AS p
    WHERE
      p.new_system_energy > 0
      AND EXISTS(
        SELECT
          1
        FROM __shipment_items AS i
        WHERE
          i.product_code = CAST(p.productnumber AS TEXT)
      )
    GROUP BY
      CAST(p.productnumber AS TEXT)
  ), __actual_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST('ACTUAL' AS TEXT) AS kind,
      i.fact_id,
      i.fact_date,
      i.qty * p.energy_kwh / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS value_gwh,
      (
        i.fact_id IS NULL OR p.energy_kwh IS NULL
      ) AS invalid,
      d.d002,
      d.d003,
      c.customer_level AS d005,
      c.customer_name AS d006,
      d.team_name AS d004
    FROM __shipment_items AS i
    JOIN __product_energy AS p
      ON p.product_code = i.product_code
    LEFT JOIN __order_dimensions AS d
      ON d.order_id = i.order_id
    LEFT JOIN __accounts AS c
      ON c.accountid = i.account_id
  ), __target_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      ranked.*
    FROM (
      SELECT
        CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT) AS target_id,
        t.new_year,
        CAST(t.new_account_id AS TEXT) AS account_id,
        CAST(t.new_marketing_center AS TEXT) AS d002,
        CAST(t.new_producttype_id AS TEXT) AS producttype_id,
        CAST(t.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
        CAST(t.owningteam AS TEXT) AS owning_team,
        t.new_month1_power,
        t.new_month2_power,
        t.new_month3_power,
        t.new_month4_power,
        t.new_month5_power,
        t.new_month6_power,
        t.new_month7_power,
        t.new_month8_power,
        t.new_month9_power,
        t.new_month10_power,
        t.new_month11_power,
        t.new_month12_power,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''), CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT)), t.new_year
          ORDER BY t.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, t.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS rn
      FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS t
      CROSS JOIN bounds AS b
      WHERE
        b.start_at IS NULL OR t.new_year = CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM b.start_at) AS INT)
    ) AS ranked
    WHERE
      ranked.rn = 1
  ), __product_types AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS producttype_id,
      CASE
        WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
        THEN '其他'
        WHEN CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS d003
    FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_products AS p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
  ), __target_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST('TARGET' AS TEXT) AS kind,
      t.target_id || ':' || CAST(v.month_no AS TEXT) AS fact_id,
      CASE
        WHEN t.new_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 9999
        THEN CAST(MAKE_DATE(CAST(t.new_year AS INT), v.month_no, 1) AS TIMESTAMP)
      END AS fact_date,
      CAST(v.power_kwh AS DECIMAL) / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS value_gwh,
      FALSE AS invalid,
      t.d002,
      COALESCE(pt.d003, '其他') AS d003,
      c.customer_level AS d005,
      c.customer_name AS d006,
      (
        SELECT
          CASE
            WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT c.__x360_target_team_name_20261114) = 1
            THEN MIN(c.__x360_target_team_name_20261114)
          END
        FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS c
        WHERE
          CAST(c.new_targetid AS TEXT) = CAST(t.target_id AS TEXT)
      ) AS d004
    FROM __target_latest AS t
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      VALUES
        (1, t.new_month1_power),
        (2, t.new_month2_power),
        (3, t.new_month3_power),
        (4, t.new_month4_power),
        (5, t.new_month5_power),
        (6, t.new_month6_power),
        (7, t.new_month7_power),
        (8, t.new_month8_power),
        (9, t.new_month9_power),
        (10, t.new_month10_power),
        (11, t.new_month11_power),
        (12, t.new_month12_power)
    ) AS v(month_no, power_kwh)
    CROSS JOIN bounds AS b
    LEFT JOIN __product_types AS pt
      ON pt.producttype_id = t.producttype_id
    LEFT JOIN __accounts AS c
      ON c.accountid = t.account_id
    WHERE
      t.target_id IS NOT NULL
      AND (
        b.start_at IS NULL
        OR (
          CASE
            WHEN t.new_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 9999
            THEN CAST(MAKE_DATE(CAST(t.new_year AS INT), v.month_no, 1) AS TIMESTAMP)
          END >= DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', b.start_at)
          AND CASE
            WHEN t.new_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 9999
            THEN CAST(MAKE_DATE(CAST(t.new_year AS INT), v.month_no, 1) AS TIMESTAMP)
          END < CASE
            WHEN b.end_at IS NOT NULL
            THEN DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', b.start_at) + INTERVAL '1 YEAR'
          END
        )
      )
  ), __forecast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      ranked.fact_id,
      ranked.opportunity_id,
      ranked.fact_date,
      ranked.qty,
      ranked.energy_kwh
    FROM (
      SELECT
        CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS fact_id,
        CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
        CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
        CAST(m.new_shipforecast_qty AS DECIMAL) AS qty,
        CAST(m.new_singlepower AS DECIMAL) AS energy_kwh,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT), DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
          ORDER BY CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) DESC NULLS LAST, CAST(m.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) DESC NULLS LAST, CAST(m.modifiedon AS TIMESTAMP) DESC NULLS LAST, CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS __remaining_month_latest_rn
      FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb" AS m
      CROSS JOIN bounds AS b
      WHERE
        NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
        AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
        AND (
          b.start_at IS NULL
          OR (
            CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= b.start_at
            AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < b.end_at
          )
        )
    ) AS ranked
    WHERE
      ranked.__remaining_month_latest_rn = 1 AND ranked.fact_id IS NOT NULL
  ), __remaining_opp_energy_values AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
      END AS product_type,
      CAST(o.new_cellcapacity AS DECIMAL) AS cell_energy_kwh,
      CAST(o.new_cell_qty AS DECIMAL) AS cells_per_set
    FROM __remaining_opportunity_source AS o
    WHERE
      EXISTS(
        SELECT
          1
        FROM __forecast_rows AS f
        WHERE
          f.opportunity_id = CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)
      )
  ), __remaining_opp_energy_by_type AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      opportunity_id,
      CASE
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT product_type) = 1
        AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(product_type)
        AND COUNT(DISTINCT cell_energy_kwh) = 1
        AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(cell_energy_kwh)
        AND MIN(cell_energy_kwh) > 0
        THEN CASE
          WHEN MIN(product_type) = '电芯'
          THEN MIN(cell_energy_kwh)
          WHEN MIN(product_type) = 'PACK'
          AND COUNT(DISTINCT cells_per_set) = 1
          AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(cells_per_set)
          AND MIN(cells_per_set) > 0
          THEN MIN(cell_energy_kwh) * MIN(cells_per_set)
        END
      END AS alternative_unit_kwh
    FROM __remaining_opp_energy_values
    GROUP BY
      opportunity_id
  ), __remaining_converted AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      f.fact_id,
      f.opportunity_id,
      f.fact_date,
      f.qty,
      CASE WHEN f.energy_kwh > 0 THEN f.energy_kwh ELSE e.alternative_unit_kwh END AS unit_kwh
    FROM __forecast_rows AS f
    LEFT JOIN __remaining_opp_energy_by_type AS e
      ON e.opportunity_id = f.opportunity_id
  ), __forecast_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST('FORECAST' AS TEXT) AS kind,
      f.fact_id,
      f.fact_date,
      CASE
        WHEN f.qty = 0
        THEN CAST(0 AS DECIMAL)
        WHEN f.qty > 0 AND f.unit_kwh > 0
        THEN f.qty * f.unit_kwh / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL)
      END AS value_gwh,
      (
        f.qty IS NULL OR f.qty < 0 OR (
          f.qty > 0 AND f.unit_kwh IS NULL
        )
      ) AS invalid,
      o.d002,
      o.d003,
      o.d005,
      c.customer_name AS d006,
      teams.team_name AS d004
    FROM __remaining_converted AS f
    JOIN __opportunities AS o
      ON o.opportunityid = f.opportunity_id
    LEFT JOIN __accounts AS c
      ON c.accountid = o.parentaccountid
    LEFT JOIN __owner_teams AS teams
      ON teams.owner_id = o.ownerid
  ), facts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM __actual_facts
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      *
    FROM __target_facts
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      *
    FROM __forecast_facts
  ), checked AS (
    SELECT
      f.*,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY kind, fact_id) AS copies
    FROM facts AS f
  ), scoped AS (
    SELECT
      f.*,
      TO_CHAR(f.fact_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month_key
    FROM checked AS f
    WHERE
      f.fact_date IS NOT NULL
      /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D002*/ AND f.d002 IN (:product_lines) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D002*/
      /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D003*/ AND f.d003 IN (:product_types) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D003*/
      /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D004*/ AND f.d004 IN (:team_ids) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D004*/
      /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D005*/ AND (
        f.d005 IN (:customer_levels)
        OR (
          CASE f.d005
            WHEN '0'
            THEN '核心大客户'
            WHEN '1'
            THEN '战略大客户'
            WHEN '2'
            THEN '重要大客户'
            WHEN '3'
            THEN '一般客户'
            WHEN '4'
            THEN 'BG大客户'
            ELSE f.d005
          END
        ) IN (:customer_levels)
      ) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D005*/
      /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D006*/ AND f.d006 IN (:customer_ids) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/
  ), aggregated AS (
    SELECT
      f.d004 AS "YWLN_D004",
      CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(
          BOOL_OR(f.invalid OR f.copies > 1 OR f.fact_id IS NULL) FILTER(WHERE
            kind = 'ACTUAL'),
          FALSE
        )
        THEN NULL
        ELSE SUM(value_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
          kind = 'ACTUAL')
      END AS actual_gwh,
      SUM(value_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
        kind = 'TARGET') AS target_gwh,
      SUM(value_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
        kind = 'FORECAST'
        AND f.fact_id IS NOT NULL
        AND f.copies = 1
        AND NOT COALESCE(f.invalid, TRUE)) AS remaining_gwh
    FROM scoped AS f
    GROUP BY
      f.d004
  )
  SELECT
    a."YWLN_D004" AS "YWLN_D004",
    a.actual_gwh AS "YWLN_M0006",
    a.target_gwh AS "YWLN_M0007",
    a.actual_gwh + COALESCE(a.remaining_gwh, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL)) AS "YWLN_M0011"
  FROM aggregated AS a
) AS __x360_period_result

WITH __ont_request AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  /*TIME_BEGIN*/
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(:start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
    CAST(:end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP) /*TIME_END*/
), __ont_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM __ont_request
), __ont_accounts_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    a.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_accounts AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM __ont_accounts_ranked
  WHERE
    __ont_rn = 1
), __ont_opportunity_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_opportunity AS (
  SELECT
    o.*
  FROM __ont_opportunity_ranked AS o
  WHERE
    o.__ont_rn = 1
), __ont_forecast_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    m.*,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL), 0) / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS __ont_energy_mwh,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS m
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND m.new_accountdate IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      b.start_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= b.start_at
    )
    AND (
      b.end_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < b.end_at
    )
), __ont_forecast AS (
  SELECT
    m.*
  FROM __ont_forecast_ranked AS m
  JOIN __ont_opportunity AS o
    ON o.opportunityid = m.new_opportunity_id
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    m.__ont_rn = 1
    AND (
      o.createdon IS NULL
      OR CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) <= LEAST(
        COALESCE(b.end_at, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)),
        CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)
      )
    )
), __ont_owner_teams AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS ownerid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), '')) = 1
      THEN MIN(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), ''))
    END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb AS t
    ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
  GROUP BY
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)
), __x360_signed_via_order_lines_20261113 AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(__sign_line.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunityid
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS __sign_line
  JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb AS __sign_order
    ON __sign_order.salesorderid = __sign_line.salesorderid
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__sign_line.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__sign_line.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND __sign_order.salesorderid IS NOT NULL
), __x360_selected_prediction_request AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    start_at,
    end_at
  FROM __ont_bounds
), __x360_selected_prediction_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM __x360_selected_prediction_request
)
SELECT
  __x360_period_result.*
FROM (
  WITH fact_distinct AS (
    SELECT
      m."new_oppmonthid" AS fact_id,
      CAST(m."new_accountdate" AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
      CAST((
        m."new_forecast_amt_rmb" / NULLIF(m."new_whprice", 0) / 1000000
      ) AS DECIMAL) AS energy_value,
      CASE
        WHEN DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m."new_accountdate" AS TIMESTAMP)) < DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
        THEN m.new_forecast_amt_rmb
        ELSE m."new_forecast_amt_rmb"
      END AS amount_value,
      (
        (
          m."new_forecast_amt_rmb" / NULLIF(m."new_whprice", 0) / 1000000
        ) IS NULL
      ) AS energy_missing,
      CAST(o."new_salesbg" AS TEXT) AS d002,
      CASE
        WHEN o."new_accproducttype" IS NULL OR TRIM(CAST(o."new_accproducttype" AS TEXT)) = ''
        THEN '其他'
        WHEN CAST(o."new_accproducttype" AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o."new_accproducttype" AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS d003,
      o."ownerid" AS owner_id,
      CAST(o."new_accountlevel" AS TEXT) AS d005,
      (
        SELECT
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.name AS TEXT)), '')
        FROM __ont_accounts AS a
        WHERE
          CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) = CAST(o."parentaccountid" AS TEXT)
      ) AS d006,
      CASE
        WHEN EXISTS(
          SELECT
            1
          FROM __x360_signed_via_order_lines_20261113 AS __sign_match
          WHERE
            __sign_match.opportunityid = CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)
        )
        THEN 'signed_opportunity'
        ELSE 'unsigned_opportunity'
      END AS d015,
      (
        SELECT
          CASE
            WHEN (
              TRUE
            )
            AND o."opportunityid" IS NOT NULL
            AND CAST(o."createdon" AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
            AND CAST(o."createdon" AS TIMESTAMP) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            AND (
              CAST(o."new_stage5enddate" AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
              OR (
                CAST(o."new_stage5enddate" AS TIMESTAMP) >= CAST(o."createdon" AS TIMESTAMP)
                AND CAST(o."new_stage5enddate" AS TIMESTAMP) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
              )
            )
            AND p.enabled
            AND p.cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL
            THEN CASE
              WHEN CAST(o."new_stage5enddate" AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
              AND CURRENT_DATE - CAST(o."createdon" AS DATE) > p.cycle_target_days
              THEN 'overdue_uncompleted'
              WHEN CAST(o."new_stage5enddate" AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
              AND p.cycle_target_days - (
                CURRENT_DATE - CAST(o."createdon" AS DATE)
              ) BETWEEN 0 AND p.imminent_days
              THEN 'imminent_uncompleted'
              WHEN CAST(o."new_stage5enddate" AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
              AND p.cycle_target_days - (
                CURRENT_DATE - CAST(o."createdon" AS DATE)
              ) > p.imminent_days
              THEN 'normal_uncompleted'
              WHEN CAST(o."new_stage5enddate" AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
              AND CAST(o."new_stage5enddate" AS DATE) - CAST(o."createdon" AS DATE) > p.cycle_target_days
              THEN 'overdue_completed'
              WHEN CAST(o."new_stage5enddate" AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
              AND CAST(o."new_stage5enddate" AS DATE) - CAST(o."createdon" AS DATE) <= p.cycle_target_days
              THEN 'normal_completed'
            END
          END
        FROM (
          SELECT
            dimension_code,
            cycle_target_days,
            imminent_days,
            (
              cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL
              AND cycle_target_days >= 0
              AND imminent_days IS NOT NULL
              AND imminent_days BETWEEN 0 AND cycle_target_days
            ) AS enabled
          FROM (
            SELECT
              dimension_code,
              MAX(config_value) FILTER(WHERE
                config_key = REPLACE(dimension_code, 'YWLN_', '') || '_CYCLE_TARGET_DAYS') AS cycle_target_days,
              MAX(config_value) FILTER(WHERE
                config_key = REPLACE(dimension_code, 'YWLN_', '') || '_IMMINENT_DAYS') AS imminent_days
            FROM ded_public."x360_static_metric_config"
            WHERE
              config_set = 'MOCK'
              AND period_key = 'GLOBAL'
              AND config_group = 'HELMET'
              AND enabled
            GROUP BY
              dimension_code
          ) AS v
        ) AS p
        WHERE
          p.dimension_code = 'YWLN_D020'
      ) AS d020
    FROM (
      SELECT
        __latest."new_accountdate",
        __latest.new_forecast_amt_rmb,
        __latest."new_oppmonthid",
        __latest."new_opportunity_id",
        __latest."new_whprice"
      FROM (
        SELECT
          __raw."createdon",
          __raw."modifiedon",
          __raw."new_accountdate",
          __raw.new_forecast_amt_rmb,
          __raw."new_oppmonthid",
          __raw."new_opportunity_id",
          __raw."new_whprice",

        FROM __ont_forecast AS __raw
        WHERE

          AND (

            OR (

              AND CAST(__raw.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < (

  ), fact_versions AS (

  ), scoped AS (

      AND EXISTS(

      AND f.d020 IN (:status_codes) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D020*/
  )

  FROM scoped AS f

), __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS MATERIALIZED (

        PARTITION BY COALESCE(

          CAST(raw.new_targetid AS TEXT)

  LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_owners AS owner_team

), __ont_request AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,

    FALSE

), __ont_bounds AS (

    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,

), __ont_accounts_ranked AS (
  SELECT

      PARTITION BY a.accountid

    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a

    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_accounts AS (
  SELECT
    *

    __ont_rn = 1
), __ont_opportunity_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid

    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o

), __ont_opportunity AS (
  SELECT

), __ont_forecast_ranked AS (

    m.*,

    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (

      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST

), __ont_forecast AS (

), __ont_owner_teams AS (

  JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb AS t

  GROUP BY

)
SELECT

FROM (

  SELECT

        ranked.*
      FROM (

              NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(original.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''),
              CAST(original.new_targetid AS TEXT)
            ), original.new_year
            ORDER BY original.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, original.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
          ) AS __customer_target_rn
        FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS original
      ) AS ranked
      WHERE

    )
    SELECT

            (
              a.accountid || ''
            ) AS accountid,
            (
              a.name || ''
            ) AS name,

          FROM __ont_accounts AS a
        ), __dashboard_combo_period AS (

            CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,

          WHERE

        ), __dashboard_combo_ywln_d002 AS (

        ), __dashboard_combo_ywln_d003 AS (

          WHERE

          UNION ALL
          SELECT

        ), __dashboard_combo_ywln_d005 AS (

        ), __dashboard_combo_ywln_d006 AS (

          WHERE

          UNION ALL
          SELECT
            UNNEST(CAST(ARRAY[:customer_ids] AS TEXT[])) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/
        ), __team_month_source AS MATERIALIZED (

                  OR (

                    AND CAST(__raw.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < (

          WHERE

            AND (
              (

                )

        ), __team_opportunity_distinct AS MATERIALIZED (

        ), __customer_unique_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
          SELECT
            owner_id,
            CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_id) = 1 THEN MIN(team_id) END AS team_id
          FROM __team_members
          GROUP BY
            owner_id
        ), __grouped_metric_1 AS (

            ORDER BY
              (
                t.new_targetid || ''
              )
          ), monthly AS (

                WHEN CAST(t.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')

                ELSE '其他'
              END AS d003,
              CAST(acc_t.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS d005,

              CASE

                THEN MAKE_DATE(CAST(t.new_year AS INT), v.month_no, 1)
              END AS target_month,
              v.amount_yuan
            FROM source_rows AS t
            LEFT JOIN __account_once AS acc_t
              ON acc_t.accountid = t.new_account_id
            CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
              VALUES
                (1, t.new_month1),
                (2, t.new_month2),
                (3, t.new_month3),
                (4, t.new_month4),
                (5, t.new_month5),
                (6, t.new_month6),
                (7, t.new_month7),
                (8, t.new_month8),
                (9, t.new_month9),
                (10, t.new_month10),
                (11, t.new_month11),
                (12, t.new_month12)
            ) AS v(month_no, amount_yuan)
          ), scoped AS (
            SELECT
              m.*,
              (
                SELECT
                  CASE
                    WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT c.__x360_target_team_name_20261114) = 1
                    THEN MIN(c.__x360_target_team_name_20261114)
                  END
                FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS c

                  CAST(c.new_targetid AS TEXT) = CAST(m.new_targetid AS TEXT)
              ) AS d004
            FROM monthly AS m
            LEFT JOIN __customer_unique_teams AS team
              ON team.owner_id = m.owner_id
            CROSS JOIN LATERAL (

                COALESCE(
                  (
                    SELECT
                      CASE
                        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT owned_team.name) = 1
                        THEN MIN(CAST(owned_team.name AS TEXT))
                      END
                    FROM __customer_target_latest AS target_owner
                    JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb" AS owned_team

                    ))
                  )
                  AND m.target_month < CASE

                      SELECT

                      FROM __dashboard_combo_period
                    ) IS NOT NULL
                    THEN DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', (
                      SELECT
                        start_at
                      FROM __dashboard_combo_period
                    )) + INTERVAL '1 YEAR'
                  END
                )
              )
              AND (
                NOT EXISTS(
                  SELECT

                  WHERE

                )
                OR (
                  m.d002 IN (
                    SELECT
                      value
                    FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d002
                  )
                )
              )
              AND (
                NOT EXISTS(
                  SELECT
                    1
                  FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d003
                  WHERE
                    value IS NOT NULL
                )
                OR (
                  m.d003 IN (
                    SELECT
                      value
                    FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d003
                  )
                )
              )
              AND (
                NOT EXISTS(
                  SELECT
                    1
                  FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d004
                  WHERE
                    value IS NOT NULL
                )
                OR (
                  (

                      CASE

SELECT

FROM (

      ) AS "ownerid",
      (
        t."opportunityid" || ''
      ) AS "opportunityid"
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" AS t
  ), __narrow_inline_4 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      t."new_target_type",
      t."new_year",
      t."new_month10",
      (
        t."ownerid" || ''
      ) AS "ownerid",
      t."new_month1",

      t."statecode",
      t."new_month9",
      t."new_month11",
      t."new_month8",
      t."new_month6",
      t."new_month12",
      t."new_month3",
      (
        t."new_targetid" || ''
      ) AS "new_targetid",
      t."new_month7"
    FROM (
      SELECT
        __x360_rank.*
      FROM (
        SELECT
          __x360_base.*,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY COALESCE(
              NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__x360_base.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''),
              CAST(__x360_base.new_targetid AS TEXT)
            ), __x360_base.new_year
            ORDER BY __x360_base.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, __x360_base.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
          ) AS version_rn
        FROM __customer_target_latest AS __x360_base
      ) AS __x360_rank
      WHERE
        __x360_rank.version_rn = 1
    ) AS t
  ), __narrow_inline_5 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      (
        t."teamid" || ''
      ) AS "teamid",
      (
        t."systemuserid" || ''
      ) AS "systemuserid"
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" AS t
  ), __narrow_inline_6 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      (
        t."teamid" || ''
      ) AS "teamid",
      (
        t."name" || ''
      ) AS "name"
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb" AS t
  ), fact_distinct AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST('ACTUAL' AS TEXT) AS kind,
      i.new_ord_shipmentitemid AS fact_id,
      CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
      i."new_amount_base" AS amount_yuan,

      CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS d002,
      CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS d003,
      CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS d005
    FROM __narrow_inline_0 AS i
    JOIN __narrow_inline_1 AS s
      ON s.new_ord_shipmentid = i.new_ord_shipment_id

      i.new_qty > 0
      AND s.statecode = 0
      AND CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST('TARGET' AS TEXT) AS kind,
      CASE
        WHEN t.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
        THEN CAST(ROW(t.new_targetid, v.month_no) AS TEXT)
      END AS fact_id,
      CASE
        WHEN t.new_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 9999 AND t.new_year <> 0
        THEN MAKE_DATE(CAST(t.new_year AS INT), v.month_no, 1)
      END AS fact_date,
      v.amount_yuan,
      t.ownerid AS owner_id,
      CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS salesorder_id,
      CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS d002,
      CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS d003,
      CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS d005
    FROM __narrow_inline_4 AS t
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      VALUES
        (1, t.new_month1),
        (2, t.new_month2),
        (3, t.new_month3),
        (4, t.new_month4),
        (5, t.new_month5),
        (6, t.new_month6),
        (7, t.new_month7),
        (8, t.new_month8),
        (9, t.new_month9),
        (10, t.new_month10),
        (11, t.new_month11),
        (12, t.new_month12)
    ) AS v(month_no, amount_yuan)
    WHERE
      TRUE
  ), fact_versions AS (
    SELECT
      *,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY kind, fact_id) AS id_copies
    FROM fact_distinct
  ), __period_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM fact_versions AS f_pre
    WHERE
      f_pre.fact_date IS NOT NULL
      /*TIME_BEGIN*/ AND CASE
        WHEN f_pre.kind IN ('TARGET')
        THEN f_pre.fact_date >= DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', CAST(:start_date AS TIMESTAMP))
        ELSE f_pre.fact_date >= CAST(:start_date AS TIMESTAMP)
      END
      AND CASE
        WHEN f_pre.kind IN ('TARGET')
        THEN f_pre.fact_date < CASE
          WHEN CAST(:end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
          THEN DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', CAST(:start_date AS TIMESTAMP)) + INTERVAL '1 YEAR'
        END
        ELSE f_pre.fact_date < CAST(:end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)
      END
  
/*TIME_END*/
), __selected_order_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      salesorder_id
    FROM __period_facts
    WHERE
      kind = 'ACTUAL' AND salesorder_id IS NOT NULL
  ), __direct_order_opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      so.salesorderid AS salesorder_id,
      so.opportunityid
    FROM __narrow_inline_2 AS so
    JOIN __selected_order_ids AS requested
      ON requested.salesorder_id = so.salesorderid
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(so.opportunityid), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), __order_opportunity_links AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      salesorder_id,
      opportunityid
    FROM __direct_order_opportunities
    UNION
    SELECT
      CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT),
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '')
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb" AS l
    JOIN __selected_order_ids AS requested

        FROM __direct_order_opportunities AS direct_link
        WHERE
          direct_link.salesorder_id = CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)
      )
  ), __owner_team_names AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      tm.systemuserid AS owner_id,

    FROM __narrow_inline_5 AS tm
    JOIN __narrow_inline_6 AS t
      ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
  ), __actual_order_team_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      link.salesorder_id,
      link.opportunityid,
      CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(teams.team_id), '') IS NOT NULL THEN teams.team_id END AS team_id
    FROM __order_opportunity_links AS link
    LEFT JOIN __narrow_inline_3 AS o
      ON o.opportunityid = link.opportunityid
    LEFT JOIN __owner_team_names AS teams
      ON teams.owner_id = o.ownerid
  ), __actual_order_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      salesorder_id,
      COUNT(DISTINCT team_id) AS team_count,
      CASE
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_id) = 1 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(team_id)
        THEN MIN(team_id)
      END AS team_id
    FROM __actual_order_team_candidates
    GROUP BY
      salesorder_id
  ), scoped AS (
    SELECT
      f.*,
      CASE WHEN f.kind = 'ACTUAL' THEN actual_team.team_id ELSE target_team.team_id END AS d004
    FROM __period_facts AS f
    LEFT JOIN __actual_order_teams AS actual_team
      ON f.kind = 'ACTUAL' AND actual_team.salesorder_id = f.salesorder_id
    LEFT JOIN __owner_team_names AS target_team
      ON f.kind = 'TARGET' AND target_team.owner_id = f.owner_id
    WHERE
      TRUE
      /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D004*/ AND (
        CASE WHEN f.kind = 'ACTUAL' THEN actual_team.team_id ELSE target_team.team_id END
      ) IN (:team_ids)
  
/*FILTER_END:YWLN_D004*/
), aggregated AS (
    SELECT
      f.d004 AS "YWLN_D004",
      CASE
        WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
          kind = 'ACTUAL') = COUNT(amount_yuan) FILTER(WHERE
          kind = 'ACTUAL')
        AND COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
          kind = 'ACTUAL') = COUNT(fact_id) FILTER(WHERE
          kind = 'ACTUAL')
        AND NOT COALESCE(BOOL_OR(id_copies > 1) FILTER(WHERE
          kind = 'ACTUAL'), FALSE)
        THEN SUM(amount_yuan) FILTER(WHERE
          kind = 'ACTUAL')
      END AS numerator_yuan,
      SUM(amount_yuan) FILTER(WHERE
        kind = 'TARGET') AS target_yuan
    FROM scoped AS f
    GROUP BY
      f.d004
  )
  SELECT
    "YWLN_D004",
    numerator_yuan / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS "YWLN_M0001",
    target_yuan / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS "YWLN_M0002",
    numerator_yuan / NULLIF(target_yuan, 0) AS "YWLN_M0003"
  FROM aggregated
) AS customer_target_result

 ,od.order_no,od.customer_id,od.d002,od.d003,od.owner_id,od.d005,od.customer_level_code,od.anomaly_flag,od.d006,

   ORDER BY d.modifiedon::timestamp DESC NULLS LAST,d.versionnumber DESC NULLS LAST,d.new_shipmentdetailid DESC) AS rn

month_selected AS NOT MATERIALIZED (

 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_shipmentdetail_monthinfo_esb" m CROSS JOIN observation p
 WHERE m.statecode=0 AND m.modifiedon::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND m.modifiedon::date<=p.cutoff
), line_selected AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT l.salesorderdetailid,l.salesorderid,l.requestdeliveryby,l.new_product_type,l.new_price_unit
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb" l CROSS JOIN observation p
 WHERE l.modifiedon::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND l.modifiedon::date<=p.cutoff
 AND (l.new_effectivedate::timestamp IS NULL OR l.new_effectivedate::date<=p.cutoff)
 AND (l.new_expirydate::timestamp IS NULL OR l.new_expirydate::date>p.cutoff)
), facts AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT d.new_shipmentdetailid AS fact_id,d.new_notshipped_qty AS pending_qty,
 d.order_no,d.customer_id,d.d002,d.d003,d.owner_id,d.d005,d.customer_level_code,d.anomaly_flag,d.d006,
 l.requestdeliveryby,p.cutoff,1::bigint AS copies,
 CASE WHEN l.requestdeliveryby::date<p.cutoff THEN 'overdue_pending' WHEN l.requestdeliveryby::date>=p.cutoff THEN 'normal_pending' END AS status_code,
 d.new_notshipped_qty*(CASE WHEN l.new_product_type::text ~ '^[+-]?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN l.new_product_type::numeric END)*(CASE WHEN l.new_price_unit::text ~ '^[+-]?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN l.new_price_unit::numeric END) AS amount_yuan,
 CURRENT_DATE-l.requestdeliveryby::date AS overdue_days,
 (l.salesorderdetailid IS NULL OR pr.productid IS NULL) AS source_issue
 FROM pending_day d CROSS JOIN observation p
 LEFT JOIN month_selected m ON m.new_shipmentdetail_monthinfoid=d.new_shipmentdetail_monthinfoid
 LEFT JOIN line_selected l ON l.salesorderdetailid=m.new_salesorderdetailid AND l.salesorderid=d.new_salesorder_id
 LEFT JOIN __x360_gov_source_9 pr ON pr.productid=d.new_product_id
)

, metric_facts AS (SELECT * FROM facts WHERE status_code='overdue_pending')
, team_labels AS MATERIALIZED (

)

sql.Q087:
WITH __ont_request AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  /*TIME_BEGIN*/
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(:start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
    CAST(:end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP) /*TIME_END*/
), __ont_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM __ont_request
), __ont_accounts_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    a.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_accounts AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM __ont_accounts_ranked
  WHERE
    __ont_rn = 1
), __ont_opportunity_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_opportunity AS (
  SELECT
    o.*
  FROM __ont_opportunity_ranked AS o
  WHERE
    o.__ont_rn = 1
), __ont_forecast_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    m.*,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL), 0) / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS __ont_energy_mwh,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS m
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND m.new_accountdate IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      b.start_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= b.start_at
    )
    AND (
      b.end_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < b.end_at
    )
), __ont_forecast AS (
  SELECT
    m.*
  FROM __ont_forecast_ranked AS m
  JOIN __ont_opportunity AS o
    ON o.opportunityid = m.new_opportunity_id
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    m.__ont_rn = 1
    AND (
      o.createdon IS NULL
      OR CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) <= LEAST(
        COALESCE(b.end_at, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)),
        CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)
      )
    )
), __ont_owner_teams AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS ownerid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), '')) = 1
      THEN MIN(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), ''))
    END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb AS t
    ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
  GROUP BY
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)
), __x360_signed_via_order_lines_20261113 AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(__sign_line.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunityid
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS __sign_line
  JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb AS __sign_order
    ON __sign_order.salesorderid = __sign_line.salesorderid
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__sign_line.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__sign_line.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND __sign_order.salesorderid IS NOT NULL
), __x360_selected_prediction_request AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    start_at,
    end_at
  FROM __ont_bounds
), __x360_selected_prediction_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM __x360_selected_prediction_request
)
SELECT
  __x360_period_result.*
FROM (
  WITH requested_period AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
      CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
    WHERE
      FALSE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      start_at,
      end_at
    FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
  ), requested_product_lines AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      CAST(NULL AS TEXT[]) AS items
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D002*/
    WHERE
      FALSE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      CAST(ARRAY[:product_lines] AS TEXT[]) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D002*/
  ), requested_product_types AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      CAST(NULL AS TEXT[]) AS items
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D003*/
    WHERE
      FALSE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      CAST(ARRAY[:product_types] AS TEXT[]) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D003*/
  ), requested_team_ids AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      CAST(NULL AS TEXT[]) AS items
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D004*/
    WHERE
      FALSE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      CAST(ARRAY[:team_ids] AS TEXT[]) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D004*/
  ), requested_customer_levels AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      CAST(NULL AS TEXT[]) AS items
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D005*/
    WHERE
      FALSE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      CAST(ARRAY[:customer_levels] AS TEXT[]) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D005*/
  ), requested_customer_ids AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      CAST(NULL AS TEXT[]) AS items
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D006*/
    WHERE
      FALSE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      CAST(ARRAY[:customer_ids] AS TEXT[]) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/
  ), requested_filters AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      pl.items AS product_lines,
      pt.items AS product_types,
      tm.items AS team_ids,
      cl.items AS customer_levels,
      cu.items AS customer_ids
    FROM requested_product_lines AS pl
    CROSS JOIN requested_product_types AS pt
    CROSS JOIN requested_team_ids AS tm
    CROSS JOIN requested_customer_levels AS cl
    CROSS JOIN requested_customer_ids AS cu
  ), opportunity_source_once AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      (
        o.opportunityid || ''
      ) AS opportunityid,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time,
      (
        o.ownerid || ''
      ) AS ownerid,
      (
        o.new_salesbg || ''
      ) AS new_salesbg,
      (
        o.new_accproducttype || ''
      ) AS new_accproducttype,
      (
        o.new_accountlevel || ''
      ) AS new_accountlevel,
      (
        o.parentaccountidname || ''
      ) AS parentaccountidname,
      o.new_opportunitystatus,
      o.new_approvalstatus
    FROM __ont_opportunity AS o
    WHERE
      o.opportunityid IS NOT NULL
  ), month_source_once AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      (
        m.new_oppmonthid || ''
      ) AS new_oppmonthid,
      (
        m.new_opportunity_id || ''
      ) AS new_opportunity_id,
      CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
      m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS metric_value
    FROM (
      SELECT
        __latest."new_accountdate",
        __latest."new_forecast_amt_rmb",
        __latest."new_month",
        __latest."new_oppmonthid",
        __latest."new_opportunity_id",
        __latest."new_year"
      FROM (
        SELECT
          __raw."createdon",
          __raw."modifiedon",
          __raw."new_accountdate",
          __raw."new_forecast_amt_rmb",
          __raw."new_month",
          __raw."new_oppmonthid",
          __raw."new_opportunity_id",
          __raw."new_year",
          1 AS __x360_period_latest_rn
        FROM __ont_forecast AS __raw
        WHERE
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__raw.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
          AND CAST(__raw.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
          AND (
            (
              SELECT
                start_at
              FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
            ) IS NULL
            OR (
              CAST(__raw.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= (
                SELECT
                  start_at
                FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
              )
              AND CAST(__raw.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < (
                SELECT
                  end_at
                FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
              )
            )
          )
      ) AS __latest
      WHERE
        __latest.__x360_period_latest_rn = 1
    ) AS m
    WHERE
      m.new_oppmonthid IS NOT NULL
      AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
      AND TRUE
      AND TRUE
  ), candidate_opportunity_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    /* Filter source opportunities on every static dimension before selecting fact IDs. */
    SELECT DISTINCT
      o.opportunityid
    FROM opportunity_source_once AS o
    CROSS JOIN requested_filters AS r
    WHERE
      o.opportunityid IS NOT NULL
      AND (
        r.product_lines IS NULL OR CAST(o.new_salesbg AS TEXT) = ANY(
          r.product_lines
        )
      )
      AND (
        r.product_types IS NULL
        OR (
          CASE
            WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
            THEN '其他'
            WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
            THEN '电芯'
            WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
            THEN 'PACK'
            ELSE '其他'
          END
        ) = ANY(
          r.product_types
        )
      )
      AND (
        r.team_ids IS NULL
        OR EXISTS(
          SELECT
            1
          FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" AS tm
          JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb" AS t
            ON t."teamid" = tm."teamid"
          WHERE
            tm."systemuserid" = o.ownerid AND CAST(t."name" AS TEXT) = ANY(
              r.team_ids
            )
        )
      )
      AND (
        r.customer_levels IS NULL
        OR CAST(o.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) = ANY(
          r.customer_levels
        )
        OR (
          CASE CAST(o.new_accountlevel AS TEXT)
            WHEN '0'
            THEN '核心大客户'
            WHEN '1'
            THEN '战略大客户'
            WHEN '2'
            THEN '重要大客户'
            WHEN '3'
            THEN '一般客户'
            WHEN '4'
            THEN 'BG大客户'
            WHEN '战略大客户'
            THEN '战略大客户'
            WHEN '重要大客户'
            THEN '重要大客户'
            WHEN '一般客户'
            THEN '一般客户'
            WHEN 'BG大客户'
            THEN 'BG大客户'
          END
        ) = ANY(
          r.customer_levels
        )
      )
      AND (
        r.customer_ids IS NULL
        OR NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.parentaccountidname AS TEXT)), '') = ANY(
          r.customer_ids
        )
      )
  ), candidate_fact_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    /* Apply period and eligibility at the monthly source, before version windows. */
    SELECT DISTINCT
      m.new_oppmonthid AS fact_id
    FROM month_source_once AS m
    JOIN candidate_opportunity_ids AS o
      ON o.opportunityid = m.new_opportunity_id
    CROSS JOIN requested_period AS p
    WHERE
      m.new_oppmonthid IS NOT NULL
      AND m.fact_date IS NOT NULL
      AND (
        m.metric_value
      ) IS NOT NULL
      AND (
        p.start_at IS NULL OR (
          m.fact_date >= p.start_at AND m.fact_date < p.end_at
        )
      )
  ), month_scope AS MATERIALIZED (
    /* Only candidate primary keys are expanded to all eligible versions. */
    /* Conflicting versions outside the requested period still poison this fact ID. */
    SELECT DISTINCT
      m.new_oppmonthid AS fact_id,
      m.new_opportunity_id AS opportunityid,
      m.fact_date AS fact_date,
      m.metric_value AS metric_value
    FROM month_source_once AS m
    JOIN candidate_fact_ids AS c
      ON c.fact_id = m.new_oppmonthid
    WHERE
      m.new_oppmonthid IS NOT NULL
      AND m.fact_date IS NOT NULL
      AND (
        m.metric_value
      ) IS NOT NULL
  ), opportunity_month_bridge AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      o.*,
      candidate.opportunityid AS selected_opportunityid
    FROM opportunity_source_once AS o
    FULL JOIN (
      SELECT DISTINCT
        opportunityid
      FROM month_scope
    ) AS candidate
      ON candidate.opportunityid = o.opportunityid
  ), opportunity_distinct AS MATERIALIZED (
    /* Load all valid versions for the selected opportunity keys, never pick one. */
    SELECT DISTINCT
      o.opportunityid,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS approved_time,
      CAST(o.new_salesbg AS TEXT) AS d002,
      CASE
        WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
        THEN '其他'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS d003,
      o.ownerid AS owner_id,
      CAST(o.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS d005,
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.parentaccountidname AS TEXT)), '') AS d006
    FROM opportunity_month_bridge AS o
    CROSS JOIN requested_filters AS r
    WHERE
      o.selected_opportunityid IS NOT NULL
      AND o.opportunityid IS NOT NULL
      AND (
        r.product_types IS NULL
        OR (
          CASE
            WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
            THEN '其他'
            WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
            THEN '电芯'
            WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
            THEN 'PACK'
            ELSE '其他'
          END
        ) = ANY(
          r.product_types
        )
      )
  ), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      o.*,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY o.opportunityid) AS source_copies
    FROM opportunity_distinct AS o
  ), fact_distinct AS MATERIALIZED (
    /* A primary key pointing to different opportunities is a grain conflict. */
    SELECT DISTINCT
      m.fact_id,
      m.opportunityid,
      m.fact_date,
      m.metric_value,
      o.source_copies,
      o.d002,
      o.d003,
      o.owner_id,
      o.d005,
      o.d006
    FROM month_scope AS m
    JOIN opportunities AS o
      ON o.opportunityid = m.opportunityid
  ), metric_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      f.*,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY f.fact_id) AS fact_copies
    FROM fact_distinct AS f
  ), scoped_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
    /* Reapply display scope after global versions of candidate keys are checked. */
    SELECT
      f.*
    FROM metric_facts AS f
    CROSS JOIN requested_period AS p
    CROSS JOIN requested_filters AS r
    WHERE
      (
        p.start_at IS NULL OR (
          f.fact_date >= p.start_at AND f.fact_date < p.end_at
        )
      )
      AND (
        r.product_lines IS NULL OR f.d002 = ANY(
          r.product_lines
        )
      )
      AND (
        r.product_types IS NULL OR f.d003 = ANY(
          r.product_types
        )
      )
      AND (
        r.team_ids IS NULL
        OR EXISTS(
          SELECT
            1
          FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" AS tm
          JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb" AS t
            ON t."teamid" = tm."teamid"
          WHERE
            tm."systemuserid" = f.owner_id AND CAST(t."name" AS TEXT) = ANY(
              r.team_ids
            )
        )
      )
      AND (
        r.customer_levels IS NULL
        OR CAST(f.d005 AS TEXT) = ANY(
          r.customer_levels
        )
        OR (
          CASE CAST(f.d005 AS TEXT)
            WHEN '0'
            THEN '核心大客户'
            WHEN '1'
            THEN '战略大客户'
            WHEN '2'
            THEN '重要大客户'
            WHEN '3'
            THEN '一般客户'
            WHEN '4'
            THEN 'BG大客户'
            WHEN '战略大客户'
            THEN '战略大客户'
            WHEN '重要大客户'
            THEN '重要大客户'
            WHEN '一般客户'
            THEN '一般客户'
            WHEN 'BG大客户'
            THEN 'BG大客户'
          END
        ) = ANY(
          r.customer_levels
        )
      )
      AND (
        r.customer_ids IS NULL OR CAST(f.d006 AS TEXT) = ANY(
          r.customer_ids
        )
      )
  ), selected_facts AS (
    SELECT
      f.*
    FROM scoped_facts AS f
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D015*/
    WHERE
      FALSE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      signed_scope.*
    FROM (
      WITH sign_order_source_once AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT
          (
            ord_line.new_opportunity_id || ''
          ) AS opportunityid,
          (
            so.salesorderid || ''
          ) AS salesorderid,
          (
            so.new_salesorderid || ''
          ) AS new_salesorderid,
          so.statecode,
          so.new_changetype,
          so.new_changestatus,
          so.new_approval_time,
          so.new_ord_oa_state,
          so.new_salesordertype,
          so.new_order_category
        FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" AS so
        JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb" AS ord_line
          ON ord_line.salesorderid = so.salesorderid
          AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(ord_line.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
      ), sign_cancel_rows_once AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT
          so.*
        FROM sign_order_source_once AS so
        WHERE
          so.salesorderid <> so.new_salesorderid AND so.new_changestatus = '8'
      ), sign_order_opportunity_bridge AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT
          so.*,
          c.opportunityid AS selected_opportunityid
        FROM sign_order_source_once AS so
        FULL JOIN (
          SELECT DISTINCT
            opportunityid
          FROM scoped_facts
        ) AS c
          ON c.opportunityid = so.opportunityid
      ), candidate_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
        /* Only rendered when sign_statuses is present, orders never multiply facts. */
        SELECT
          (
            so.opportunityid || ''
          ) AS opportunityid,
          (
            so.salesorderid || ''
          ) AS salesorderid,
          so.statecode,
          so.new_changetype,
          so.new_changestatus,
          so.new_approval_time
        FROM sign_order_opportunity_bridge AS so
        WHERE
          so.selected_opportunityid IS NOT NULL AND so.salesorderid IS NOT NULL
      ), cancelled_order_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT DISTINCT
          cx.new_salesorderid AS salesorderid
        FROM sign_cancel_rows_once AS cx
        WHERE
          cx.salesorderid <> cx.new_salesorderid AND cx.new_changestatus = '8'
      ), signed_opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT
          opportunityid
        FROM __x360_signed_via_order_lines_20261113
      ), signed_scope_bridge AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT
          f.*,
          s.opportunityid AS signed_opportunityid
        FROM scoped_facts AS f
        FULL JOIN signed_opportunities AS s
          ON s.opportunityid = f.opportunityid
      )
      SELECT
        f.fact_id,
        f.opportunityid,
        f.fact_date,
        f.metric_value,
        f.source_copies,
        f.d002,
        f.d003,
        f.owner_id,
        f.d005,
        f.d006,
        f.fact_copies
      FROM signed_scope_bridge AS f
      WHERE
        f.fact_id IS NOT NULL
        AND (
          CASE
            WHEN f.signed_opportunityid IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'signed_opportunity'
            ELSE 'unsigned_opportunity'
          END
        ) IN (:sign_statuses)
    ) AS signed_scope
  
/*FILTER_END:YWLN_D015*/
)
  SELECT
    f.d003 AS "YWLN_D003",
    SUM(f.metric_value) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS "YWLN_M0023"
  FROM selected_facts AS f
  GROUP BY
    f.d003
) AS __x360_period_result
