WITH __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(name AS TEXT)) = 1 THEN MIN(CAST(name AS TEXT)) END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_owners AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(t.team_name) END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS t
    ON t.team_id = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(t.team_name), '') IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_products AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS new_product_typeid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)) = 1
      THEN MIN(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT))
    END AS new_accproducttype
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    v.*,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), owner_team.team_name) AS __x360_target_team_name_20261114
  FROM (
    SELECT
      raw.*,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY COALESCE(
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(raw.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''),
          CAST(raw.new_targetid AS TEXT)
        ), raw.new_year
        ORDER BY raw.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, raw.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS __x360_target_version_20261114
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_target_esb AS raw
    WHERE
      raw.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
  ) AS v
  LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS owned
    ON owned.team_id = CAST(v.owningteam AS TEXT)
  LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_owners AS owner_team
    ON owner_team.owner_id = CAST(v.ownerid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    v.__x360_target_version_20261114 = 1
), __x360_selected_prediction_request AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  /*TIME_BEGIN*/
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(:start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
    CAST(:end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP) /*TIME_END*/
), __x360_selected_prediction_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM __x360_selected_prediction_request
)
SELECT
  __x360_period_result.*
FROM (
  WITH requested AS (
    SELECT
      CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
      CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
    WHERE
      FALSE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      start_at,
      end_at
    FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
  ), bounds AS (
    SELECT
      MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
      MAX(end_at) AS end_at
    FROM requested
  ), __accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(accountid AS TEXT),
      CAST(new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS customer_level,
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(name AS TEXT)), '') AS customer_name
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb"
  ), __teams AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(teamid AS TEXT),
      CAST(name AS TEXT) AS team_name
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb"
  ), __owner_team_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
      t.team_name
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" AS tm
    JOIN __teams AS t
      ON t.teamid = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(t.team_name), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), __owner_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      owner_id,
      CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(team_name) END AS team_name
    FROM __owner_team_candidates
    GROUP BY
      owner_id
  ), __remaining_opportunity_source AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      opportunityid,
      ownerid,
      new_salesbg,
      new_accproducttype,
      new_accountlevel,
      parentaccountid,
      new_cellcapacity,
      new_cell_qty
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb"
  ), __opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(opportunityid AS TEXT),
      CAST(ownerid AS TEXT),
      CAST(new_salesbg AS TEXT) AS d002,
      CASE
        WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
        THEN '其他'
        WHEN CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS d003,
      CAST(new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS d005,
      CAST(parentaccountid AS TEXT)
    FROM __remaining_opportunity_source
  ), __shipment_items AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(i.new_ord_shipmentitemid AS TEXT) AS fact_id,
      CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
      CAST(i.new_qty AS DECIMAL) AS qty,
      CAST(i.new_productcode AS TEXT) AS product_code,
      CAST(s.new_account_id AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      COALESCE(
        NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(i.new_ord_salesorder_id AS TEXT)), ''),
        NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(s.new_salesorderid AS TEXT)), '')
      ) AS order_id
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipmentitem_esb" AS i
    JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb" AS s
      ON s.new_ord_shipmentid = i.new_ord_shipment_id
    CROSS JOIN bounds AS b
    WHERE
      i.new_qty > 0
      AND s.statecode = 0
      AND s.new_ord_shipmentid IS NOT NULL
      AND s.new_shipping2_date IS NOT NULL
      AND CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      AND (
        b.start_at IS NULL
        OR (
          CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) >= b.start_at
          AND CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) < b.end_at
        )
      )
  ), __selected_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      order_id
    FROM __shipment_items
    WHERE
      order_id IS NOT NULL
  ), __direct_order_links AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(so.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id,
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(so.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') AS opportunity_id
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" AS so
    JOIN __selected_orders AS requested
      ON requested.order_id = CAST(so.salesorderid AS TEXT)
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(so.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), __order_links AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      order_id,
      opportunity_id
    FROM __direct_order_links
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT),
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '')
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb" AS l
    JOIN __selected_orders AS requested
      ON requested.order_id = CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)
    WHERE
      NOT EXISTS(
        SELECT
          1
        FROM __direct_order_links AS d
        WHERE
          d.order_id = CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)
      )
  ), __order_dimension_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      link.order_id,
      link.opportunity_id,
      o.ownerid,
      o.d002,
      o.d003,
      teams.team_name
    FROM __order_links AS link
    LEFT JOIN __opportunities AS o
      ON o.opportunityid = link.opportunity_id
    LEFT JOIN __owner_team_candidates AS teams
      ON teams.owner_id = o.ownerid
  ), __order_dimensions AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      order_id,
      CASE
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT ownerid) = 1 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(ownerid)
        THEN MIN(ownerid)
      END AS owner_id,
      CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT d002) = 1 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(d002) THEN MIN(d002) END AS d002,
      CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT d003) = 1 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(d003) THEN MIN(d003) END AS d003,
      CASE
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) = 1 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(team_name)
        THEN MIN(team_name)
      END AS team_name
    FROM __order_dimension_candidates
    GROUP BY
      order_id
  ), __product_energy AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      CAST(p.productnumber AS TEXT) AS product_code,
      CASE
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT p.new_system_energy) = 1
        THEN MIN(CAST(p.new_system_energy AS DECIMAL))
      END AS energy_kwh
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_product_esb" AS p
    WHERE
      p.new_system_energy > 0
      AND EXISTS(
        SELECT
          1
        FROM __shipment_items AS i
        WHERE
          i.product_code = CAST(p.productnumber AS TEXT)
      )
    GROUP BY
      CAST(p.productnumber AS TEXT)
  ), __actual_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST('ACTUAL' AS TEXT) AS kind,
      i.fact_id,
      i.fact_date,
      i.qty * p.energy_kwh / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS value_gwh,
      (
        i.fact_id IS NULL OR p.energy_kwh IS NULL
      ) AS invalid,
      d.d002,
      d.d003,
      c.customer_level AS d005,
      c.customer_name AS d006,
      d.team_name AS d004
    FROM __shipment_items AS i
    JOIN __product_energy AS p
      ON p.product_code = i.product_code
    LEFT JOIN __order_dimensions AS d
      ON d.order_id = i.order_id
    LEFT JOIN __accounts AS c
      ON c.accountid = i.account_id
  ), __target_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      ranked.*
    FROM (
      SELECT
        CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT) AS target_id,
        t.new_year,
        CAST(t.new_account_id AS TEXT) AS account_id,
        CAST(t.new_marketing_center AS TEXT) AS d002,
        CAST(t.new_producttype_id AS TEXT) AS producttype_id,
        CAST(t.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
        CAST(t.owningteam AS TEXT) AS owning_team,
        t.new_month1_power,
        t.new_month2_power,
        t.new_month3_power,
        t.new_month4_power,
        t.new_month5_power,
        t.new_month6_power,
        t.new_month7_power,
        t.new_month8_power,
        t.new_month9_power,
        t.new_month10_power,
        t.new_month11_power,
        t.new_month12_power,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''), CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT)), t.new_year
          ORDER BY t.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, t.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS rn
      FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS t
      CROSS JOIN bounds AS b
      WHERE
        b.start_at IS NULL OR t.new_year = CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM b.start_at) AS INT)
    ) AS ranked
    WHERE
      ranked.rn = 1
  ), __product_types AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS producttype_id,
      CASE
        WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
        THEN '其他'
        WHEN CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS d003
    FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_products AS p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
  ), __target_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST('TARGET' AS TEXT) AS kind,
      t.target_id || ':' || CAST(v.month_no AS TEXT) AS fact_id,
      CASE
        WHEN t.new_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 9999
        THEN CAST(MAKE_DATE(CAST(t.new_year AS INT), v.month_no, 1) AS TIMESTAMP)
      END AS fact_date,
      CAST(v.power_kwh AS DECIMAL) / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS value_gwh,
      FALSE AS invalid,
      t.d002,
      COALESCE(pt.d003, '其他') AS d003,
      c.customer_level AS d005,
      c.customer_name AS d006,
      (
        SELECT
          CASE
            WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT c.__x360_target_team_name_20261114) = 1
            THEN MIN(c.__x360_target_team_name_20261114)
          END
        FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS c
        WHERE
          CAST(c.new_targetid AS TEXT) = CAST(t.target_id AS TEXT)
      ) AS d004
    FROM __target_latest AS t
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      VALUES
        (1, t.new_month1_power),
        (2, t.new_month2_power),
        (3, t.new_month3_power),
        (4, t.new_month4_power),
        (5, t.new_month5_power),
        (6, t.new_month6_power),
        (7, t.new_month7_power),
        (8, t.new_month8_power),
        (9, t.new_month9_power),
        (10, t.new_month10_power),
        (11, t.new_month11_power),
        (12, t.new_month12_power)
    ) AS v(month_no, power_kwh)
    CROSS JOIN bounds AS b
    LEFT JOIN __product_types AS pt
      ON pt.producttype_id = t.producttype_id
    LEFT JOIN __accounts AS c
      ON c.accountid = t.account_id
    WHERE
      t.target_id IS NOT NULL
      AND (
        b.start_at IS NULL
        OR (
          CASE
            WHEN t.new_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 9999
            THEN CAST(MAKE_DATE(CAST(t.new_year AS INT), v.month_no, 1) AS TIMESTAMP)
          END >= DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', b.start_at)
          AND CASE
            WHEN t.new_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 9999
            THEN CAST(MAKE_DATE(CAST(t.new_year AS INT), v.month_no, 1) AS TIMESTAMP)
          END < CASE
            WHEN b.end_at IS NOT NULL
            THEN DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', b.start_at) + INTERVAL '1 YEAR'
          END
        )
      )
  ), __forecast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      ranked.fact_id,
      ranked.opportunity_id,
      ranked.fact_date,
      ranked.qty,
      ranked.energy_kwh
    FROM (
      SELECT
        CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS fact_id,
        CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
        CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
        CAST(m.new_shipforecast_qty AS DECIMAL) AS qty,
        CAST(m.new_singlepower AS DECIMAL) AS energy_kwh,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT), DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
          ORDER BY CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) DESC NULLS LAST, CAST(m.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) DESC NULLS LAST, CAST(m.modifiedon AS TIMESTAMP) DESC NULLS LAST, CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS __remaining_month_latest_rn
      FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb" AS m
      CROSS JOIN bounds AS b
      WHERE
        NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
        AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
        AND (
          b.start_at IS NULL
          OR (
            CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= b.start_at
            AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < b.end_at
          )
        )
    ) AS ranked
    WHERE
      ranked.__remaining_month_latest_rn = 1 AND ranked.fact_id IS NOT NULL
  ), __remaining_opp_energy_values AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
      END AS product_type,
      CAST(o.new_cellcapacity AS DECIMAL) AS cell_energy_kwh,
      CAST(o.new_cell_qty AS DECIMAL) AS cells_per_set
    FROM __remaining_opportunity_source AS o
    WHERE
      EXISTS(
        SELECT
          1
        FROM __forecast_rows AS f
        WHERE
          f.opportunity_id = CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)
      )
  ), __remaining_opp_energy_by_type AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      opportunity_id,
      CASE
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT product_type) = 1
        AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(product_type)
        AND COUNT(DISTINCT cell_energy_kwh) = 1
        AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(cell_energy_kwh)
        AND MIN(cell_energy_kwh) > 0
        THEN CASE
          WHEN MIN(product_type) = '电芯'
          THEN MIN(cell_energy_kwh)
          WHEN MIN(product_type) = 'PACK'
          AND COUNT(DISTINCT cells_per_set) = 1
          AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(cells_per_set)
          AND MIN(cells_per_set) > 0
          THEN MIN(cell_energy_kwh) * MIN(cells_per_set)
        END
      END AS alternative_unit_kwh
    FROM __remaining_opp_energy_values
    GROUP BY
      opportunity_id
  ), __remaining_converted AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      f.fact_id,
      f.opportunity_id,
      f.fact_date,
      f.qty,
      CASE WHEN f.energy_kwh > 0 THEN f.energy_kwh ELSE e.alternative_unit_kwh END AS unit_kwh
    FROM __forecast_rows AS f
    LEFT JOIN __remaining_opp_energy_by_type AS e
      ON e.opportunity_id = f.opportunity_id
  ), __forecast_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST('FORECAST' AS TEXT) AS kind,
      f.fact_id,
      f.fact_date,
      CASE
        WHEN f.qty = 0
        THEN CAST(0 AS DECIMAL)
        WHEN f.qty > 0 AND f.unit_kwh > 0
        THEN f.qty * f.unit_kwh / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL)
      END AS value_gwh,
      (
        f.qty IS NULL OR f.qty < 0 OR (
          f.qty > 0 AND f.unit_kwh IS NULL
        )
      ) AS invalid,
      o.d002,
      o.d003,
      o.d005,
      c.customer_name AS d006,
      teams.team_name AS d004
    FROM __remaining_converted AS f
    JOIN __opportunities AS o
      ON o.opportunityid = f.opportunity_id
    LEFT JOIN __accounts AS c
      ON c.accountid = o.parentaccountid
    LEFT JOIN __owner_teams AS teams
      ON teams.owner_id = o.ownerid
  ), facts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM __actual_facts
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      *
    FROM __target_facts
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      *
    FROM __forecast_facts
  ), checked AS (
    SELECT
      f.*,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY kind, fact_id) AS copies
    FROM facts AS f
  ), scoped AS (
    SELECT
      f.*,
      TO_CHAR(f.fact_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month_key
    FROM checked AS f
    WHERE
      f.fact_date IS NOT NULL
      /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D002*/ AND f.d002 IN (:product_lines) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D002*/
      /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D003*/ AND f.d003 IN (:product_types) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D003*/
      /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D004*/ AND f.d004 IN (:team_ids) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D004*/
      /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D005*/ AND (
        f.d005 IN (:customer_levels)
        OR (
          CASE f.d005
            WHEN '0'
            THEN '核心大客户'
            WHEN '1'
            THEN '战略大客户'
            WHEN '2'
            THEN '重要大客户'
            WHEN '3'
            THEN '一般客户'
            WHEN '4'
            THEN 'BG大客户'
            ELSE f.d005
          END
        ) IN (:customer_levels)
      ) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D005*/
      /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D006*/ AND f.d006 IN (:customer_ids) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/
  ), aggregated AS (
    SELECT
      CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(
          BOOL_OR(f.invalid OR f.copies > 1 OR f.fact_id IS NULL) FILTER(WHERE
            kind = 'ACTUAL'),
          FALSE
        )
        THEN NULL
        ELSE SUM(value_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
          kind = 'ACTUAL')
      END AS actual_gwh,
      SUM(value_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
        kind = 'TARGET') AS target_gwh,
      SUM(value_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
        kind = 'FORECAST'
        AND f.fact_id IS NOT NULL
        AND f.copies = 1
        AND NOT COALESCE(f.invalid, TRUE)) AS remaining_gwh
    FROM scoped AS f
  )
  SELECT
    (
      a.actual_gwh + COALESCE(a.remaining_gwh, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL))
    ) / NULLIF(a.target_gwh, 0) AS "YWLN_M0012"
  FROM aggregated AS a
) AS __x360_period_result

WITH source_values AS (
 SELECT config_key,config_value,period_key,
  CASE WHEN length(period_key)=4 THEN to_date(period_key||'-01-01','YYYY-MM-DD')
       ELSE to_date(period_key||'-01','YYYY-MM-DD') END AS snapshot_date
 FROM ded_public."x360_static_metric_config"
 WHERE config_set='MOCK' AND enabled AND config_group='FINANCE'
  AND config_key IN ('NET_MARGIN_ACTUAL','NET_MARGIN_TARGET') AND length(period_key)=7
), scoped AS (
 SELECT * FROM source_values WHERE 1=1
 /*TIME_BEGIN*/ AND snapshot_date>=CAST(:start_date AS date)
 AND snapshot_date<CAST(:end_exclusive AS date) /*TIME_END*/
), snapshots AS (
 SELECT period_key,snapshot_date,
  max(config_value) FILTER(WHERE config_key='NET_MARGIN_ACTUAL') AS actual_value,
  max(config_value) FILTER(WHERE config_key='NET_MARGIN_TARGET') AS target_value
 FROM scoped GROUP BY period_key,snapshot_date
)
SELECT CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT period_key)=1 THEN max(actual_value) END AS "YWLN_M0016", CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT period_key)=1 THEN max(target_value) END AS "YWLN_M0017" FROM snapshots
sql.Q126:
WITH __ont_request AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  /*TIME_BEGIN*/
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(:start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
    CAST(:end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP) /*TIME_END*/
), __ont_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM __ont_request
), __ont_accounts_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    a.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_accounts AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM __ont_accounts_ranked
  WHERE
    __ont_rn = 1
), __ont_opportunity_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_opportunity AS (
  SELECT
    o.*
  FROM __ont_opportunity_ranked AS o
  WHERE
    o.__ont_rn = 1
), __ont_forecast_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    m.*,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL), 0) / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS __ont_energy_mwh,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS m
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND m.new_accountdate IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      b.start_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= b.start_at
    )
    AND (
      b.end_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < b.end_at
    )
), __ont_forecast AS (
  SELECT
    m.*
  FROM __ont_forecast_ranked AS m
  JOIN __ont_opportunity AS o
    ON o.opportunityid = m.new_opportunity_id
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    m.__ont_rn = 1
    AND (
      o.createdon IS NULL
      OR CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) <= LEAST(
        COALESCE(b.end_at, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)),
        CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)
      )
    )
), __ont_owner_teams AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS ownerid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), '')) = 1
      THEN MIN(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), ''))
    END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb AS t
    ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
  GROUP BY
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)
), __x360_signed_via_order_lines_20261113 AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(__sign_line.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunityid
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS __sign_line
  JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb AS __sign_order
    ON __sign_order.salesorderid = __sign_line.salesorderid
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__sign_line.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__sign_line.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND __sign_order.salesorderid IS NOT NULL
), __x360_selected_prediction_request AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    start_at,
    end_at
  FROM __ont_bounds
), __x360_selected_prediction_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM __x360_selected_prediction_request
)
SELECT
  __x360_period_result.*
FROM (
  WITH order_source_once AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      (
        so.salesorderid || ''
      ) AS salesorderid,
      (
        so.new_salesorderid || ''
      ) AS new_salesorderid,
      (
        ord_line.new_opportunity_id || ''
      ) AS opportunityid,
      so.statecode,
      so.new_changetype,
      so.new_changestatus,
      so.new_approval_time,
      so.new_ord_oa_state,
      so.new_salesordertype,
      so.new_order_category
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" AS so
    JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb" AS ord_line
      ON ord_line.salesorderid = so.salesorderid
      AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(ord_line.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    WHERE
      so.salesorderid IS NOT NULL
  ), cancelled_order_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      cx.new_salesorderid AS salesorderid
    FROM order_source_once AS cx
    WHERE
      cx.salesorderid <> cx.new_salesorderid
  ), signed_opportunity_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      opportunityid
    FROM __x360_signed_via_order_lines_20261113
  ), opportunity_distinct AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      (
        o.opportunityid || ''
      ) AS opportunityid,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP),
      (
        o.new_salesbg || ''
      ) AS d002,
      CASE
        WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL
        THEN NULL
        WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
        THEN '其他'
        WHEN o.new_accproducttype IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN o.new_accproducttype IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS d003,
      (
        o.ownerid || ''
      ) AS owner_id,
      (
        o.new_accountlevel || ''
      ) AS d005,
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(acc_o.name AS TEXT)), '') AS d006,
      CASE
        WHEN EXISTS(
          SELECT
            1
          FROM __x360_signed_via_order_lines_20261113 AS __sign_match
          WHERE
            __sign_match.opportunityid = CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)
        )
        THEN 'signed_opportunity'
        ELSE 'unsigned_opportunity'
      END AS status_code
    FROM __ont_opportunity AS o
    LEFT JOIN signed_opportunity_ids AS signed
      ON signed.opportunityid = o.opportunityid
    LEFT JOIN __ont_accounts AS acc_o
      ON acc_o.accountid = o.parentaccountid
    WHERE
      o.opportunityid IS NOT NULL
  ), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      *,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY opportunityid) AS copies
    FROM opportunity_distinct
  ), month_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      (
        m.new_opportunity_id || ''
      ) AS month_opportunity_id,
      (
        m.new_oppmonthid || ''
      ) AS fact_id,
      CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
      m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS metric_value
    FROM (
      SELECT
        __latest."new_accountdate",
        __latest."new_forecast_amt_rmb",
        __latest."new_month",
        __latest."new_oppmonthid",
        __latest."new_opportunity_id",
        __latest."new_year"
      FROM (
        SELECT
          __raw."createdon",
          __raw."modifiedon",
          __raw."new_accountdate",
          __raw."new_forecast_amt_rmb",
          __raw."new_month",
          __raw."new_oppmonthid",
          __raw."new_opportunity_id",
          __raw."new_year",
          1 AS __x360_period_latest_rn
        FROM __ont_forecast AS __raw
        WHERE
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__raw.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
          AND CAST(__raw.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
          AND (
            (
              SELECT
                start_at
              FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
            ) IS NULL
            OR (
              CAST(__raw.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= (
                SELECT
                  start_at
                FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
              )
              AND CAST(__raw.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < (
                SELECT
                  end_at
                FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
              )
            )
          )
      ) AS __latest
      WHERE
        __latest.__x360_period_latest_rn = 1
    ) AS m
    WHERE
      m.new_oppmonthid IS NOT NULL
      AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
      AND (
        (
          SELECT
            start_at
          FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
        ) IS NULL
        OR (
          CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= CAST((
            SELECT
              start_at
            FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
          ) AS TIMESTAMP)
          AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < CAST((
            SELECT
              end_at
            FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
          ) AS TIMESTAMP)
        )
      )
      AND (
        m.new_forecast_amt_rmb
      ) IS NOT NULL
      AND TRUE
      AND TRUE
  ), month_opportunity_bridge AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      m.fact_id,
      m.fact_date,
      m.metric_value,
      m.month_opportunity_id,
      o.opportunityid AS source_opportunity_id,
      o.copies AS source_copies,
      o.status_code,
      o.d002,
      o.d003,
      o.owner_id,
      o.d005,
      o.d006
    FROM month_filtered AS m
    FULL JOIN opportunities AS o
      ON o.opportunityid = m.month_opportunity_id
  ), fact_distinct AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      fact_id,
      fact_date,
      metric_value,
      source_copies,
      status_code,
      d002,
      d003,
      owner_id,
      d005,
      d006
    FROM month_opportunity_bridge
    WHERE
      fact_id IS NOT NULL AND source_opportunity_id IS NOT NULL
  ), metric_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      *,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY fact_id) AS copies
    FROM fact_distinct
  ), scoped AS (
    SELECT
      f.*,
      CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS d004
    FROM metric_facts AS f
    WHERE
      1 = 1
      /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D002*/ AND  f.d002 IN (:product_lines) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D002*/
      /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D003*/ AND  f.d003 IN (:product_types) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D003*/
      /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D004*/ AND  EXISTS(
        SELECT
          1
        FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" AS tm
        JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb" AS t
          ON t."teamid" = tm."teamid"
        WHERE
          tm."systemuserid" = f.owner_id AND CAST(t."name" AS TEXT) IN (:team_ids)
      ) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D004*/
      /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D005*/ AND  /* YWLN_CUSTOMER_LEVEL_FILTER_V1 */ (
        CAST(f.d005 AS TEXT) IN (:customer_levels)
        OR (
          CASE CAST(f.d005 AS TEXT)
            WHEN '0'
            THEN '核心大客户'
            WHEN '1'
            THEN '战略大客户'
            WHEN '2'
            THEN '重要大客户'
            WHEN '3'
            THEN '一般客户'
            WHEN '4'
            THEN 'BG大客户'
            WHEN '战略大客户'
            THEN '战略大客户'
            WHEN '重要大客户'
            THEN '重要大客户'
            WHEN '一般客户'
            THEN '一般客户'
            WHEN 'BG大客户'
            THEN 'BG大客户'
          END
        ) IN (:customer_levels)
      ) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D005*/
      /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D006*/ AND  /* YWLN_CUSTOMER_NAME_FILTER_V1 */ (
        CAST(f.d006 AS TEXT) IN (:customer_ids)
        OR EXISTS(
          SELECT
            1
          FROM __ont_accounts AS customer_filter
          WHERE
            CAST(customer_filter.accountid AS TEXT) = CAST(f.d006 AS TEXT)
            AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(customer_filter.name AS TEXT)), '') IN (:customer_ids)
        )
      ) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/
      /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D015*/ AND  f.status_code IN (:sign_statuses) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D015*/
  )
  SELECT
    f.status_code AS "YWLN_D015",
    SUM(f.metric_value) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS "YWLN_M0023"
  FROM scoped AS f
  GROUP BY
    f.status_code
) AS __x360_period_result

WITH __x360_gov_source_6 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT __x360_raw."new_productpower",__x360_raw."new_quoteapply_id",__x360_raw."new_product_id",__x360_raw."new_opportunity_id",__x360_raw."new_accproducttype",__x360_raw."ownerid",__x360_raw."createdon",__x360_raw."new_quoteapply_id"::text AS "new_quoteapplydetailid" FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_quoteapplydetail_esb" __x360_raw)
SELECT * FROM (
WITH requested AS (
 SELECT NULL::timestamp AS start_at,NULL::timestamp AS end_at
 /*TIME_BEGIN*/ WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT CAST(:start_date AS timestamp),CAST(:end_exclusive AS timestamp) /*TIME_END*/
), bounds AS (SELECT MAX(start_at) AS start_at,MAX(end_at) AS end_at FROM requested)
, measure_rows AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 'm0'::text AS measure_tag,f.fact_id::text,f.fact_date::timestamp AS fact_date,(f.energy_kwh)::numeric/1000000::numeric AS metric_value,(COALESCE(f.source_issue,FALSE) OR COALESCE((FALSE),FALSE) OR (f.energy_kwh) IS NULL) AS invalid,(f.approval='6') AS poison_time,f.d002,f.d003,f.owner_id,f.d005,f.d006,f.status_code,to_jsonb(f)->>'helmet_status' AS helmet_status FROM (
WITH linked_pick AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT ON (d.new_opportunity_id) d.new_opportunity_id,q.new_quoteapplyid
 FROM __x360_gov_source_6 d
 JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_quoteapply_esb" q ON q.new_quoteapplyid=d.new_quoteapply_id
 JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" o ON o.opportunityid=d.new_opportunity_id
 WHERE q.new_approvalstatus::text IN ('2','3','6') AND q.createdon::timestamp<=NOW()
 AND d.new_opportunity_id IS NOT NULL AND o.new_opportunitystatus::text='0' AND o.new_approvalstatus::text='3'
 ORDER BY d.new_opportunity_id,q.createdon::timestamp DESC,q.new_quoteapplyid DESC
), chosen AS (
 SELECT d.*,q.new_approvalstatus::text AS approval,q.new_oasubmitdate::timestamp,q.new_approved_time::timestamp,q.createdon::timestamp AS quote_created,
 q.new_quoteapplyid AS quote_id,q.ownerid AS quote_owner
 FROM __x360_gov_source_6 d JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_quoteapply_esb" q ON q.new_quoteapplyid=d.new_quoteapply_id
 WHERE d.new_quoteapplydetailid IS NOT NULL
 AND q.new_approvalstatus::text IN ('2','3','6') AND q.createdon::timestamp<=NOW()
 AND (d.new_opportunity_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM linked_pick p WHERE p.new_quoteapplyid=q.new_quoteapplyid AND p.new_opportunity_id=d.new_opportunity_id))
)
 SELECT DISTINCT d.new_quoteapplydetailid::text AS fact_id,
 CASE WHEN d.approval='3' THEN d.new_approved_time::timestamp ELSE d.new_oasubmitdate::timestamp END AS fact_date,
 d.new_oasubmitdate::timestamp,d.new_approved_time::timestamp,d.quote_created,d.quote_id::text,d.approval,
 d.new_productpower::numeric AS energy_kwh,
 o.new_salesbg::text AS d002,
 CASE WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN NULLIF(btrim(o.new_accproducttype::text),'') IS NULL THEN '其他' WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯' WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK' ELSE '其他' END AS d003,
 COALESCE(o.ownerid,d.quote_owner)::text AS owner_id,o.new_accountlevel::text AS d005,(SELECT NULLIF(btrim(a.name::text),'') FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" a WHERE a.accountid::text=o.parentaccountid::text) AS d006,NULL::text AS status_code,
 (SELECT CASE WHEN ((d.approval='2' AND d.new_approved_time::timestamp IS NULL) OR (d.approval='3' AND d.new_approved_time::timestamp IS NOT NULL)) AND d.new_oasubmitdate::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND d.new_oasubmitdate::timestamp<=NOW()
 AND (d.new_approved_time::timestamp IS NULL OR (d.new_approved_time::timestamp>=d.new_oasubmitdate::timestamp AND d.new_approved_time::timestamp<=NOW())) AND p.enabled AND p.cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL THEN
 CASE WHEN d.new_approved_time::timestamp IS NULL AND CURRENT_DATE-d.new_oasubmitdate::date>p.cycle_target_days THEN 'overdue_uncompleted'
 WHEN d.new_approved_time::timestamp IS NULL AND p.cycle_target_days-(CURRENT_DATE-d.new_oasubmitdate::date) BETWEEN 0 AND p.imminent_days THEN 'imminent_uncompleted'
 WHEN d.new_approved_time::timestamp IS NULL AND p.cycle_target_days-(CURRENT_DATE-d.new_oasubmitdate::date)>p.imminent_days THEN 'normal_uncompleted'
 WHEN d.new_approved_time::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND d.new_approved_time::date-d.new_oasubmitdate::date>p.cycle_target_days THEN 'overdue_completed'
 WHEN d.new_approved_time::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND d.new_approved_time::date-d.new_oasubmitdate::date<=p.cycle_target_days THEN 'normal_completed' END END
 FROM (SELECT dimension_code,cycle_target_days,imminent_days,
 (cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL AND cycle_target_days>=0
  AND imminent_days IS NOT NULL AND imminent_days BETWEEN 0 AND cycle_target_days) AS enabled
FROM (
 SELECT dimension_code,
  max(config_value) FILTER(WHERE config_key=replace(dimension_code,'YWLN_','')||'_CYCLE_TARGET_DAYS') AS cycle_target_days,
  max(config_value) FILTER(WHERE config_key=replace(dimension_code,'YWLN_','')||'_IMMINENT_DAYS') AS imminent_days
 FROM ded_public."x360_static_metric_config"
 WHERE config_set='MOCK' AND period_key='GLOBAL'
   AND config_group='HELMET' AND enabled
 GROUP BY dimension_code
) v) p WHERE p.dimension_code='YWLN_D021') AS helmet_status,
 (o.new_accountlevel::text IN ('1','2') OR o.new_risklevel::text IN ('1','2')) AS is_key,
 pr.material_type,COALESCE(pr.matches,0)<>1 OR pr.material_type IS NULL AS material_issue,
 (d.approval='6') AS source_issue,
 (CURRENT_DATE-d.new_oasubmitdate::date) AS elapsed_days
 FROM chosen d LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" o ON o.opportunityid=d.new_opportunity_id
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COUNT(*) AS matches,MIN(p.new_productype::text) AS material_type
 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT productid,new_productype FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_product_esb" WHERE name::text=d.new_product_id::text) p) pr ON TRUE
) f WHERE f.energy_kwh IS NOT NULL AND (f.approval='6' OR (f.approval='3' AND f.new_approved_time::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND f.new_approved_time::timestamp<=NOW()) OR (f.approval='2' AND f.new_oasubmitdate::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND f.new_oasubmitdate::timestamp<=NOW()))
), checked AS (SELECT *,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY measure_tag,fact_id) AS fact_copies FROM measure_rows),
 scoped AS (SELECT f.*,NULL::text AS d004 FROM checked f 
 WHERE ((SELECT start_at FROM bounds) IS NULL OR (f.fact_date>=(SELECT start_at FROM bounds) AND f.fact_date<(SELECT end_at FROM bounds)) OR f.poison_time)
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D002*/ AND f.d002 IN (:product_lines) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D002*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D003*/ AND f.d003 IN (:product_types) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D003*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D004*/ AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" tm JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb" t ON t."teamid"=tm."teamid"
 WHERE tm."systemuserid"::text=f.owner_id AND t."name"::text IN (:team_ids)) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D004*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D005*/ AND f.d005 IN (:customer_levels) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D005*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D006*/ AND f.d006 IN (:customer_ids) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D021*/ AND (f.helmet_status IN (:status_codes) OR (CASE f.helmet_status WHEN 'overdue_uncompleted' THEN '逾期未完成' WHEN 'imminent_uncompleted' THEN '临期未完成' WHEN 'normal_uncompleted' THEN '正常未完成' WHEN 'overdue_completed' THEN '逾期完成' WHEN 'normal_completed' THEN '正常完成' END) IN (:status_codes)) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D021*//*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D_QUOTE_ABNORMAL*/ AND (CASE WHEN f.helmet_status IN ('overdue_completed','overdue_uncompleted') THEN '是' WHEN f.helmet_status IN ('normal_completed','normal_uncompleted','imminent_uncompleted') THEN '否' ELSE NULL END) IN (:quote_abnormal_flags) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D_QUOTE_ABNORMAL*/
)
SELECT f.d003 AS "YWLN_D003", (CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM scoped x WHERE x.measure_tag='m0' AND x.poison_time AND x.d003 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM f.d003) OR COALESCE(bool_or(f.invalid OR f.fact_copies>1) FILTER(WHERE f.measure_tag='m0'),FALSE) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(f.metric_value) FILTER(WHERE f.measure_tag='m0') END) AS "YWLN_M0031" FROM scoped f GROUP BY f.d003
) AS __x360_gov_result
sql.Q131:
WITH __x360_gov_source_6 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT __x360_raw."new_productpower",__x360_raw."new_quoteapply_id",__x360_raw."new_product_id",__x360_raw."new_opportunity_id",__x360_raw."new_accproducttype",__x360_raw."ownerid",__x360_raw."createdon",__x360_raw."new_quoteapply_id"::text AS "new_quoteapplydetailid" FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_quoteapplydetail_esb" __x360_raw)
SELECT * FROM (
WITH __helmet_cfg AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT dimension_code,cycle_target_days,imminent_days,
 (cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL AND cycle_target_days>=0
  AND imminent_days IS NOT NULL AND imminent_days BETWEEN 0 AND cycle_target_days) AS enabled
FROM (
 SELECT dimension_code,
  max(config_value) FILTER(WHERE config_key=replace(dimension_code,'YWLN_','')||'_CYCLE_TARGET_DAYS') AS cycle_target_days,
  max(config_value) FILTER(WHERE config_key=replace(dimension_code,'YWLN_','')||'_IMMINENT_DAYS') AS imminent_days
 FROM ded_public."x360_static_metric_config"
 WHERE config_set='MOCK' AND period_key='GLOBAL'
   AND config_group='HELMET' AND enabled
 GROUP BY dimension_code
) v
),
requested AS (
 SELECT NULL::timestamp AS start_at,NULL::timestamp AS end_at
 /*TIME_BEGIN*/ WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT CAST(:start_date AS timestamp),CAST(:end_exclusive AS timestamp) /*TIME_END*/
), bounds AS (SELECT MAX(start_at) AS start_at,MAX(end_at) AS end_at FROM requested)
, measure_rows AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 'm0'::text AS measure_tag,f.fact_id::text,f.fact_date::timestamp AS fact_date,(f.energy_kwh)::numeric/1000000::numeric AS metric_value,(COALESCE(f.source_issue,FALSE) OR COALESCE((FALSE),FALSE) OR (f.energy_kwh) IS NULL) AS invalid,(f.approval='6' AND f.fact_date IS NULL) AS poison_time,f.d002,f.d003,f.owner_id,f.d005,f.d006,f.status_code,f.helmet_status AS helmet_status FROM (
WITH linked_pick AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT ON (d.new_opportunity_id) d.new_opportunity_id,q.new_quoteapplyid
 FROM __x360_gov_source_6 d
 JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_quoteapply_esb" q ON q.new_quoteapplyid=d.new_quoteapply_id
 JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" o LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" acc_o ON acc_o.accountid = o.parentaccountid ON o.opportunityid=d.new_opportunity_id
 WHERE q.new_approvalstatus::text IN ('2','3','6') AND q.createdon::timestamp<=NOW()
 AND d.new_opportunity_id IS NOT NULL AND o.new_opportunitystatus::text='0' AND o.new_approvalstatus::text='3'
 ORDER BY d.new_opportunity_id,q.createdon::timestamp DESC,q.new_quoteapplyid DESC
), chosen AS (
 SELECT d.*,q.new_approvalstatus::text AS approval,q.new_oasubmitdate::timestamp,q.new_approved_time::timestamp,q.createdon::timestamp AS quote_created,
 q.new_quoteapplyid AS quote_id,q.ownerid AS quote_owner
 FROM __x360_gov_source_6 d JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_quoteapply_esb" q ON q.new_quoteapplyid=d.new_quoteapply_id
 WHERE d.new_quoteapplydetailid IS NOT NULL
 AND q.new_approvalstatus::text IN ('2','3','6') AND q.createdon::timestamp<=NOW()
 AND (d.new_opportunity_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM linked_pick p WHERE p.new_quoteapplyid=q.new_quoteapplyid AND p.new_opportunity_id=d.new_opportunity_id))
)
 SELECT DISTINCT d.new_quoteapplydetailid::text AS fact_id,
 CASE WHEN d.approval='3' THEN d.new_approved_time::timestamp ELSE d.new_oasubmitdate::timestamp END AS fact_date,
 d.new_oasubmitdate::timestamp,d.new_approved_time::timestamp,d.quote_created,d.quote_id::text,d.approval,
 d.new_productpower::numeric AS energy_kwh,
 o.new_salesbg::text AS d002,
 CASE WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN NULLIF(btrim(o.new_accproducttype::text),'') IS NULL THEN '其他' WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯' WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK' ELSE '其他' END AS d003,
 COALESCE(o.ownerid,d.quote_owner)::text AS owner_id,o.new_accountlevel::text AS d005,NULLIF(btrim(acc_o.name::text),'') AS d006,NULL::text AS status_code,
 (SELECT CASE WHEN ((d.approval='2' AND d.new_approved_time::timestamp IS NULL) OR (d.approval='3' AND d.new_approved_time::timestamp IS NOT NULL)) AND d.new_oasubmitdate::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND d.new_oasubmitdate::timestamp<=NOW()
 AND (d.new_approved_time::timestamp IS NULL OR (d.new_approved_time::timestamp>=d.new_oasubmitdate::timestamp AND d.new_approved_time::timestamp<=NOW())) AND p.enabled AND p.cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL THEN
 CASE WHEN d.new_approved_time::timestamp IS NULL AND CURRENT_DATE-d.new_oasubmitdate::date>p.cycle_target_days THEN 'overdue_uncompleted'
 WHEN d.new_approved_time::timestamp IS NULL AND p.cycle_target_days-(CURRENT_DATE-d.new_oasubmitdate::date) BETWEEN 0 AND p.imminent_days THEN 'imminent_uncompleted'
 WHEN d.new_approved_time::timestamp IS NULL AND p.cycle_target_days-(CURRENT_DATE-d.new_oasubmitdate::date)>p.imminent_days THEN 'normal_uncompleted'
 WHEN d.new_approved_time::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND d.new_approved_time::date-d.new_oasubmitdate::date>p.cycle_target_days THEN 'overdue_completed'
 WHEN d.new_approved_time::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND d.new_approved_time::date-d.new_oasubmitdate::date<=p.cycle_target_days THEN 'normal_completed' END END
 FROM __helmet_cfg p WHERE p.dimension_code='YWLN_D021') AS helmet_status,
 (o.new_accountlevel::text IN ('1','2') OR o.new_risklevel::text IN ('1','2')) AS is_key,
 pr.material_type,COALESCE(pr.matches,0)<>1 OR pr.material_type IS NULL AS material_issue,
 (d.approval='6' AND d.new_oasubmitdate::timestamp IS NULL) AS source_issue,
 (CURRENT_DATE-d.new_oasubmitdate::date) AS elapsed_days
 FROM chosen d LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" o LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" acc_o ON acc_o.accountid = o.parentaccountid ON o.opportunityid=d.new_opportunity_id
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COUNT(*) AS matches,MIN(p.new_productype::text) AS material_type
 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT productid,new_productype FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_product_esb" WHERE productid::text=d.new_product_id::text) p) pr ON TRUE
) f WHERE f.energy_kwh IS NOT NULL AND (f.approval='6' OR (f.approval='3' AND f.new_approved_time::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND f.new_approved_time::timestamp<=NOW()) OR (f.approval='2' AND f.new_oasubmitdate::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND f.new_oasubmitdate::timestamp<=NOW()))
), checked AS (SELECT *,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY measure_tag,fact_id) AS fact_copies FROM measure_rows),
 scoped AS (SELECT f.*,NULL::text AS d004 FROM checked f 
 WHERE ((SELECT start_at FROM bounds) IS NULL OR (f.fact_date>=(SELECT start_at FROM bounds) AND f.fact_date<(SELECT end_at FROM bounds)) OR f.poison_time)
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D002*/ AND f.d002 IN (:product_lines) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D002*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D003*/ AND f.d003 IN (:product_types) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D003*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D004*/ AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" tm JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb" t ON t."teamid"=tm."teamid"
 WHERE tm."systemuserid"::text=f.owner_id AND t."name"::text IN (:team_ids)) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D004*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D005*/ AND /*YWLN_CUSTOMER_LEVEL_FILTER_V1*/ (f.d005::text IN (:customer_levels) OR (CASE f.d005::text WHEN '1' THEN '战略大客户' WHEN '2' THEN '重要大客户' WHEN '3' THEN '一般客户' WHEN '4' THEN 'BG大客户' WHEN '战略大客户' THEN '战略大客户' WHEN '重要大客户' THEN '重要大客户' WHEN '一般客户' THEN '一般客户' WHEN 'BG大客户' THEN 'BG大客户' END) IN (:customer_levels)) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D005*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D006*/ AND /*YWLN_CUSTOMER_NAME_FILTER_V1*/ (f.d006::text IN (:customer_ids) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" customer_filter WHERE customer_filter.accountid::text=f.d006::text AND NULLIF(btrim(customer_filter.name::text),'') IN (:customer_ids))) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D021*/ AND (f.helmet_status IN (:status_codes) OR (CASE f.helmet_status WHEN 'overdue_uncompleted' THEN '逾期未完成' WHEN 'imminent_uncompleted' THEN '临期未完成' WHEN 'normal_uncompleted' THEN '正常未完成' WHEN 'overdue_completed' THEN '逾期完成' WHEN 'normal_completed' THEN '正常完成' END) IN (:status_codes)) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D021*//*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D_QUOTE_ABNORMAL*/ AND (CASE WHEN f.helmet_status IN ('overdue_completed','overdue_uncompleted') THEN '是' WHEN f.helmet_status IN ('normal_completed','normal_uncompleted','imminent_uncompleted') THEN '否' ELSE NULL END) IN (:quote_abnormal_flags) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D_QUOTE_ABNORMAL*/
)
SELECT f.helmet_status AS "YWLN_D021", (CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM scoped x WHERE x.measure_tag='m0' AND x.poison_time AND x.helmet_status IS NOT DISTINCT FROM f.helmet_status) OR COALESCE(bool_or(f.invalid OR f.fact_copies>1) FILTER(WHERE f.measure_tag='m0'),FALSE) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(f.metric_value) FILTER(WHERE f.measure_tag='m0') END) AS "YWLN_M0031" FROM scoped f GROUP BY f.helmet_status
) AS __x360_gov_result
sql.Q132:
WITH __repl_product AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT r."createdon",r."modifiedon",r."name",r."new_capacity",(r."new_capacity"::numeric/1000::numeric) AS "new_electricquantity",r."productid",r."statecode" FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_product_esb" r)
SELECT __repl_result.* FROM (
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT max(config_value) FILTER (WHERE config_key='D024_CYCLE_TARGET_DAYS') AS cycle_target_days,
           max(config_value) FILTER (WHERE config_key='D024_IMMINENT_DAYS') AS imminent_days
    FROM ded_public."x360_static_metric_config"
    WHERE config_set='MOCK' AND period_key='GLOBAL' AND config_group='HELMET'
      AND dimension_code='YWLN_D024' AND enabled
), cancelled_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT new_salesorderid::text AS order_id
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb"
    WHERE TRUE AND salesorderid<>new_salesorderid
      AND TRUE AND new_changestatus::text='8'
      AND new_approval_time::timestamp<=NOW()
), order_distinct AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT so.salesorderid::text AS fact_id,so.ordernumber::text AS order_no,(SELECT MIN(d.new_opportunity_id) FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb" d WHERE d.salesorderid=so.salesorderid AND NULLIF(BTRIM(d.new_opportunity_id::text),'') IS NOT NULL HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.new_opportunity_id)=1)::text AS opportunity_id,
           so.new_approval_time::timestamp AS started_at,
           o.new_salesbg::text AS d002,
           CASE WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL THEN NULL
                WHEN NULLIF(btrim(o.new_accproducttype::text),'') IS NULL THEN '其他'
                WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯'
                WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK'
                ELSE '其他' END AS d003,
           COALESCE(o.ownerid,so.ownerid)::text AS owner_id,
           COALESCE(c.new_accountlevel::text,o.new_accountlevel::text) AS d005,
           NULLIF(btrim(c.name::text),'') AS d006
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" so
    LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" o ON o.opportunityid=(SELECT MIN(d.new_opportunity_id) FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb" d WHERE d.salesorderid=so.salesorderid AND NULLIF(BTRIM(d.new_opportunity_id::text),'') IS NOT NULL HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.new_opportunity_id)=1)
    LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" c ON c.accountid=so.customerid
    WHERE so.salesorderid IS NOT NULL AND so.new_salesordertype::text='1'
      AND so.new_order_category::text IN ('1','3') AND so.statecode=0
      AND so.new_ord_oa_state::text='5'
      AND NOT COALESCE(TRUE AND so.new_changestatus::text='8'
                       AND so.new_approval_time::timestamp<=NOW(),FALSE)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cancelled_orders x WHERE x.order_id=so.salesorderid::text)
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT *,count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY fact_id) AS id_copies FROM order_distinct
), line_distinct AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT l.salesorderid::text AS order_id,l.salesorderdetailid::text AS line_id,
           l.new_dischargecapacity::numeric AS energy_kwh
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb" l
    WHERE l.salesorderdetailid IS NOT NULL
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.fact_id=l.salesorderid::text)
      AND (l.new_effectivedate::timestamp IS NULL OR l.new_effectivedate::timestamp<=NOW())
      AND (l.new_expirydate::timestamp IS NULL OR l.new_expirydate::timestamp>NOW())
), lines_checked AS (
    SELECT *,count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id,line_id) AS copies FROM line_distinct
), line_totals AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT order_id,CASE WHEN bool_or(copies>1 OR energy_kwh IS NULL) THEN NULL
                        ELSE sum(energy_kwh) END AS energy_kwh
    FROM lines_checked GROUP BY order_id
), first_shipment AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT s.new_salesorderid::text AS order_id,min(s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp) AS finished_at
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb" s
    WHERE s.statecode=0 AND TRUE AND s.new_shipping2_date IS NOT NULL
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.fact_id=s.new_salesorderid::text)
    GROUP BY s.new_salesorderid::text
), source_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT o.*,l.energy_kwh,s.finished_at FROM orders o
    LEFT JOIN line_totals l ON l.order_id=o.fact_id
    LEFT JOIN first_shipment s ON s.order_id=o.fact_id
), classified AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT f.*,CASE
        WHEN f.id_copies=1 AND f.started_at IS NOT NULL AND f.started_at<=NOW()
         AND (f.finished_at IS NULL OR (f.finished_at>=f.started_at AND f.finished_at<=NOW()))
         AND p.cycle_target_days>=0 AND p.imminent_days BETWEEN 0 AND p.cycle_target_days
        THEN CASE
            WHEN f.finished_at IS NULL AND CURRENT_DATE-f.started_at::date>p.cycle_target_days
                THEN 'overdue_uncompleted'
            WHEN f.finished_at IS NULL AND p.cycle_target_days-(CURRENT_DATE-f.started_at::date) BETWEEN 0 AND p.imminent_days
                THEN 'imminent_uncompleted'
            WHEN f.finished_at IS NULL AND p.cycle_target_days-(CURRENT_DATE-f.started_at::date)>p.imminent_days
                THEN 'normal_uncompleted'
            WHEN f.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND f.finished_at::date-f.started_at::date>p.cycle_target_days
                THEN 'overdue_completed'
            WHEN f.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND f.finished_at::date-f.started_at::date<=p.cycle_target_days
                THEN 'normal_completed'
        END END AS status_code
    FROM source_rows f CROSS JOIN parameters p
), selected_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT f.*,CASE WHEN f.status_code IN ('overdue_uncompleted','overdue_completed') THEN '是' WHEN f.status_code IN ('imminent_uncompleted','normal_uncompleted','normal_completed') THEN '否' ELSE NULL END AS anomaly_flag,
 GREATEST(COALESCE(f.finished_at::date,CURRENT_DATE)-f.started_at::date-p.cycle_target_days,0)::numeric AS overdue_days
 FROM classified f CROSS JOIN parameters p WHERE f.status_code IS NOT NULL
 /*TIME_BEGIN*/ AND f.started_at>=CAST(:start_date AS timestamp) AND f.started_at<CAST(:end_exclusive AS timestamp) /*TIME_END*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D003*/ AND f.d003 IN (:product_types) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D003*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D006*/ AND f.d006 IN (:customer_ids) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D049*/ AND f.order_no IN (:order_numbers) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D049*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D024*/ AND f.status_code IN (:status_codes) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D024*//*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D_SHIPMENT_ABNORMAL*/ AND (CASE WHEN f.status_code IN ('overdue_completed','overdue_uncompleted') THEN '是' WHEN f.status_code IN ('normal_completed','normal_uncompleted','imminent_uncompleted') THEN '否' ELSE NULL END) IN (:shipment_abnormal_flags) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D_SHIPMENT_ABNORMAL*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D045*/ AND (CASE WHEN f.status_code IN ('overdue_uncompleted','overdue_completed') THEN '是' WHEN f.status_code IN ('imminent_uncompleted','normal_uncompleted','normal_completed') THEN '否' ELSE NULL END) IN (:anomaly_flags) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D045*/
), shipments_distinct AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT s.new_ord_shipmentid::text AS fact_id,s.new_salesorderid::text AS order_id,
 s.new_totalqty::numeric*p.new_electricquantity::numeric AS energy_kwh,s.new_money::numeric AS amount_yuan,
 (s.new_totalqty IS NULL OR s.new_totalqty<0 OR p.new_electricquantity IS NULL OR p.new_electricquantity<=0) AS energy_issue
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb" s
 LEFT JOIN __repl_product p ON p.productid=s.new_product_id
 WHERE s.statecode=0 AND s.new_ord_shipmentid IS NOT NULL AND s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp<=NOW()
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM selected_orders x WHERE x.fact_id=s.new_salesorderid::text)
), shipments_checked AS (
 SELECT *,count(*) OVER(PARTITION BY fact_id) AS copies FROM shipments_distinct
), shipment_amounts AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT order_id,CASE WHEN bool_or(copies>1 OR energy_issue) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(energy_kwh)/1000000::numeric END AS energy_gwh,
 CASE WHEN bool_or(copies>1 OR amount_yuan IS NULL) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(amount_yuan)/100000000::numeric END AS amount_yi
 FROM shipments_checked GROUP BY order_id
), detailed AS (
 SELECT f.*,progress.project_blocker,progress.project_next_step,s.energy_gwh,s.amount_yi,s.order_id AS shipment_order
 FROM selected_orders f LEFT JOIN shipment_amounts s ON s.order_id=f.fact_id
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
 SELECT NULLIF(btrim(pp.new_question_resource::text),'') AS project_blocker,NULLIF(btrim(pp.new_actionplan::text),'') AS project_next_step
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_projectprocess_esb" pp WHERE pp.new_opportunity_id::text=f.opportunity_id
 AND COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(pp.modifiedon::text),''),NULLIF(btrim(pp.createdon::text),''))::timestamp<=NOW()
 ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(pp.modifiedon::text),''),NULLIF(btrim(pp.createdon::text),''))::timestamp DESC NULLS LAST,pp.new_projectprocessid DESC LIMIT 1
 ) progress ON TRUE
), filtered AS (
 SELECT f.* FROM detailed f WHERE TRUE
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D_PROJECT_BLOCKER*/ AND f.project_blocker IN (:project_blockers) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D_PROJECT_BLOCKER*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D_PROJECT_NEXT_STEP*/ AND f.project_next_step IN (:project_next_steps) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D_PROJECT_NEXT_STEP*/
)
SELECT f.d003 AS "YWLN_D003",f.d006 AS "YWLN_D006",f.order_no AS "YWLN_D049",
 f.project_blocker AS "YWLN_D_PROJECT_BLOCKER",f.project_next_step AS "YWLN_D_PROJECT_NEXT_STEP",
 CASE WHEN f.shipment_order IS NULL THEN 0::numeric ELSE f.energy_gwh END AS "YWLN_M0035",

), product_energy AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT (productid||'') AS productid,new_electricquantity ,"productnumber","new_system_energy" FROM __repl_product
), shipment_measures AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT 'm0'::text AS measure_tag,s.new_ord_shipmentid AS fact_id,
   (s.new_totalqty*p.new_electricquantity)::numeric/1000000::numeric AS energy_value,
   s.amount_yuan/100000000::numeric AS amount_value,
   (COALESCE(s.new_totalqty IS NULL OR s.new_totalqty<0 OR p.new_electricquantity IS NULL OR p.new_electricquantity<=0,FALSE)

   (i.new_qty*__actual_energy.new_system_energy)::numeric/1000000::numeric AS energy_value,

   (COALESCE(__actual_energy.new_system_energy IS NULL OR __actual_energy.new_system_energy<=0,FALSE)
     OR i.new_ord_shipmentitemid IS NULL OR (i.new_qty*__actual_energy.new_system_energy) IS NULL) AS energy_invalid,
   (COALESCE(p.new_electricquantity IS NULL OR p.new_electricquantity<=0,FALSE) OR i.new_amount IS NULL) AS amount_invalid,(__actual_energy.new_system_energy>0) AS energy_covered
 FROM active_shipments s

 -(CASE WHEN COALESCE(bool_or(energy_invalid OR fact_copies>1) FILTER(WHERE measure_tag='m1' AND energy_covered),FALSE) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(energy_value) FILTER(WHERE measure_tag='m1' AND energy_covered) END) ELSE NULL END AS "YWLN_M0145",
 (CASE WHEN COALESCE(bool_or(amount_invalid OR fact_copies>1) FILTER(WHERE measure_tag='m0'),FALSE) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(amount_value) FILTER(WHERE measure_tag='m0') END)
 -(CASE WHEN COALESCE(bool_or(amount_invalid OR fact_copies>1) FILTER(WHERE measure_tag='m1'),FALSE) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(amount_value) FILTER(WHERE measure_tag='m1') END) AS "YWLN_M0149"

 WHEN d.new_approved_time::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND d.new_approved_time::date-d.new_oasubmitdate::date>p.cycle_target_days THEN 'overdue_completed'

 CASE WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN NULLIF(btrim(o.new_accproducttype::text),'') IS NULL THEN '其他' WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯' WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK' ELSE '其他' END AS d003,
 COALESCE(o.ownerid,d.quote_owner)::text AS owner_id,o.new_accountlevel::text AS d005,(SELECT NULLIF(btrim(a.name::text),'') FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" a WHERE a.accountid::text=o.parentaccountid::text) AS d006,NULL::text AS status_code,
 (SELECT CASE WHEN ((d.approval='2' AND d.new_approved_time::timestamp IS NULL) OR (d.approval='3' AND d.new_approved_time::timestamp IS NOT NULL)) AND d.new_oasubmitdate::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND d.new_oasubmitdate::timestamp<=NOW()
 AND (d.new_approved_time::timestamp IS NULL OR (d.new_approved_time::timestamp>=d.new_oasubmitdate::timestamp AND d.new_approved_time::timestamp<=NOW())) AND p.enabled AND p.cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL THEN
 CASE WHEN d.new_approved_time::timestamp IS NULL AND CURRENT_DATE-d.new_oasubmitdate::date>p.cycle_target_days THEN 'overdue_uncompleted'
 WHEN d.new_approved_time::timestamp IS NULL AND p.cycle_target_days-(CURRENT_DATE-d.new_oasubmitdate::date) BETWEEN 0 AND p.imminent_days THEN 'imminent_uncompleted'
 WHEN d.new_approved_time::timestamp IS NULL AND p.cycle_target_days-(CURRENT_DATE-d.new_oasubmitdate::date)>p.imminent_days THEN 'normal_uncompleted'
 WHEN d.new_approved_time::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND d.new_approved_time::date-d.new_oasubmitdate::date>p.cycle_target_days THEN 'overdue_completed'
 WHEN d.new_approved_time::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND d.new_approved_time::date-d.new_oasubmitdate::date<=p.cycle_target_days THEN 'normal_completed' END END
 FROM (SELECT dimension_code,cycle_target_days,imminent_days,
 (cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL AND cycle_target_days>=0
  AND imminent_days IS NOT NULL AND imminent_days BETWEEN 0 AND cycle_target_days) AS enabled
FROM (
 SELECT dimension_code,
  max(config_value) FILTER(WHERE config_key=replace(dimension_code,'YWLN_','')||'_CYCLE_TARGET_DAYS') AS cycle_target_days,
  max(config_value) FILTER(WHERE config_key=replace(dimension_code,'YWLN_','')||'_IMMINENT_DAYS') AS imminent_days
 FROM ded_public."x360_static_metric_config"
 WHERE config_set='MOCK' AND period_key='GLOBAL'
   AND config_group='HELMET' AND enabled
 GROUP BY dimension_code
) v) p WHERE p.dimension_code='YWLN_D021') AS helmet_status,
 (o.new_accountlevel::text IN ('1','2') OR o.new_risklevel::text IN ('1','2')) AS is_key,
 pr.material_type,COALESCE(pr.matches,0)<>1 OR pr.material_type IS NULL AS material_issue,
 (d.approval='6' AND d.new_oasubmitdate::timestamp IS NULL) AS source_issue,
 (CURRENT_DATE-d.new_oasubmitdate::date) AS elapsed_days
 FROM chosen d LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" o ON o.opportunityid=d.new_opportunity_id
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COUNT(*) AS matches,MIN(p.new_productype::text) AS material_type
 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT productid,new_productype FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_product_esb" WHERE productid::text=d.new_product_id::text) p) pr ON TRUE
) f WHERE f.approval='2' AND f.new_oasubmitdate::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND f.new_oasubmitdate::timestamp<=NOW() AND f.elapsed_days>7 AND f.energy_kwh IS NOT NULL
), checked AS (SELECT *,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY measure_tag,fact_id) AS fact_copies FROM measure_rows),
 scoped AS (SELECT f.*,NULL::text AS d004 FROM checked f 
 WHERE ((SELECT start_at FROM bounds) IS NULL OR (f.fact_date>=(SELECT start_at FROM bounds) AND f.fact_date<(SELECT end_at FROM bounds)) OR f.poison_time)
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D002*/ AND f.d002 IN (:product_lines) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D002*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D003*/ AND f.d003 IN (:product_types) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D003*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D004*/ AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" tm JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb" t ON t."teamid"=tm."teamid"
 WHERE tm."systemuserid"::text=f.owner_id AND t."name"::text IN (:team_ids)) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D004*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D005*/ AND f.d005 IN (:customer_levels) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D005*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D006*/ AND f.d006 IN (:customer_ids) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D021*/ AND (f.helmet_status IN (:status_codes) OR (CASE f.helmet_status WHEN 'overdue_uncompleted' THEN '逾期未完成' WHEN 'imminent_uncompleted' THEN '临期未完成' WHEN 'normal_uncompleted' THEN '正常未完成' WHEN 'overdue_completed' THEN '逾期完成' WHEN 'normal_completed' THEN '正常完成' END) IN (:status_codes)) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D021*//*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D_QUOTE_ABNORMAL*/ AND (CASE WHEN f.helmet_status IN ('overdue_completed','overdue_uncompleted') THEN '是' WHEN f.helmet_status IN ('normal_completed','normal_uncompleted','imminent_uncompleted') THEN '否' ELSE NULL END) IN (:quote_abnormal_flags) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D_QUOTE_ABNORMAL*/
)
SELECT (CASE WHEN COALESCE(bool_or(f.invalid OR f.fact_copies>1) FILTER(WHERE f.measure_tag='m0'),FALSE) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(f.metric_value) FILTER(WHERE f.measure_tag='m0') END) AS "YWLN_M0178" FROM scoped f GROUP BY ()
) AS __x360_gov_result

WITH __ont_request AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  /*TIME_BEGIN*/
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(:start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
    CAST(:end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP) /*TIME_END*/
), __ont_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM __ont_request
), __ont_accounts_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    a.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_accounts AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM __ont_accounts_ranked
  WHERE
    __ont_rn = 1
), __ont_opportunity_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_opportunity AS (
  SELECT
    o.*
  FROM __ont_opportunity_ranked AS o
  WHERE
    o.__ont_rn = 1
), __ont_forecast_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    m.*,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL), 0) / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS __ont_energy_mwh,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS m
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND m.new_accountdate IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      b.start_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= b.start_at
    )
    AND (
      b.end_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < b.end_at
    )
), __ont_forecast AS (
  SELECT
    m.*
  FROM __ont_forecast_ranked AS m
  JOIN __ont_opportunity AS o
    ON o.opportunityid = m.new_opportunity_id
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    m.__ont_rn = 1
    AND (
      o.createdon IS NULL
      OR CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) <= LEAST(
        COALESCE(b.end_at, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)),
        CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)
      )
    )
), __ont_owner_teams AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS ownerid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), '')) = 1
      THEN MIN(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), ''))
    END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb AS t
    ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
  GROUP BY
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)
), __x360_signed_via_order_lines_20261113 AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(__sign_line.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunityid
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS __sign_line
  JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb AS __sign_order
    ON __sign_order.salesorderid = __sign_line.salesorderid
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__sign_line.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__sign_line.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND __sign_order.salesorderid IS NOT NULL
), __signed_order_source AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    (
      sx.opportunityid || ''
    ) AS opportunityid,
    (
      sx.salesorderid || ''
    ) AS salesorderid,
    (
      sx.new_salesorderid || ''
    ) AS new_salesorderid,
    sx.statecode,
    sx.new_changetype,
    sx.new_changestatus,
    sx.new_approval_time
  FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" AS sx
), __signed_keys_0 AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    (
      sign_stage.opportunityid || ''
    ) AS opportunityid
  FROM __ont_opportunity AS sign_stage
  WHERE
    sign_stage.new_contractconfirmation = 1
), shared_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    start_at,
    end_at
  FROM __ont_bounds
)
SELECT
  (
    WITH requested AS (
      SELECT
        start_at,
        end_at
      FROM shared_bounds
    ), bounds AS (
      SELECT
        MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
        MAX(end_at) AS end_at
      FROM requested
    ), measure_rows AS (
      SELECT DISTINCT
        CAST('m0' AS TEXT) AS measure_tag,
        CAST(f.fact_id AS TEXT),
        CAST(f.fact_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
        CAST((
          f.energy_mwh
        ) AS DECIMAL) / CAST(1000 AS DECIMAL) AS metric_value,
        (
          COALESCE(f.source_issue, FALSE) OR COALESCE((
            FALSE
          ), FALSE)
        ) AS invalid,
        (
          FALSE
        ) AS poison_time,
        f.d002,
        f.d003,
        f.owner_id,
        f.d005,
        f.d006,
        f.status_code,
        f.helmet_status AS helmet_status
      FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
          CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS fact_id,
          CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
          CAST(o.new_salesbg AS TEXT) AS d002,
          CASE
            WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL
            THEN NULL
            WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
            THEN '其他'
            WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
            THEN '电芯'
            WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
            THEN 'PACK'
            ELSE '其他'
          END AS d003,
          CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
          CAST(o.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS d005,
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(acc_o.name AS TEXT)), '') AS d006,
          CASE
            WHEN EXISTS(
              SELECT
                1
              FROM __x360_signed_via_order_lines_20261113 AS __sign_match
              WHERE
                __sign_match.opportunityid = CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)
            )
            THEN 'signed_opportunity'
            ELSE 'unsigned_opportunity'
          END AS status_code,
          CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS helmet_status,
          (
            CAST(o.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) IN ('1', '2')
            OR CAST(o.new_risklevel AS TEXT) IN ('1', '2')
          ) AS is_key,
          CAST((
            m.new_forecast_amt_rmb / NULLIF(m.new_whprice, 0) / 1000000
          ) AS DECIMAL) AS energy_mwh,
          m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS amount_yuan,
          TRUE AS amount_period_valid,
          FALSE AS source_issue
        FROM __ont_forecast AS m
        JOIN __ont_opportunity AS o
          LEFT JOIN __ont_accounts AS acc_o
            ON acc_o.accountid = o.parentaccountid
          ON o.opportunityid = m.new_opportunity_id
        WHERE
          m.new_oppmonthid IS NOT NULL AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
      ) AS f
      WHERE
        f.status_code = 'signed_opportunity' AND f.energy_mwh IS NOT NULL
    ), checked AS (
      SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY measure_tag, fact_id) AS fact_copies
      FROM measure_rows
    ), scoped AS (
      SELECT
        f.*,
        CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS d004
      FROM checked AS f
      WHERE
        (
          (
            SELECT
              start_at
            FROM bounds
          ) IS NULL
          OR (
            f.fact_date >= (
              SELECT
                start_at
              FROM bounds
            )
            AND f.fact_date < (
              SELECT
                end_at
              FROM bounds
            )
          )
          OR f.poison_time
        )
    )
    SELECT
      (
        SUM(f.metric_value) FILTER(WHERE
          f.measure_tag = 'm0')
      ) AS "YWLN_M0194"
    FROM scoped AS f
    GROUP BY
      ()
  ) AS "YWLN_M0194",
  (
    WITH requested AS (
      SELECT
        start_at,
        end_at
      FROM shared_bounds
    ), bounds AS (
      SELECT
        MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
        MAX(end_at) AS end_at
      FROM requested
    ), measure_rows AS (
      SELECT DISTINCT
        CAST('m0' AS TEXT) AS measure_tag,
        CAST(f.fact_id AS TEXT),
        CAST(f.fact_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
        CAST((
          f.amount_yuan
        ) AS DECIMAL) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS metric_value,
        (
          COALESCE(f.source_issue, FALSE) OR COALESCE((
            FALSE
          ), FALSE)
        ) AS invalid,
        (
          FALSE
        ) AS poison_time,
        f.d002,
        f.d003,
        f.owner_id,
        f.d005,
        f.d006,
        f.status_code,
        f.helmet_status AS helmet_status
      FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
          CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS fact_id,
          CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
          CAST(o.new_salesbg AS TEXT) AS d002,
          CASE
            WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL
            THEN NULL
            WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
            THEN '其他'
            WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
            THEN '电芯'
            WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
            THEN 'PACK'
            ELSE '其他'
          END AS d003,
          CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
          CAST(o.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS d005,
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(acc_o.name AS TEXT)), '') AS d006,
          CASE
            WHEN EXISTS(
              SELECT
                1
              FROM __x360_signed_via_order_lines_20261113 AS __sign_match
              WHERE
                __sign_match.opportunityid = CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)
            )
            THEN 'signed_opportunity'
            ELSE 'unsigned_opportunity'
          END AS status_code,
          CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS helmet_status,
          (
            CAST(o.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) IN ('1', '2')
            OR CAST(o.new_risklevel AS TEXT) IN ('1', '2')
          ) AS is_key,
          CAST((
            m.new_forecast_amt_rmb / NULLIF(m.new_whprice, 0) / 1000000
          ) AS DECIMAL) AS energy_mwh,
          m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS amount_yuan,
          TRUE AS amount_period_valid,
          FALSE AS source_issue
        FROM __ont_forecast AS m
        JOIN __ont_opportunity AS o
          LEFT JOIN __ont_accounts AS acc_o
            ON acc_o.accountid = o.parentaccountid
          ON o.opportunityid = m.new_opportunity_id
        WHERE
          m.new_oppmonthid IS NOT NULL AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
      ) AS f
      WHERE
        f.status_code = 'signed_opportunity' AND TRUE AND f.amount_yuan IS NOT NULL
    ), checked AS (
      SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY measure_tag, fact_id) AS fact_copies
      FROM measure_rows
    ), scoped AS (
      SELECT
        f.*,
        CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS d004
      FROM checked AS f
      WHERE
        (
          (
            SELECT
              start_at
            FROM bounds
          ) IS NULL
          OR (
            f.fact_date >= (
              SELECT
                start_at
              FROM bounds
            )
            AND f.fact_date < (
              SELECT
                end_at
              FROM bounds
            )
          )
          OR f.poison_time
        )
    )
    SELECT
      (
        SUM(f.metric_value) FILTER(WHERE
          f.measure_tag = 'm0')
      ) AS "YWLN_M0198"
    FROM scoped AS f
    GROUP BY
      ()
  ) AS "YWLN_M0198"
