sql.Q152:
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT max(config_value) FILTER (WHERE config_key='D024_CYCLE_TARGET_DAYS') AS cycle_target_days,
           max(config_value) FILTER (WHERE config_key='D024_IMMINENT_DAYS') AS imminent_days
    FROM ded_public."x360_static_metric_config"
    WHERE config_set='MOCK' AND period_key='GLOBAL' AND config_group='HELMET'
      AND dimension_code='YWLN_D024' AND enabled
), cancelled_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT new_salesorderid::text AS order_id
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb"
    WHERE TRUE AND salesorderid<>new_salesorderid
      AND TRUE AND new_changestatus::text='8'
      AND new_approval_time::timestamp<=NOW()
), order_distinct AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT so.salesorderid::text AS fact_id,
           so.new_approval_time::timestamp AS started_at,
           o.new_salesbg::text AS d002,
           CASE WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL THEN NULL
                WHEN NULLIF(btrim(o.new_accproducttype::text),'') IS NULL THEN '其他'
                WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯'
                WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK'
                ELSE '其他' END AS d003,
           COALESCE(o.ownerid,so.ownerid)::text AS owner_id,
           COALESCE(c.new_accountlevel::text,o.new_accountlevel::text) AS d005,
           NULLIF(btrim(c.name::text),'') AS d006
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" so
    LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" o ON o.opportunityid=(SELECT MIN(d.new_opportunity_id) FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb" d WHERE d.salesorderid=so.salesorderid AND NULLIF(BTRIM(d.new_opportunity_id::text),'') IS NOT NULL HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.new_opportunity_id)=1)
    LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" c ON c.accountid=so.customerid
    WHERE so.salesorderid IS NOT NULL AND so.new_salesordertype::text='1'
      AND so.new_order_category::text IN ('1','3') AND so.statecode=0
      AND so.new_ord_oa_state::text='5'
      AND NOT COALESCE(TRUE AND so.new_changestatus::text='8'
                       AND so.new_approval_time::timestamp<=NOW(),FALSE)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cancelled_orders x WHERE x.order_id=so.salesorderid::text)
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT *,count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY fact_id) AS id_copies FROM order_distinct
), line_distinct AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT l.salesorderid::text AS order_id,l.salesorderdetailid::text AS line_id,
           l.new_dischargecapacity::numeric AS energy_kwh
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb" l
    WHERE l.salesorderdetailid IS NOT NULL
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.fact_id=l.salesorderid::text)
      AND (l.new_effectivedate::timestamp IS NULL OR l.new_effectivedate::timestamp<=NOW())
      AND (l.new_expirydate::timestamp IS NULL OR l.new_expirydate::timestamp>NOW())
), lines_checked AS (
    SELECT *,count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id,line_id) AS copies FROM line_distinct
), line_totals AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT order_id,CASE WHEN bool_or(copies>1 OR energy_kwh IS NULL) THEN NULL
                        ELSE sum(energy_kwh) END AS energy_kwh
    FROM lines_checked GROUP BY order_id
), first_shipment AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT s.new_salesorderid::text AS order_id,min(s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp) AS finished_at
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb" s
    WHERE s.statecode=0 AND TRUE AND s.new_shipping2_date IS NOT NULL
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.fact_id=s.new_salesorderid::text)
    GROUP BY s.new_salesorderid::text
), source_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT o.*,l.energy_kwh,s.finished_at FROM orders o
    LEFT JOIN line_totals l ON l.order_id=o.fact_id
    LEFT JOIN first_shipment s ON s.order_id=o.fact_id
), classified AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT f.*,CASE
        WHEN f.id_copies=1 AND f.started_at IS NOT NULL AND f.started_at<=NOW()
         AND (f.finished_at IS NULL OR (f.finished_at>=f.started_at AND f.finished_at<=NOW()))
         AND p.cycle_target_days>=0 AND p.imminent_days BETWEEN 0 AND p.cycle_target_days
        THEN CASE
            WHEN f.finished_at IS NULL AND CURRENT_DATE-f.started_at::date>p.cycle_target_days
                THEN 'overdue_uncompleted'
            WHEN f.finished_at IS NULL AND p.cycle_target_days-(CURRENT_DATE-f.started_at::date) BETWEEN 0 AND p.imminent_days
                THEN 'imminent_uncompleted'
            WHEN f.finished_at IS NULL AND p.cycle_target_days-(CURRENT_DATE-f.started_at::date)>p.imminent_days
                THEN 'normal_uncompleted'
            WHEN f.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND f.finished_at::date-f.started_at::date>p.cycle_target_days
                THEN 'overdue_completed'
            WHEN f.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND f.finished_at::date-f.started_at::date<=p.cycle_target_days
                THEN 'normal_completed'
        END END AS status_code
    FROM source_rows f CROSS JOIN parameters p
), scoped AS (
    SELECT f.* FROM classified f WHERE f.status_code IS NOT NULL
    /*TIME_BEGIN*/ AND f.started_at>=CAST(:start_date AS timestamp) AND f.started_at<CAST(:end_exclusive AS timestamp) /*TIME_END*/
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D002*/ AND f.d002 IN (:product_lines) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D002*/
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D003*/ AND f.d003 IN (:product_types) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D003*/
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D004*/ AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" tm
        JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb" t ON t."teamid"=tm."teamid"
        WHERE tm."systemuserid"::text=f.owner_id AND t."name"::text IN (:team_ids)
    ) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D004*/
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D005*/ AND (f.d005 IN (:customer_levels) OR CASE f.d005
        WHEN '1' THEN '战略大客户' WHEN '2' THEN '重要大客户' WHEN '3' THEN '一般客户'
        WHEN '4' THEN 'BG大客户' ELSE f.d005 END IN (:customer_levels)) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D005*/
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D006*/ AND (f.d006 IN (:customer_ids) OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" a
        WHERE a.accountid::text IN (:customer_ids) AND NULLIF(btrim(a.name::text),'')=f.d006
    )) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D024*/ AND (f.status_code IN (:status_codes) OR (CASE f.status_code WHEN 'overdue_uncompleted' THEN '逾期未完成' WHEN 'imminent_uncompleted' THEN '临期未完成' WHEN 'normal_uncompleted' THEN '正常未完成' WHEN 'overdue_completed' THEN '逾期完成' WHEN 'normal_completed' THEN '正常完成' END) IN (:status_codes)) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D024*//*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D_SHIPMENT_ABNORMAL*/ AND (CASE WHEN f.status_code IN ('overdue_completed','overdue_uncompleted') THEN '是' WHEN f.status_code IN ('normal_completed','normal_uncompleted','imminent_uncompleted') THEN '否' ELSE NULL END) IN (:shipment_abnormal_flags) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D_SHIPMENT_ABNORMAL*/
)
SELECT f.status_code AS "YWLN_D024",sum(f.energy_kwh)/1000000::numeric AS "YWLN_M0312"
FROM scoped f GROUP BY f.status_code
sql.Q153:
WITH __source AS MATERIALIZED (
WITH
__requested AS (
 SELECT NULL::timestamp AS start_at,NULL::timestamp AS end_at
 /*TIME_BEGIN*/ WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT CAST(:start_date AS timestamp),CAST(:end_exclusive AS timestamp) /*TIME_END*/
),
__bounds AS (SELECT MAX(start_at) AS start_at,MAX(end_at) AS end_at FROM __requested),
__flt_YWLN_D002(v) AS (SELECT NULL::text WHERE FALSE
/*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D002*/ UNION ALL SELECT unnest(CAST(ARRAY[:product_lines] AS text[])) AS v /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D002*/),
__flt_YWLN_D003(v) AS (SELECT NULL::text WHERE FALSE
/*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D003*/ UNION ALL SELECT unnest(CAST(ARRAY[:product_types] AS text[])) AS v /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D003*/),
__flt_YWLN_D004(v) AS (SELECT NULL::text WHERE FALSE
/*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D004*/ UNION ALL SELECT unnest(CAST(ARRAY[:team_ids] AS text[])) AS v /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D004*/),
__flt_YWLN_D005(v) AS (SELECT NULL::text WHERE FALSE
/*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D005*/ UNION ALL SELECT unnest(CAST(ARRAY[:customer_levels] AS text[])) AS v /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D005*/),
__flt_YWLN_D006(v) AS (SELECT NULL::text WHERE FALSE
/*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D006*/ UNION ALL SELECT unnest(CAST(ARRAY[:customer_ids] AS text[])) AS v /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/),
__flt_YWLN_D045(v) AS (SELECT NULL::text WHERE FALSE
/*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D045*/ UNION ALL SELECT unnest(CAST(ARRAY[:anomaly_flags] AS text[])) AS v /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D045*/),
__order_raw AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT so.salesorderid::text AS salesorderid,so.ordernumber::text AS order_no,
 so.customerid::text AS customerid,NULLIF(btrim(so.new_customeridname::text),'') AS customer_name,so.opportunityid::text AS opportunityid,
 so.ownerid::text AS ownerid,so.new_amount::numeric AS order_amount,so.createdon::timestamp AS createdon
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" so CROSS JOIN __bounds b
 WHERE so.salesorderid IS NOT NULL AND so.statecode=0 AND so.createdon::timestamp<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
 AND (b.start_at IS NULL OR (so.createdon::timestamp>=b.start_at AND so.createdon::timestamp<b.end_at))
),
__orders AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT salesorderid,MIN(order_no) AS order_no,MIN(customerid) AS customerid,MIN(customer_name) AS customer_name,
 MIN(opportunityid) AS opportunityid,MIN(ownerid) AS ownerid,MIN(order_amount) AS order_amount,
 COUNT(*)>1 AS source_issue FROM __order_raw GROUP BY salesorderid
),
__line_raw AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT l.salesorderdetailid::text AS salesorderdetailid,l.salesorderid::text AS salesorderid,
 l.new_product_id::text AS new_product_id,l.lineitemnumber,l.new_opportunity_id::text AS new_opportunity_id,
 l.quantity::numeric AS quantity,l.new_productnumber::text AS product_code,l.uomid::text AS uom_id,l.requestdeliveryby::timestamp AS requestdeliveryby,
 l.modifiedon::timestamp AS modifiedon,l.new_effectivedate::timestamp AS new_effectivedate FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb" l
 WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __orders o WHERE o.salesorderid=l.salesorderid::text)
),
__line_ranked AS (
 SELECT l.*,DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY salesorderdetailid ORDER BY modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST) AS latest_rank
 FROM __line_raw l WHERE l.salesorderdetailid IS NOT NULL AND l.modifiedon<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
),
__line_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT salesorderdetailid,MIN(salesorderid) AS salesorderid,MIN(new_product_id) AS new_product_id,
 MIN(lineitemnumber) AS lineitemnumber,MIN(new_opportunity_id) AS new_opportunity_id,
 MIN(quantity) AS quantity,MIN(product_code) AS product_code,MIN(uom_id) AS uom_id,MIN(requestdeliveryby) AS requestdeliveryby,
 MIN(new_effectivedate) AS new_effectivedate,COUNT(*)>1 AS source_issue
 FROM __line_ranked WHERE latest_rank=1 GROUP BY salesorderdetailid
),
__active_lines AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT l.* FROM __line_latest l WHERE (l.new_effectivedate IS NULL OR l.new_effectivedate<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
 
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __orders o WHERE o.salesorderid=l.salesorderid)
),
__order_totals AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT salesorderid,SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity,
 BOOL_OR(source_issue OR quantity IS NULL OR quantity<0) OR SUM(quantity)<=0 AS quantity_issue,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(btrim(new_opportunity_id),''))=1 THEN MIN(NULLIF(btrim(new_opportunity_id),'')) END AS unique_opportunityid
 FROM __active_lines GROUP BY salesorderid
),
__shipment_header_source AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT s.new_ord_shipmentid,s.new_shipping2_date,s.statecode,s.modifiedon
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb" s
),
__shipment_item_source AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT i.new_ord_shipmentitemid,i.new_ord_shipment_id,i.new_ord_salesorder_id,i.new_seq,
 i.new_product_id,i.new_productcode,i.new_uom_id,i.new_qty,i.statecode,i.modifiedon
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipmentitem_esb" i WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __orders o WHERE o.salesorderid=i.new_ord_salesorder_id::text)
),
__actual_header_distinct AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT new_ord_shipmentid::text AS shipment_id,new_shipping2_date::timestamp AS shipped_at,
 statecode,modifiedon::timestamp AS modified_at FROM __shipment_header_source
),
__actual_header_ranked AS (
 SELECT s.*,DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY shipment_id ORDER BY modified_at DESC NULLS LAST) AS latest_rank
 FROM __actual_header_distinct s WHERE shipment_id IS NOT NULL AND modified_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
),
__actual_headers AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT shipment_id,MIN(shipped_at) AS shipped_at,MIN(statecode) AS statecode,COUNT(*)>1 AS version_issue
 FROM __actual_header_ranked WHERE latest_rank=1 GROUP BY shipment_id
),
__actual_item_distinct AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT new_ord_shipmentitemid::text AS item_id,new_ord_shipment_id::text AS shipment_id,
 new_ord_salesorder_id::text AS order_id,new_seq::text AS seq_raw,new_product_id::text AS product_id,
 new_productcode::text AS product_code,new_uom_id::text AS uom_id,new_qty::numeric AS shipped_qty,
 statecode,modifiedon::timestamp AS modified_at FROM __shipment_item_source
),
__actual_item_ranked AS (
 SELECT i.*,DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY item_id ORDER BY modified_at DESC NULLS LAST) AS latest_rank
 FROM __actual_item_distinct i WHERE item_id IS NOT NULL AND modified_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
),
__actual_items AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT item_id,MIN(shipment_id) AS shipment_id,MIN(order_id) AS order_id,MIN(seq_raw) AS seq_raw,
 MIN(product_id) AS product_id,MIN(product_code) AS product_code,MIN(uom_id) AS uom_id,
 MIN(shipped_qty) AS shipped_qty,MIN(statecode) AS statecode,COUNT(*)>1 AS version_issue
 FROM __actual_item_ranked WHERE latest_rank=1 GROUP BY item_id
),
__actual_joined AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT i.*,s.shipment_id AS matched_header_id,s.shipped_at,s.statecode AS header_state,
 s.version_issue AS header_version_issue,
 CASE WHEN btrim(i.seq_raw) ~ '^[0-9]+([.]0+)?$' THEN btrim(i.seq_raw)::numeric END AS normalized_seq
 FROM __actual_items i JOIN __orders o ON o.salesorderid=i.order_id
 LEFT JOIN __actual_headers s ON s.shipment_id=i.shipment_id
),
__actual_eligible AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT * FROM __actual_joined WHERE statecode=0 AND header_state=0 AND shipped_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
),
__actual_matches AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT i.item_id,COUNT(l.salesorderdetailid) AS line_matches,
 MIN(l.salesorderdetailid) AS line_id,MIN(l.uom_id) AS line_uom_id
 FROM __actual_eligible i LEFT JOIN __line_latest l ON l.salesorderid=i.order_id
 AND l.lineitemnumber::numeric=i.normalized_seq
 AND (l.new_product_id=i.product_id OR NULLIF(btrim(i.product_code),'')=NULLIF(btrim(l.product_code),''))
 GROUP BY i.item_id
),
__actual_linked AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT i.*,m.line_matches,m.line_id,
 COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(i.uom_id),'') IS NOT NULL
 AND NULLIF(btrim(i.uom_id),'')=NULLIF(btrim(m.line_uom_id),''),FALSE) AS same_uom
 FROM __actual_eligible i JOIN __actual_matches m ON m.item_id=i.item_id
),
__actual_problem_rows AS (
 SELECT order_id,CASE WHEN version_issue OR header_version_issue THEN '发货版本冲突'
 WHEN line_matches<>1 THEN '发货明细无法唯一关联订单行'
 WHEN NOT same_uom THEN '发货与订单计量单位不一致或缺失'
 WHEN shipped_qty IS NULL THEN '实际发货数量缺失' END AS reason
 FROM __actual_linked
 WHERE version_issue OR header_version_issue OR line_matches<>1 OR NOT same_uom OR shipped_qty IS NULL
 UNION ALL
 SELECT order_id,CASE WHEN matched_header_id IS NULL THEN '发货明细找不到可用发货主表'
 WHEN version_issue OR header_version_issue THEN '发货版本冲突'
 ELSE '有效发货单缺实际发货时间' END AS reason
 FROM __actual_joined WHERE statecode=0 AND
 (matched_header_id IS NULL OR version_issue OR header_version_issue OR (header_state=0 AND shipped_at IS NULL))
),
__actual_bad_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT order_id,string_agg(DISTINCT reason,'、' ORDER BY reason) AS reason
 FROM __actual_problem_rows GROUP BY order_id
),
__actual_by_line AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT line_id,SUM(shipped_qty) AS net_shipped_qty,
 BOOL_OR(shipped_qty IS NULL OR version_issue OR header_version_issue OR NOT same_uom) AS source_issue
 FROM __actual_linked WHERE line_matches=1 GROUP BY line_id
),
__line_balances AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT l.salesorderdetailid AS line_id,l.quantity AS ordered_qty,
 COALESCE(s.net_shipped_qty,0) AS net_shipped_qty,b.reason AS actual_problem,
 l.source_issue OR COALESCE(s.source_issue,FALSE) OR b.order_id IS NOT NULL
 OR l.quantity IS NULL OR l.quantity<0 OR COALESCE(s.net_shipped_qty,0)<0
 OR COALESCE(s.net_shipped_qty,0)>l.quantity AS quantity_issue
 FROM __active_lines l LEFT JOIN __actual_by_line s ON s.line_id=l.salesorderdetailid
 LEFT JOIN __actual_bad_orders b ON b.order_id=l.salesorderid
),
__pending_by_line AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT line_id,CASE WHEN quantity_issue THEN NULL ELSE ordered_qty-net_shipped_qty END AS pending_qty,
 CASE WHEN quantity_issue THEN NULL ELSE net_shipped_qty END AS net_shipped_qty,
 quantity_issue,actual_problem,FALSE AS energy_product_issue,
 CASE WHEN quantity_issue OR ordered_qty-net_shipped_qty>0 THEN 1::bigint END AS plan_rows
 FROM __line_balances
),
__opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT o.opportunityid::text AS opportunityid,o.new_salesbg::text AS d002,
 CASE WHEN NULLIF(btrim(o.new_accproducttype::text),'') IS NULL THEN '其他'
 WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯' WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK' ELSE '其他' END AS d003,
 o.new_accountlevel::text AS d005,o.ownerid::text AS owner_id,o.new_risklevel::text AS risk_level
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" o
),
__accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT NULLIF(btrim(a.name::text),'') AS customer_name,
 MIN(a.new_accountlevel)::text AS customer_level
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" a
 WHERE NULLIF(btrim(a.name::text),'') IS NOT NULL
 GROUP BY NULLIF(btrim(a.name::text),'')
),
__team_members AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT tm.systemuserid::text AS owner_id,t.teamid::text AS team_id,t.name::text AS team_name
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" tm JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb" t ON t.teamid=tm.teamid
),
__owner_teams AS (
 SELECT owner_id,string_agg(DISTINCT team_name,'、' ORDER BY team_name) AS team_names FROM __team_members GROUP BY owner_id
),
__line_base AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT l.salesorderdetailid AS line_id,l.salesorderid AS order_id,l.new_product_id AS product_id,
 l.quantity AS ordered_qty,l.requestdeliveryby AS due_at,l.requestdeliveryby::date AS due_date,l.source_issue AS line_issue,
 so.order_no,so.customerid,so.order_amount,so.source_issue AS order_issue,ot.total_quantity,ot.quantity_issue AS order_quantity_issue,
 o.d002,o.d003,a.customer_level AS d005,COALESCE(o.owner_id,so.ownerid) AS owner_id,so.customer_name AS d006,CASE WHEN COALESCE(o.d005 IN ('0','1','2') OR o.risk_level IN ('1','2'),FALSE) THEN '是' ELSE '否' END AS anomaly_flag,p.pending_qty,p.net_shipped_qty,p.actual_problem,p.quantity_issue AS pending_quantity_issue,p.plan_rows,NULL::numeric AS unit_energy_kwh,FALSE AS product_issue
 FROM __active_lines l JOIN __orders so ON so.salesorderid=l.salesorderid
 JOIN __order_totals ot ON ot.salesorderid=l.salesorderid
 LEFT JOIN __pending_by_line p ON p.line_id=l.salesorderdetailid
 
 LEFT JOIN __opportunities o ON o.opportunityid=COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(l.new_opportunity_id),''),ot.unique_opportunityid,NULLIF(btrim(so.opportunityid),''))
 LEFT JOIN __accounts a ON a.customer_name=so.customer_name
),
__line_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT f.*,team.team_names AS d004,
 CASE WHEN due_at<CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 'overdue_pending' WHEN due_at>=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 'normal_pending' END AS status_code,
 CURRENT_DATE-due_date AS overdue_days,
 CASE WHEN NOT order_issue AND NOT line_issue AND NOT COALESCE(order_quantity_issue,TRUE)
 AND order_amount IS NOT NULL AND ordered_qty>=0 AND total_quantity>0
 THEN order_amount*ordered_qty/NULLIF(total_quantity,0) END AS allocated_order_amount,
 CASE WHEN NOT order_issue AND NOT line_issue AND NOT COALESCE(order_quantity_issue,TRUE)
 AND NOT COALESCE(pending_quantity_issue,FALSE) AND order_amount IS NOT NULL
 AND pending_qty>0 AND ordered_qty>0 AND pending_qty<=ordered_qty AND total_quantity>0
 THEN order_amount*pending_qty/NULLIF(total_quantity,0) END AS pending_amount,
 CASE WHEN NOT line_issue AND NOT COALESCE(pending_quantity_issue,FALSE) AND NOT product_issue
 AND pending_qty>0 AND (ordered_qty IS NULL OR pending_qty<=ordered_qty)
 THEN pending_qty*unit_energy_kwh END AS pending_energy_kwh
 FROM __line_base f LEFT JOIN __owner_teams team ON team.owner_id=f.owner_id
),
__line_scope AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT f.* FROM __line_facts f WHERE TRUE
AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __flt_YWLN_D002) OR (f.d002 IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D002)))
AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __flt_YWLN_D003) OR (f.d003 IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D003)))
AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __flt_YWLN_D004) OR (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __team_members tm WHERE tm.owner_id=f.owner_id AND (tm.team_name IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D004) OR tm.team_id IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D004)))))
AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __flt_YWLN_D005) OR (f.d005 IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D005) OR CASE f.d005 WHEN '0' THEN '核心大客户' WHEN '1' THEN '战略大客户' WHEN '2' THEN '重要大客户' WHEN '3' THEN '一般客户' WHEN '4' THEN 'BG大客户' ELSE f.d005 END IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D005)))
AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __flt_YWLN_D006) OR (f.d006 IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D006) OR f.customerid IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D006)))
AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __flt_YWLN_D045) OR (f.anomaly_flag IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D045)))

),
__pending_scope AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT f.* FROM __line_scope f
 WHERE f.plan_rows IS NOT NULL
),
__totals AS (
 SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status_code='overdue_pending') AS overdue_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status_code='normal_pending') AS normal_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status_code IS NULL) AS missing_due_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status_code='overdue_pending' AND pending_amount IS NOT NULL) AS overdue_amount_valid_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status_code='normal_pending' AND pending_amount IS NOT NULL) AS normal_amount_valid_rows,
 SUM(pending_amount) FILTER(WHERE status_code='overdue_pending') AS overdue_amount,
 SUM(pending_amount) FILTER(WHERE status_code='normal_pending') AS normal_amount,
 SUM(pending_energy_kwh) FILTER(WHERE status_code='overdue_pending') AS overdue_energy
 FROM __pending_scope
),
__denominator AS (
 SELECT SUM(allocated_order_amount) FILTER(WHERE allocated_order_amount IS NOT NULL
 AND (plan_rows IS NULL OR (pending_amount IS NOT NULL AND status_code IS NOT NULL))) AS order_amount
 FROM __line_scope
)
SELECT CASE WHEN t.overdue_rows=0 AND t.normal_rows=0 AND t.missing_due_rows>0 THEN NULL WHEN t.overdue_rows=0 THEN 0::numeric ELSE t.overdue_amount/100000000::numeric END AS "YWLN_M0143",
CASE WHEN t.overdue_rows=0 AND t.normal_rows=0 AND t.missing_due_rows>0 THEN NULL WHEN t.normal_rows=0 THEN 0::numeric ELSE t.normal_amount/100000000::numeric END AS "YWLN_M0150"
FROM __totals t CROSS JOIN __denominator d
), __categorized AS (
 SELECT '超期订未发'::text AS "YWLN_D051",
        s."YWLN_M0143" AS "YWLN_M_PENDING_SHIPMENT_AMOUNT"
 FROM __source s
 UNION ALL
 SELECT '正常订未发'::text AS "YWLN_D051",
        s."YWLN_M0150" AS "YWLN_M_PENDING_SHIPMENT_AMOUNT"
 FROM __source s
)
SELECT "YWLN_D051","YWLN_M_PENDING_SHIPMENT_AMOUNT" FROM __categorized
/*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D051*/ WHERE "YWLN_D051" IN (:shipment_pie_states) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D051*/
sql.T001:
-- PostgreSQL只读查询；默认2025全年；无绑定参数。
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
    CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CASE
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS product_type,
    CAST(o.new_processstage AS TEXT) AS process_stage,
    CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
    CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
    CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
    CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
    CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
    CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
    CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
    CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
    CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
    CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
    CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
    CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.project_name,
    o.owner_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    o.demand_status,
    o.created_at,
    o.s1,
    o.s2,
    o.s3,
    o.s4,
    o.s5,
    a.account_name,
    a.level_code,
    o.new_cdastartdate,
    o.new_cdaenddate,
    o.new_approved_time_acneed,
    o.new_submit_time_acneed,
    o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
    o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
    o.new_sampletestpass_time,
    o.new_sampletime,
    o.new_technicalsigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_techcon,
    o.new_warrantysigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_qsl,
    o.new_isneedcda,
    o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    o.new_sampletestresult,
    a.sap_created_at,
    a.sap_submitted_at,
    a.sap_code,
    a.account_factory_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_submitted_at,
    a.account_sinosure_start,
    a.account_sinosure_end,
    a.account_credit_submitted_at,
    a.account_credit_approved_at,
    a.account_cda_start,
    a.account_cda_end,
    a.account_cda_submitted_at,
    a.account_cda_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_approval_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at IS NULL OR o.created_at <= p.cutoff
    )
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AS signed
  FROM opportunities AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
), forecast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS forecast_id,
    CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS forecast_month,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yuan,
    CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL) AS wh_price,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS m
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= p.start_date
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < p.end_exclusive
), forecast_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    f.forecast_id,
    f.forecast_month,
    o.*,
    f.amount_yuan / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    f.amount_yuan / NULLIF(f.wh_price, 0) / CAST(1000000000 AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh
  FROM forecast_rows AS f
  JOIN opportunity_flags AS o
    USING (opportunity_id)
  WHERE
    f.rn = 1
), storage_customer_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
  WITH storage_opportunity_owners AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      owner_id
    FROM (
      SELECT
        CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
          ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS rn
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
      WHERE
        NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    ) AS ranked
    WHERE
      rn = 1 AND NULLIF(TRIM(owner_id), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), storage_team_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
    JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb AS t
      ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
    WHERE
      CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) IN (
        SELECT
          owner_id
        FROM storage_opportunity_owners
      )
      AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), storage_user_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS user_id
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
    WHERE
      CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT) IN (
        SELECT
          team_id
        FROM storage_team_ids
      )
      AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), customer_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(a.owninguser AS TEXT) AS owning_user,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY a.accountid
        ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  )
  SELECT
    account_id
  FROM customer_latest
  WHERE
    rn = 1 AND owning_user IN (
      SELECT
        user_id
      FROM storage_user_ids
    )
), storage_forecasts_by_product AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN GROUPING(product_type) = 1 THEN '全部' ELSE product_type END AS product_type,
    SUM(amount_yi) AS total_amount,
    SUM(energy_gwh) AS total_energy,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        NOT signed) = 0
      THEN 0
      ELSE SUM(amount_yi) FILTER(WHERE
        NOT signed)
    END AS unsigned_amount,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        NOT signed) = 0
      THEN 0
      ELSE SUM(energy_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
        NOT signed)
    END AS unsigned_energy,
    COUNT(DISTINCT opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
      NOT signed) AS unsigned_count,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(p.focus_levels)
        AND account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM storage_customer_ids)) = 0
      THEN 0
      ELSE SUM(amount_yi) FILTER(WHERE
        NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(p.focus_levels)
        AND account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM storage_customer_ids))
    END AS focus_amount,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(p.focus_levels)
        AND account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM storage_customer_ids)) = 0
      THEN 0
      ELSE SUM(energy_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
        NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(p.focus_levels)
        AND account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM storage_customer_ids))
    END AS focus_energy,
    COUNT(DISTINCT opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
      NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(p.focus_levels)
        AND account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM storage_customer_ids)) AS focus_count,
    COUNT(*) AS fact_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      amount_yi IS NULL) AS missing_amount_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_rows
  FROM forecast_facts
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  GROUP BY
    GROUPING SETS (
      (),
      (
        product_type
      )
    )
), product_types AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS product_type_id,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)) = 1
      THEN MIN(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT))
    END AS type_code
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT)
), teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id,
    MAX(CAST(name AS TEXT)) AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT)
), team_members AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CAST(t.name AS TEXT) AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN (
    SELECT
      team_id,
      team_name AS name
    FROM teams
  ) AS t
    ON t.team_id = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), owner_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    owner_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(team_name) END AS team_name
  FROM team_members
  GROUP BY
    owner_id
), target_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT) AS target_id,
    CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(t.new_year AS INT) AS year_no,
    CAST(t.new_account_id AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(t.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CAST(t.owningteam AS TEXT) AS owning_team_id,
    CAST(t.new_producttype_id AS TEXT) AS product_type_id,
    t.new_month1,
    t.new_month2,
    t.new_month3,
    t.new_month4,
    t.new_month5,
    t.new_month6,
    t.new_month7,
    t.new_month8,
    t.new_month9,
    t.new_month10,
    t.new_month11,
    t.new_month12,
    t.new_month1_power,
    t.new_month2_power,
    t.new_month3_power,
    t.new_month4_power,
    t.new_month5_power,
    t.new_month6_power,
    t.new_month7_power,
    t.new_month8_power,
    t.new_month9_power,
    t.new_month10_power,
    t.new_month11_power,
    t.new_month12_power,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''), CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT)), t.new_year
      ORDER BY t.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, t.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_target_esb AS t
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    CAST(t.new_year AS INT) = CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.start_date) AS INT)
    AND t.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
), target_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    t.target_id,
    t.account_id,
    CASE
      WHEN pt.type_code IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN pt.type_code IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS product_type,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), ot.team_name) AS team_name,
    CAST(v.amount_yuan AS DECIMAL) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(v.power_value AS DECIMAL) / p.target_power_units_per_gwh AS energy_gwh
  FROM target_rows AS t
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (1, t.new_month1, t.new_month1_power),
      (2, t.new_month2, t.new_month2_power),
      (3, t.new_month3, t.new_month3_power),
      (4, t.new_month4, t.new_month4_power),
      (5, t.new_month5, t.new_month5_power),
      (6, t.new_month6, t.new_month6_power),
      (7, t.new_month7, t.new_month7_power),
      (8, t.new_month8, t.new_month8_power),
      (9, t.new_month9, t.new_month9_power),
      (10, t.new_month10, t.new_month10_power),
      (11, t.new_month11, t.new_month11_power),
      (12, t.new_month12, t.new_month12_power)
  ) AS v(month_no, amount_yuan, power_value)
  LEFT JOIN product_types AS pt
    USING (product_type_id)
  LEFT JOIN owner_teams AS ot
    USING (owner_id)
  LEFT JOIN teams AS owned
    ON owned.team_id = t.owning_team_id
  WHERE
    t.rn = 1
    AND MAKE_DATE(t.year_no, v.month_no, 1) >= p.year_start
    AND MAKE_DATE(t.year_no, v.month_no, 1) < p.next_year_start
), targets_by_product AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN GROUPING(product_type) = 1 THEN '全部' ELSE product_type END AS product_type,
    SUM(amount_yi) AS target_amount,
    SUM(energy_gwh) AS target_energy,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      amount_yi IS NULL) AS target_missing_amount_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      energy_gwh IS NULL) AS target_missing_energy_rows
  FROM target_facts
  GROUP BY
    GROUPING SETS (
      (),
      (
        product_type
      )
    )
), storage_base_values AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(t.product_type, f.product_type) AS product_type,
    t.target_amount,
    t.target_energy,
    t.target_missing_amount_rows,
    t.target_missing_energy_rows,
    f.total_amount,
    f.total_energy,
    f.unsigned_amount,
    f.unsigned_energy,
    f.focus_amount,
    f.focus_energy,
    f.unsigned_count,
    f.focus_count,
    f.fact_rows,
    f.missing_amount_rows,
    f.missing_energy_rows,
    t.target_amount - f.total_amount AS gap_amount,
    t.target_energy - f.total_energy AS gap_energy,
    1 - (
      f.unsigned_amount + t.target_amount - f.total_amount
    ) / NULLIF(t.target_amount, 0) AS signed_progress_amount,
    1 - (
      f.unsigned_energy + t.target_energy - f.total_energy
    ) / NULLIF(t.target_energy, 0) AS signed_progress_energy
  FROM targets_by_product AS t
  FULL JOIN storage_forecasts_by_product AS f
    USING (product_type)
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    1 AS sort_no,
    CAST('B01' AS TEXT) AS code,
    CAST('年度销售目标' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    CAST((
      b.target_amount
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST((
      b.target_energy
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    CAST((
      NULL
    ) AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST((
      NULL
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST((
      NULL
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST('查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细' AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('全年目标，商机＋年取最新；金额月字段÷10^8，power沿用当前M0007的kWh÷10^6。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    CAST((
      (
        SELECT
          JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(v))
        FROM storage_base_values AS v
      )
    ) AS JSONB) AS detail
  FROM storage_base_values AS b
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    b.product_type = '全部'
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

-- PostgreSQL只读查询；默认2025全年；无绑定参数。
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
    CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CASE
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS product_type,
    CAST(o.new_processstage AS TEXT) AS process_stage,
    CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
    CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
    CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
    CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
    CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
    CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
    CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
    CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
    CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
    CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
    CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
    CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.project_name,
    o.owner_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    o.demand_status,
    o.created_at,
    o.s1,
    o.s2,
    o.s3,
    o.s4,
    o.s5,
    a.account_name,
    a.level_code,
    o.new_cdastartdate,
    o.new_cdaenddate,
    o.new_approved_time_acneed,
    o.new_submit_time_acneed,
    o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
    o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
    o.new_sampletestpass_time,
    o.new_sampletime,
    o.new_technicalsigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_techcon,
    o.new_warrantysigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_qsl,
    o.new_isneedcda,
    o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    o.new_sampletestresult,
    a.sap_created_at,
    a.sap_submitted_at,
    a.sap_code,
    a.account_factory_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_submitted_at,
    a.account_sinosure_start,
    a.account_sinosure_end,
    a.account_credit_submitted_at,
    a.account_credit_approved_at,
    a.account_cda_start,
    a.account_cda_end,
    a.account_cda_submitted_at,
    a.account_cda_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_approval_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at IS NULL OR o.created_at <= p.cutoff
    )
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AS signed
  FROM opportunities AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
), forecast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS forecast_id,
    CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS forecast_month,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yuan,
    CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL) AS wh_price,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS m
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= p.start_date
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < p.end_exclusive
), forecast_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    f.forecast_id,
    f.forecast_month,
    o.*,
    f.amount_yuan / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    f.amount_yuan / NULLIF(f.wh_price, 0) / CAST(1000000000 AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh
  FROM forecast_rows AS f
  JOIN opportunity_flags AS o
    USING (opportunity_id)
  WHERE
    f.rn = 1
), storage_customer_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
  WITH storage_opportunity_owners AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      owner_id
    FROM (
      SELECT
        CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
          ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS rn
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
      WHERE
        NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    ) AS ranked
    WHERE
      rn = 1 AND NULLIF(TRIM(owner_id), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), storage_team_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
    JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb AS t
      ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
    WHERE
      CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) IN (
        SELECT
          owner_id
        FROM storage_opportunity_owners
      )
      AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), storage_user_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS user_id
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
    WHERE
      CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT) IN (
        SELECT
          team_id
        FROM storage_team_ids
      )
      AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), customer_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(a.owninguser AS TEXT) AS owning_user,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY a.accountid
        ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  )
  SELECT
    account_id
  FROM customer_latest
  WHERE
    rn = 1 AND owning_user IN (
      SELECT
        user_id
      FROM storage_user_ids
    )
), storage_forecasts_by_product AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN GROUPING(product_type) = 1 THEN '全部' ELSE product_type END AS product_type,
    SUM(amount_yi) AS total_amount,
    SUM(energy_gwh) AS total_energy,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        NOT signed) = 0
      THEN 0
      ELSE SUM(amount_yi) FILTER(WHERE
        NOT signed)
    END AS unsigned_amount,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        NOT signed) = 0
      THEN 0
      ELSE SUM(energy_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
        NOT signed)
    END AS unsigned_energy,
    COUNT(DISTINCT opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
      NOT signed) AS unsigned_count,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(p.focus_levels)
        AND account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM storage_customer_ids)) = 0
      THEN 0
      ELSE SUM(amount_yi) FILTER(WHERE
        NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(p.focus_levels)
        AND account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM storage_customer_ids))
    END AS focus_amount,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(p.focus_levels)
        AND account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM storage_customer_ids)) = 0
      THEN 0
      ELSE SUM(energy_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
        NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(p.focus_levels)
        AND account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM storage_customer_ids))
    END AS focus_energy,
    COUNT(DISTINCT opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
      NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(p.focus_levels)
        AND account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM storage_customer_ids)) AS focus_count,
    COUNT(*) AS fact_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      amount_yi IS NULL) AS missing_amount_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_rows
  FROM forecast_facts
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  GROUP BY
    GROUPING SETS (
      (),
      (
        product_type
      )
    )
), product_types AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS product_type_id,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)) = 1
      THEN MIN(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT))
    END AS type_code
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT)
), teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id,
    MAX(CAST(name AS TEXT)) AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT)
), team_members AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CAST(t.name AS TEXT) AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN (
    SELECT
      team_id,
      team_name AS name
    FROM teams
  ) AS t
    ON t.team_id = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), owner_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    owner_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(team_name) END AS team_name
  FROM team_members
  GROUP BY
    owner_id
), target_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT) AS target_id,
    CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(t.new_year AS INT) AS year_no,
    CAST(t.new_account_id AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(t.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CAST(t.owningteam AS TEXT) AS owning_team_id,
    CAST(t.new_producttype_id AS TEXT) AS product_type_id,
    t.new_month1,
    t.new_month2,
    t.new_month3,
    t.new_month4,
    t.new_month5,
    t.new_month6,
    t.new_month7,
    t.new_month8,
    t.new_month9,
    t.new_month10,
    t.new_month11,
    t.new_month12,
    t.new_month1_power,
    t.new_month2_power,
    t.new_month3_power,
    t.new_month4_power,
    t.new_month5_power,
    t.new_month6_power,
    t.new_month7_power,
    t.new_month8_power,
    t.new_month9_power,
    t.new_month10_power,
    t.new_month11_power,
    t.new_month12_power,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''), CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT)), t.new_year
      ORDER BY t.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, t.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_target_esb AS t
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    CAST(t.new_year AS INT) = CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.start_date) AS INT)
    AND t.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
), target_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    t.target_id,
    t.account_id,
    CASE
      WHEN pt.type_code IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN pt.type_code IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS product_type,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), ot.team_name) AS team_name,
    CAST(v.amount_yuan AS DECIMAL) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(v.power_value AS DECIMAL) / p.target_power_units_per_gwh AS energy_gwh
  FROM target_rows AS t
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (1, t.new_month1, t.new_month1_power),
      (2, t.new_month2, t.new_month2_power),
      (3, t.new_month3, t.new_month3_power),
      (4, t.new_month4, t.new_month4_power),
      (5, t.new_month5, t.new_month5_power),
      (6, t.new_month6, t.new_month6_power),
      (7, t.new_month7, t.new_month7_power),
      (8, t.new_month8, t.new_month8_power),
      (9, t.new_month9, t.new_month9_power),
      (10, t.new_month10, t.new_month10_power),
      (11, t.new_month11, t.new_month11_power),
      (12, t.new_month12, t.new_month12_power)
  ) AS v(month_no, amount_yuan, power_value)
  LEFT JOIN product_types AS pt
    USING (product_type_id)
  LEFT JOIN owner_teams AS ot
    USING (owner_id)
  LEFT JOIN teams AS owned
    ON owned.team_id = t.owning_team_id
  WHERE
    t.rn = 1
    AND MAKE_DATE(t.year_no, v.month_no, 1) >= p.year_start
    AND MAKE_DATE(t.year_no, v.month_no, 1) < p.next_year_start
), targets_by_product AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN GROUPING(product_type) = 1 THEN '全部' ELSE product_type END AS product_type,
    SUM(amount_yi) AS target_amount,
    SUM(energy_gwh) AS target_energy,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      amount_yi IS NULL) AS target_missing_amount_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      energy_gwh IS NULL) AS target_missing_energy_rows
  FROM target_facts
  GROUP BY
    GROUPING SETS (
      (),
      (
        product_type
      )
    )
), storage_base_values AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(t.product_type, f.product_type) AS product_type,
    t.target_amount,
    t.target_energy,
    t.target_missing_amount_rows,
    t.target_missing_energy_rows,
    f.total_amount,
    f.total_energy,
    f.unsigned_amount,
    f.unsigned_energy,
    f.focus_amount,
    f.focus_energy,
    f.unsigned_count,
    f.focus_count,
    f.fact_rows,
    f.missing_amount_rows,
    f.missing_energy_rows,
    t.target_amount - f.total_amount AS gap_amount,
    t.target_energy - f.total_energy AS gap_energy,
    1 - (
      f.unsigned_amount + t.target_amount - f.total_amount
    ) / NULLIF(t.target_amount, 0) AS signed_progress_amount,
    1 - (
      f.unsigned_energy + t.target_energy - f.total_energy
    ) / NULLIF(t.target_energy, 0) AS signed_progress_energy
  FROM targets_by_product AS t
  FULL JOIN storage_forecasts_by_product AS f
    USING (product_type)
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    2 AS sort_no,
    CAST('B02' AS TEXT) AS code,
    CAST('商机总预测金额／电量' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    CAST((
      b.total_amount
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST((
      b.total_energy
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    CAST((
      NULL
    ) AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST((
      NULL
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST((
      NULL
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST('查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细' AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('所选期间同商机同月最新预测；只用预测金额，不混入已历月份实绩；按元/Wh换算GWh。SUM忽略单个NULL，缺失条数在明细，部分合计不代表全量完整。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    CAST((
      (
        SELECT
          JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(v))
        FROM storage_base_values AS v
      )
    ) AS JSONB) AS detail
  FROM storage_base_values AS b
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    b.product_type = '全部'
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;
